chapters.title: Chapter 551 Drino
paragraphs: "Husband..." Teresa called out softly, her voice as enchanting as ever.
"Hmm," Vritra hummed.
"Can we go out somewhere together?" She asked.
Because of her situation, Teresa knew she would still have to stay in a room.
Though Vritra being in her life made it infinitely better and more joyful, she still wanted to see more of the world.
But only with him. After all, it isn't just beauty that the world holds, it could be far more disgusting.
"Of course, we will be going to a lot of places together. With me around, you won't have to be cooped up in a room." Vritra said, before adding, "In fact, we will be going somewhere really soon."
"Oh, thank you, husband!" Teresa happily leaned onto him.
The ride continued in silence for a while, then Vritra questioned,
"You have seen me fight, killing all those fishmen and even hurting your family, but you never complained. Why? Don't you hate violence?"
"I do, but you are always right." Teresa answered. Now that it was just the two of them, she had removed her veil.
The person driving the vehicle couldn't look behind at them.
They continued to talk for the rest of the way, slowly getting to know each other more.
And before long, they arrived in the Yate realm.
They were all welcomed back in a grand manner. The whole realm was decorated, thousands of people came forward to see the couple.
Teresa had already put the veil back as they got out of the car.
Vanessa, Diana, Fiona, and Maeve had come with them. Gunter didn't know what their relation was with his son, but he was more than happy to have them as his guests.
While walking with Teresa towards the palace, Vritra questioned in his mind,
'Wifey, where are you?'
"I will be there in a couple of minutes." Came her reply instantly.
'Good.' After a moment, he thought of something and questioned, 'Now that I think about it, what is the name of this planet? I haven't heard of it.'
"You haven't? I think I told you about it before. It's called the Zoratian planet." She answered.
'Anyway, hurry back. I will soon be going to the Star realm.' Vritra said while walking with Teresa.
Somewhere far away in the universe, in an endless dark space.
Two brightly glowing eyes with a deadly intensity could be seen. It was more of a blurry mass of energy.
In front of the eyes, only a throne could be seen, but no one was seated on it.
A person was kneeling, facing the two eyes respectfully. His body was humongous, orange in color, and bulky.
It was a semi-humanoid, twelve-foot-tall, dinosaur-like entity, with long arms and short legs.
"Have you found any of the two yet?" A heavy voice that made the creature flinch sounded.
The creature with a dinosaur-like face was at the demi god level, while the presence he was facing was a god.
There was just no comparison between the two's strength.
His name was Drino. He was one of the strongest people on his planet and would soon be participating in the world games.
His planet had already passed the trial.
"Yes, I found one of his sisters, and this time I will definitely kill her." Drino said, not even daring to look at the two eyes.
He was more than happy to help a god if it meant getting even a slight help during the games.
"No, don't kill her. Bring her here. I might as well try to obtain her powers." The heavy voice said.
This god was one of the demon gods on Vritra's planet. Directly getting involved in a planet would bring heavy punishment for them.
But intervening in such a manner, although still wrong, wouldn't bring him any trouble.
There still shouldn't be any demi god on that planet. Not one could be born in such a short span of time.
It would make Drino's job a lot easier, though he would still be punished. But getting a god's favor far outweighed the punishment.
"Then head out immediately. There isn't much time. That divine must have done something to protect his sisters. If you failed..."
The god didn't complete his sentence and soon disappeared.
The surroundings changed. The darkness disappeared and Drino reappeared in his hall along with his throne.
"What's even there to fail? I just need to bring a weak woman back. Something this simple could even be done by my commanders."
But despite the confidence, Drino planned to go there himself.
Although with the restriction of that planet his strength would be slightly lowered, a demi god was still a demi god.
No amount of lords would be enough to kill one.
After giving out orders, Drino instantly left his planet, heading towards the Zoratian planet.
"Art, tell us if you need anything. We have shifted all your stuff to a bigger room. With Teresa being with you, you need more space." Ava spoke.
"Son, take care of her. And now, why don't you take over as the monarch of the Yate family? I am sure you are ready." Gunter said.
Whether it be strength or planning, he felt Art was better than himself.
Though the couple were still worried about others secretly attacking Teresa, they had increased the safety to the maximum.
"No, I think you are doing a great job. I can't take responsibility for all this. At least not yet." Vritra refused. He still needed to do a lot after all.
"Alright, I understand. You should just enjoy your life for now then. Once you are ready, you can take over." Gunter said.
They stood some distance away from Vritra and Teresa.
Most of the family members were present there. Young men were looking at him with envious gazes.
At first, those with grudges against him were happy that his life would be finished because of this marriage.
But he ended up marrying the most beautiful woman to ever exist, the most talented sorceress.
"Uhm, h- hello, I am Art's cousin-" Ray stepped forward, introducing himself shyly. He couldn't believe the Stealer of Fate was actually there.
"What?" Teresa interrupted him, her voice sounding rather cold, which instantly made Ray flinch as he hid back into the crowd.
"N- Nothing, haha..." He awkwardly moved back.
'Oh!' Vritra was a bit surprised. He didn't think she could even use such a tone.
But then again, she wasn't a little girl. She had lived for more than ten times Vritra's age.
She was like that only in front of him.
It was certain she didn't have a good impression of most of the Yate family members.
There were a couple of rituals that they performed for a long, happy life together, Ava being the one to help.
Soon, all the family members had left. They all wondered how beautiful Teresa actually must be.
During the ritual, Vritra could feel his wives' gazes, and he knew exactly what they wanted.
He decided that before the game or trial began, he would hold a proper marriage for all his wives.
Teresa returned to her new room. While waiting for her husband, she started arranging her stuff there.
Vritra went to meet Diana and the others. Out of them all, Fiona was the most upset.
Despite the dream they had seen, they wanted a wedding too. Not to mention, they wanted to spend time with him.

chapters.title: Chapter 552 Coaxing
paragraphs: Outside of the palace, Vritra came to meet Maeve and the others.
They would be going back for now, but each of his women wanted to stay longer with him.
So for now, they needed Teresa to know everything first.
And maybe hope that she could control her abilities.
"Mom, I have got some gifts for you and Diana too." Vritra said, the five were away from everyone's sight.
"Gifts? Well, it should be us giving you gifts after all, you just married." Vanessa said, before asking seductively, "When would you like to receive your gift?"
"Hmm, soon, very soon. Anyway, this is for you." Vritra spoke as he took out the piece of cloth and handed it to his mother.
"What is this? It is too small to be turned into a dress..." Vanessa looked at the cloth, which was a bit too big to be a handkerchief and too small for any other use.
"Well, Divine gave them to me and told me you can figure it out. It is a weapon and can also increase your strength." Vritra explained.
Vanessa put the cloth away in her inventory.
"Alright, then I will study it later. Thank you, honey." She spoke, giving a soft kiss on his lips.
"And Diana, this is for you." Next, he took out a heavy metallic door, whose size was rather small.
"Is that a toy?" the goddess questioned while tilting her head, only to be surprised by the energy seeping out of it.
"This is called the Tomb of Gods, you too can check it out later." Vritra spoke and handed it to her. "Be careful and tell me if it's anything dangerous."
"Okay, thank you, dear." Diana put away the door, and she too gave a kiss on his lips.
"Foxy and Fiona, I will bring something for you next. That's all I got from Divine for now." Vritra said.
"It's alright, Master, what I want more is you." Maeve wrapped her arms around his body and rubbed her cheek against his chest.
Vritra patted her head, then spoke, "Foxy, how many demon lords are there in total?"
Without leaving his embrace, the fox demon replied, "Master, there are a total of a hundred demon lords serving under the five gods."
She continued after a moment, "There could be a couple more lords who could only be recognized when someone dies among the hundred lords."
"I see. That pig demon is still alive, right?" he asked, remembering the scene from the war.
All other demon lords had died then, but the pig had managed to survive, although barely.
"Yeah, he is one of the strong lords. His strength has grown a lot by now, or so I heard." Maeve answered. Now she was a walking encyclopedia.
Vritra could easily get most information from her.
"I see. It is time to butcher that pig and also take over the demon realms. Let's have some demon lords as pets." Vritra said.
It didn't matter to him whether it was humans or demons, they were all the same to him.
"Alright, just tell me whenever you want. I have all the information about each of them." Maeve said confidently.
"Good job, Foxy. World Information Center is too small for you. Let's make you the Queen of all demons." Vritra said with a faint smile.
"If you are the king, then sure, hehe." The demoness tilted her head up and pressed her lips against his, lingering a few moments longer than his other wives.
Before their lips separated, her tongue sneaked out, giving a light lick against his lips.
"Haa, Fiona..." Vritra turned to the redhead, but she was upset with him for not giving her any time.
Pulling her into his arms, he relaxed into her warmth, mumbling, "I will be going to the Star Realm soon. How about you come with me there?"
"... " Fiona fought back the urge to reply instantly. He had been pouring all his love and care onto Teresa recently.
She wanted it all too. It made her feel so jealous, and so the redhead couldn't just forgive him.
"And if you don't have anything to do, why don't you just stay here with me?" Vritra asked. Fiona was only slightly more mature when it came to him.
"Wouldn't your new wife be upset?" she mumbled, standing in his arms with her cheeks puffed up like a squirrel.
"No. I will tell her everything soon. No matter what, my love for you will never change. Don't tell me you think you are lower in any way than Teresa?" Vritra asked, looking into her eyes.
"Of course I am not." Fiona replied, though she hadn't seen her appearance, so her confidence was a bit low.
"Heh. My lovely Fiona, cheer up. We are getting a new home soon, just for our family." He spoke, trying to make her mood better.
The whole marriage event came too fast. After his return, he didn't even get to spend much time with his wives.
"A house? Where?" Fiona finally seemed a little excited. Living in their own home, just imagining it made her happy.
"That's a secret. I will show it to you once it's ready." Vritra said. He really needed to tell Teresa everything and also find a way so his other wives' presence wouldn't put her in danger.
"Honey, we will be leaving first then." Vanessa, Diana, and Maeve left soon. Unlike Fiona, they had to look over many decisions.
But very soon, they would be free from most such duties. Fiona didn't really participate in small matters, and everyone was too afraid to do anything wrong.
They all feared her too much to even think of trying anything behind her back.
Only Fiona and Vritra were left there now.
"Darling, I want you." Fiona spoke with a needy look.
"Just wait a bit, I—" Vritra was just speaking when suddenly a soft body hit his back.
"Hubby, I am back! Did you miss me?" Yasmine hugged him from behind, charging up her energy meter after having been separated from Vritra for so long.
"Wifey, it's great that you are back. I definitely missed you." Vritra gently pulled Yasmine closer, hugging the two women.
"So when are we going to the Star Realm?" Yasmine asked.
"Tomorrow. Let's all go together." He replied.
"Anyway, so when are you giving time to me and Fiona? I understand Teresa needs more of your time for now, but you gotta give us some time too, no?" Yasmine said. She couldn't delay things.
"I know, and I will give you time." Vritra said. Having so many relationships was actually a bit tough.
But he was happy nonetheless.
"Let's go, I will ask them to arrang—" Vritra was just speaking when Yasmine interrupted.
"There is no need. I would rather be in the fourth dimension, staying close to you."
"Me too. I also want to be close to you, darling." Fiona said, pressing her lips against his cheek in a sensual kiss.
Yasmine followed, kissing his other cheek.
"Okay, okay, I will do as you wish." Vritra sighed, allowing them to enter the fourth dimension.
Now it seemed as if two ghosts, two beautiful ghosts, were constantly revolving around him, but who was he to complain.

chapters.title: Chapter 553 Intruders
paragraphs: Vritra returned to his room, and Teresa had already put her clothes and other things in the room.
The thought that she was newly wed and that she would be living with her husband from now on made her feel excited and tingly.
He was away just for a few minutes, and she was already missing him.
Teresa thanked her late mother for choosing such a wonderful husband for her.
Just then, the door opened.
"Tess," Vritra called out, as she couldn't constantly be keeping check of her surroundings, and he didn't want to startle her.
"Husband!" Teresa turned back, her pupils unfocused.
'What can I do about her eyes?' Vritra felt really bad seeing it, but he had no control over fate for now.
He wondered if he would have to wait until he was a god to change her fate, or if a god could even do that.
"What's wrong, husband?" Teresa walked closer, gently embracing him.
"It's nothing. Let's go to see the Star realm tomorrow," Vritra said, pulling her closer.
'That aside, the news that Tess is here must have already spread, so I wonder if people would come to target her,' Vritra wondered as he removed her veil.
He put several barriers over the room, so no one could suddenly barge in.
Teresa always kept herself covered, since if a normal man saw her, there was a high chance that he would go crazy.
Just like that fishman king's son, who had only seen a very brief glimpse of her from a distance.
He slipped one arm under her feet and picked Teresa up in a princess carry, surprising her as she clutched his clothes.
Then he sat on the bed and made Teresa sit on his lap, facing him.
"Tess, do you want to learn how to fight?" he asked, pulling her closer, their bodies pressed tightly together.
They were so close, feeling each other's warmth, that for a moment Teresa grasped for breath.
Feeling a little shy, she wrapped her arms around his neck and put her blushing face over his shoulder.
"...No, I don't want to hurt anyone," she replied, but she knew this wasn't the answer he wanted.
"Okay, we will wait then," he said, caressing her back.
Her body felt really soft and warm, her voluptuous breasts pressed against his chest, her feet hanging nervously.
"Can you tell me what you knew about me before marriage? Did your mother tell you something, or was it a dream or something?" he asked, breathing in the air full of her fragrance.
Her scent really put such a strong charm over him.
"My mother told me about it," Teresa said, her heart beating rapidly.
"So what did she tell you?" Vritra wondered what sort of person she was, the woman who had taught so much to Teresa.
Thankfully, she was not like most Fords, which was why he could get such a good and well mannered wife.
"I know you are not Art Yates. You are... uhm, I know your real identity," Teresa replied.
Vritra was confused for a moment, then remembered that her mother had taught her that calling her husband's name brings bad luck.
"So you know I am Vritra?" he asked, and Teresa nodded.
"You know who I actually am and everything from the war back then?" he continued.
"Yes, my mother told me about it all," Teresa replied softly, enjoying the closeness.
Vritra paused, then asked, "You knew I was a demon, but still decided to marry me? And you also know I have other wives."
"Yes, and yes. I do know the five women who visited are your wives," Teresa said, though she didn't sound sure.
Her mother hadn't told her much about his other wives.
"Yes, they were. Aside from you, I have six wives," Vritra said directly, wondering what her reaction might be.
"S- Six!" Teresa exclaimed, so Vritra had a total of seven wives now.
Suddenly she was worried about even getting enough affection from him.
'Husband must already be deeply in love with his other wives while we are just getting to know each other.'
Her start was already so late, and unlike his other wives, she also had many negatives.
"Don't have any useless thoughts. I love everyone in my family dearly and would never neglect anyone.
I am sure you would like them too and can finally have a happy family," Vritra said, clearly understanding what was going through her head.
Teresa was about to speak, but they paused.
Suddenly, they could sense quite a lot of presences entering the Yate realm and heading towards them.
"They came fast," Vritra shook his head. They were certainly here to target his wife.
Even that Smog guy had come, except his entrance wasn't really sneaky, unlike all the others.
"Oh, they must be here for me," Teresa mumbled, sighing and leaning into his arms.
"It's alright. Psyche, go deal with them," Vritra said, as Psyche, who was already protecting the realm, changed its direction and headed toward the intruders.
"Anyway, I have more to tell you," Vritra said, as he already trusted her and felt he could tell her his secrets.
"Y- You have more lovers?" Teresa asked in bewilderment, worried she would never get time with him.
"What are you thinking? Of course not. I never expected to get into a relationship with most of my wives. Anyway, let's start from the beginning."
With Teresa seated on his lap, Vritra began the story from the Dunshire kingdom, telling her about the important things.
While outside, Psyche, who already possessed a new body, the fishman king's body, had started to deal with the intruders.
Except for Smog, Psyche killed all the others without any difficulty.
While Gunter went to meet Smog, the monarch of the Yate family wasn't really afraid of him, but he was from the Golden Moon.
Yet he wasn't just going to be forced into doing anything.
And so, he directly refused to let Teresa go to the Golden Moon's base.
Smog threw various threats, but Gunter remained fixed on his decision.
In the end, Smog could only leave. He alone couldn't attack the entire Yate family.
It seemed they would need to use force against them.
Fiona and Yasmine, who were floating around Vritra and enjoying being close to him, silently listened to his story.
It brought back old memories. They had been through so many disasters, but what mattered was the end result.
"And so, I married you," Vritra ended the explanation.
"Divine...?" Teresa looked at his face in confusion. She had no memories of her past life.

"It is fine to forget him. He is a jerk and doesn't deserve to be your brother. Anyway, now that we are getting closer to the games, you have to be able to protect yourself, okay?" Vritra said seriously.
"Why? Are you leaving me?" Teresa asked. She was sure he could protect her from anything.
"No, but there could be times when even I might not be able to protect you. In any case, I will help you with it," Vritra said, her beautiful face still mesmerizing.
With a goth baddie look and her innocence, she looked absolutely cute.
Yasmine, observing everything, thought, 'It would be fun to corrupt... I mean, train her a bit.'
She was sure Teresa would become a wonderful wife.

chapters.title: Chapter 554 Sorry and Thank you
paragraphs: During the remainder of the day, assassins, various organizations, and all sorts of people were coming to the Yate realm.
Some sneaking inside, while many came to form good relations with them, some hoping to buy treasures from the witch.
The day was quite hectic for Gunter and Psyche, who were busy handling people in their separate departments.
Vritra just enjoyed his time with Teresa, helping her settle in this new temporary house.
The day passed just like that without much disturbance for Vritra; the two slept peacefully together, cuddling under the sheets.
Teresa was less shy this time as she hugged him, placing her head over his arm and talking about random things.
Since the bed wasn't big enough for four people, Fiona and Yasmine took out their beds and slept in the same room.
Vritra woke up early; he sensed that Psyche was still busy killing intruders.
While Gunter was still in meetings with strong people from powerful organizations.
"Good morning, Tess." Vritra kissed her cheek as the beautiful woman in his arms opened her eyes, smiling to wake in such a lovely way.
"Good morning, husband." She replied, before burying her face into his neck, hugging him tighter.
She needed two more minutes of sleep.
"Remember we have to visit the Star realm today? Let's get ready." Vritra spoke after a while, patting her head.
"Mhmm," she hummed, and pulled back. After slight hesitation, she kissed his cheek too, gently pressing her soft juicy black lips against his skin.
Then she got up and turned around, a sweet feeling blossoming in her heart.
As soon as she went into the bathroom, Fiona and Yasmine became visible.
"Darling, where is my good morning kiss?" Fiona spoke with a pout, walking closer to his bed.
Then she leaned down and pressed her tender lips against his. After lingering for a few extra seconds, she pulled back.
Yasmine followed along, giving him a short soft kiss.
The two ladies were already dressed up and ready; Yasmine wasn't going to miss this show.
Soon, Vritra and Teresa were both ready, dressed up in matching clothes prepared by Ava.
"Tess, you look lovely." Vritra said, taking in the beautiful sight.
"Thank you, husband." With a big smile on her face, Teresa replied. She too took in the sight of her husband.
And was just as mesmerized; he looked far better than any of her imagination.
Soon, Teresa covered her face with a veil, but Vritra interrupted.
"Tess, there is no need to wear a veil. Let's go just like this." He said, as he stood exactly behind her, placed his chin over her shoulder, and looked at their image in the mirror.
"But that would be too problematic..." Teresa raised her head slightly, her eyes unfocused.

"It will be fine. You know I have the Misty Essence mythic halo. They won't even be able to see you. I will change your appearance through an illusion." Vritra said, his hands wrapping around her waist.
"Oh okay, thank you, husband." Teresa smiled brightly. She didn't like wearing that veil all the time either, but if normal people saw her face, there was a high chance they would just go crazy.
Even without speaking, he already knew what she wanted, or even things she didn't know she wanted. She was starting to fall deeper and deeper for him.

"You are my wife. There is no need for thank you or sorry. Instead, you can just give me something in return, a reward instead of thank you and compensation instead of sorry." Vritra spoke, slowly turning her around.
"W- What?" Teresa felt her heartbeat increase. She focused on his lips for a moment and then her senses became unfocused.
"I am waiting. Come on, give me my reward." Vritra leaned forward slightly. His arms were wrapped around her waist, otherwise Teresa might have fallen back, her legs going soft.
"Uh O- Okay..." Her fists clenched, she shut her senses down and slowly moved forward.
Her heartbeat kept getting faster, her body turning hot.
After a moment, her moist black lips pressed against his warm lips, though her angle was a little off.
Her lips only touched the left side of his lips, but that was enough to make her body shiver.
Teresa was about to pull back, but Vritra's hand slid onto the back of her head.
Vritra tilted his head, his lips softly rubbing against hers and properly aligning this time.
He didn't make any further move, just pressed his lips tighter against hers; the feeling was just too wonderful.
The kiss lasted for a couple dozen seconds, then their lips softly separated. Her juicy black lips stuck to his for a moment longer before bouncing back.
Her lips were so delicious that Vritra barely held himself back from devouring them. He licked his lips, looking at her blushing face.
"Mm, delicious... So you understand how to say sorry or thank you from now on, right?" Vritra asked, the sensation of her lips still lingering on his.
Teresa had tilted her head back. She too loved her first kiss; who could have thought something could actually feel this good.
"Hmm." She nodded, biting on her lower lip softly, enticing Vritra to continue.
"That's good. Let's go then. Let's see how the Star realm looks." Vritra finally took a step back, separating from her warm and soft body.
Teresa hurriedly turned around; her face was burning. She touched her cheeks, feeling so hot.
Vritra was in no hurry. He would slowly change her and make their bond stronger.
Soon, the two walked out of the room.
Gunter had refused to meet anyone for a while. He was now talking with Yasmine and Fiona, who had just arrived there to meet Vritra, or so he believed.
"Please come, I will have my best chefs prepare breakfast for you while we wait for Art." Gunter said respectfully.
These two by far were the most important people who had visited the Yate realm so far; all of them were just here to make some deals.
"There is no need." Fiona refused, her face as stoic as ever.
'Just as I had heard, the Phoenix Empress is quite scary. She had even killed so many lords. Thankfully, we are on the same side.' Gunter heaved a sigh of relief.
He decided to ask his son later about how he knew all of them.
"You two are here? Good, let's head out after eating breakfast." Vritra finally appeared with Teresa, who was not wearing her veil, but for others except his two wives, it appeared she still was.
"Okay." Fiona agreed instantly.
'Huh? Didn't she just refuse?' Gunter looked at them strangely, but then he hurriedly ordered the chefs to prepare various things.
"You two seem in a good mood. Did something happen?" Yasmine looked teasingly at Teresa. Now that Fiona was all grown up, it wasn't as fun to tease her.
"... " Instantly, Teresa's face flushed red. She could almost feel his lips on hers as she remembered the kiss.
"Yes, she thanked me." Vritra interrupted.
Soon, the group of six were seated around the dining table. Ava and Gunter sat together on one side.
On the other were the four of them.
Soon, various dishes were brought to the table, which were a bit heavy for a breakfast.
So they ate lunch and breakfast at the same time and finally headed out to the Star realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 555 The Star Realm
paragraphs: The group of four flew towards the Star realm; Yasmine and Fiona knew about its location.
"Do you know about us yet?" Yasmine asked, even though she had been there when Vritra was telling the whole story.
"Yes, I know." Teresa replied, her tone not giving away any emotions.
"That's good, anyway..." Yasmine instantly started talking to her as if they had been good friends for quite long.
While Fiona was more reserved.
Without wasting much time on the journey itself, the group of four quickly arrived near the Star realm.
The entrance was blocked by several guards; it seemed they had shut down after the marriage.
Only the monarch of the Star family had survived, while the two other families had both lost their monarchs.
The entrance of the Star realm was situated in a market in the neighboring city; no one was allowed to enter or leave for a while.
Vritra and the three women landed before the guards; because of the illusion, no one could see Teresa's true appearance.
And there were all sorts of barriers around her; not even an insect could get close.
"Sorry, but the Star family is not welcoming any guests right now." One of the guards said respectfully upon seeing them approach.
Vritra had two choices, either to barge inside forcefully or go in peacefully.
Firstly, he decided to go inside peacefully.
"Inform her, Art Yates, Fiona Arclis, and Yasmine Arclis are here." Vritra said.
The guard who was looking dazedly at Fiona and Yasmine came back to his senses, looking at them in surprise and doubt.
He had never seen the two empresses, but all sorts of people had been coming there pretending to be someone else.
But before the guard could say anything, a person who was hidden in the shadows stepped forward.
"Greetings, sir. I will inform our monarch about your arrival." The Star family was, after all, the place which supplied information to others.
How could they not recognize these four; the guards, however, weren't all that knowledgeable.
The guard who had spoken earlier felt cold sweat rolling down his body; he almost got himself killed just now.
"Alright." Vritra nodded. He glanced back and wondered what Yasmine was teaching to the innocent Teresa.
He could only see his new wife nodding constantly, her head moving like a toy.
"Sir, please come inside. Our monarch is coming to meet you." After a few moments, the man replied.
How could they afford to offend these people?
Forget the other three, just one or two of Teresa's treasures would be enough to make the Star realm disappear or purchase it all.
The things created by her were just that special.
Vritra nodded, and the four stepped into the gate, instantly arriving inside the Star realm.
This realm looked completely different from the lively outside; everything was so quiet there.
The shops were closed, and barely anyone could be seen on the streets.
Within moments, a figure became visible in the sky, approaching them at high speed.
She landed before them and took a glance over them as a friendly smile appeared on her face.
"Hello, Art, Empress Fiona, Empress Yasmine, and Teresa. I welcome you all to the Star realm.
If you had informed me in advance, I would have prepared a few things for—" the monarch started trying to please them.
Vritra interrupted her.
"There is no need for pleasantries. There is something I want to ask you."
"Of course. As long as I have that information, I will give it to you free of charge as a token of our friendship, but first why don't we head inside?"
She said, gesturing towards her palace not too far away.
"Sure." Vritra was feeling a bit nervous now that he was close to this lead.
He was afraid that if even this failed, then he really wouldn't know how to find Yennefer, but Divine wouldn't have lied about it.
The monarch led them into her palace, respectfully bringing them into one of her halls, asking all the guards to leave.
They sat around a round table.
"Please let me prepare lunch for you. There are such delicacies that—" the monarch again tried to please them, but Vritra interrupted her again.
"There is no need. I want to know, do you recognize it?" He took out the glass ball, the treasure Teresa had created.
Inside the clear glass bowl, a swirling tornado could be seen.
"Oh, that's... yeah, I do seem to remember it.
W- What's the matter, Master Yate? I- I just sent it as a gift..." How could she not recognize it?
She had, after all, sent it to the Ford realm to create some chaos.
If not for Teresa, this tornado alone would have destroyed a big part of the realm before they managed to control it.
So the monarch was afraid that they had come here to take revenge.
Vritra could clearly read her thoughts.
"We are not here for revenge. I just want to know, where did you obtain this?" he questioned.
"Uhm... we got it from a realm our family was trying to explore before, but it turned out to be far more dangerous, so we gave up and only managed to obtain that tornado.
But it was of no use, so we..." she trailed off, glancing towards Teresa.
Fiona had killed the two monarchs so easily, so how could she, who was weaker than the Trant and Grant families' monarchs, not be afraid?
"I see. Can you still access that realm? I want to enter it."
While Vritra was talking, Yasmine and Fiona were doing their job, putting pressure with their silence and deadly glares.
"T- That place is far too dangerous and easy to get lost forever. I would suggest—" she started speaking, only to be interrupted.
"Just answer my question." Vritra's eyes glowed as the pressure suddenly intensified on her.
He appeared far more dangerous than the three ladies.
"Y- Y- Yes, but it would be a little difficult to find that exact realm again and might take quite some time.
Since we stopped exploring it, we cut off the connections." She answered hurriedly. It felt like one wrong move and she would be dead along with the entire Star realm.
"That's no problem. We can find it ourselves. Just bring us to the portal you use to explore all these realms." Yasmine spoke.
If they could find Yennefer, then most of Vritra's worries would disappear.
"Okay, please follow me. But be careful, that place is just too dangerous—" sensing Vritra's eyes, the monarch turned silent and led them away.
They moved through several corridors and then headed underground.
After moving a few dozen meters downwards, they were inside a large open space.
Vritra had no interest in enjoying the venue; he urged her to bring them there.
And soon, they were standing inside a big chamber.
On the high platform, a big round metallic ring could be seen, its diameter around fifteen feet.
"Sir, this is the portal we use to explore all sorts of realms."
"Alright, you can leave now." Yasmine spoke, studying the portal.
The monarch nodded and left, closing the door behind her and sealing off the place.
She waited outside fearfully.
"Wifey, how do we do this?" Vritra looked at Yasmine, his number one problem solver, who nodded and took a step towards the portal.

The entrance of the Star realm was situated in a market in the neighboring city; no one was allowed to enter or leave for a while.
Vritra and the three women landed before the guards; because of the illusion, no one could see Teresa's true appearance.
And there were all sorts of barriers around her; not even an insect could get close.
"Sorry, but the Star family is not welcoming any guests right now." One of the guards said respectfully upon seeing them approach.
Vritra had two choices, either to barge inside forcefully or go in peacefully.
Firstly, he decided to go inside peacefully.
"Inform her, Art Yates, Fiona Arclis, and Yasmine Arclis are here." Vritra said.
The guard who was looking dazedly at Fiona and Yasmine came back to his senses, looking at them in surprise and doubt.
He had never seen the two empresses, but all sorts of people had been coming there pretending to be someone else.
But before the guard could say anything, a person who was hidden in the shadows stepped forward.
"Greetings, sir.
I will inform our monarch about your arrival." The Star family was, after all, the place which supplied information to others.
How could they not recognize these four; the guards, however, weren't all that knowledgeable.
The guard who had spoken earlier felt cold sweat rolling down his body; he almost got himself killed just now.
"Alright." Vritra nodded.
He glanced back and wondered what Yasmine was teaching to the innocent Teresa.
He could only see his new wife nodding constantly, her head moving like a toy.
"Sir, please come inside.
Our monarch is coming to meet you." After a few moments, the man replied.
How could they afford to offend these people?
Forget the other three, just one or two of Teresa's treasures would be enough to make the Star realm disappear or purchase it all.
The things created by her were just that special.
Vritra nodded, and the four stepped into the gate, instantly arriving inside the Star realm.
This realm looked completely different from the lively outside; everything was so quiet there.
The shops were closed, and barely anyone could be seen on the streets.
Within moments, a figure became visible in the sky, approaching them at high speed.
She landed before them and took a glance over them as a friendly smile appeared on her face.
"Hello, Art, Empress Fiona, Empress Yasmine, and Teresa.
I welcome you all to the Star realm.
If you had informed me in advance, I would have prepared a few things for—" the monarch started trying to please them.
Vritra interrupted her.
"There is no need for pleasantries.
There is something I want to ask you."
"Of course.
As long as I have that information, I will give it to you free of charge as a token of our friendship, but first why don't we head inside?"
She said, gesturing towards her palace not too far away.
"Sure." Vritra was feeling a bit nervous now that he was close to this lead.
He was afraid that if even this failed, then he really wouldn't know how to find Yennefer, but Divine wouldn't have lied about it.
The monarch led them into her palace, respectfully bringing them into one of her halls, asking all the guards to leave.
They sat around a round table.
"Please let me prepare lunch for you.
There are such delicacies that—" the monarch again tried to please them, but Vritra interrupted her again.
"There is no need.
I want to know, do you recognize it?" He took out the glass ball, the treasure Teresa had created.
Inside the clear glass bowl, a swirling tornado could be seen.
"Oh, that's... yeah, I do seem to remember it.
W- What's the matter, Master Yate?
I- I just sent it as a gift..." How could she not recognize it?
She had, after all, sent it to the Ford realm to create some chaos.
If not for Teresa, this tornado alone would have destroyed a big part of the realm before they managed to control it.
So the monarch was afraid that they had come here to take revenge.
Vritra could clearly read her thoughts.
"We are not here for revenge.
I just want to know, where did you obtain this?" he questioned.
"Uhm... we got it from a realm our family was trying to explore before, but it turned out to be far more dangerous, so we gave up and only managed to obtain that tornado.
But it was of no use, so we..." she trailed off, glancing towards Teresa.
Fiona had killed the two monarchs so easily, so how could she, who was weaker than the Trant and Grant families' monarchs, not be afraid?
"I see.
Can you still access that realm?
I want to enter it."
While Vritra was talking, Yasmine and Fiona were doing their job, putting pressure with their silence and deadly glares.
"T- That place is far too dangerous and easy to get lost forever.
I would suggest—" she started speaking, only to be interrupted.
"Just answer my question." Vritra's eyes glowed as the pressure suddenly intensified on her.
He appeared far more dangerous than the three ladies.
"Y- Y- Yes, but it would be a little difficult to find that exact realm again and might take quite some time.
Since we stopped exploring it, we cut off the connections." She answered hurriedly.
It felt like one wrong move and she would be dead along with the entire Star realm.
"That's no problem.
We can find it ourselves.
Just bring us to the portal you use to explore all these realms." Yasmine spoke.
If they could find Yennefer, then most of Vritra's worries would disappear.
"Okay, please follow me.
But be careful, that place is just too dangerous—" sensing Vritra's eyes, the monarch turned silent and led them away.
They moved through several corridors and then headed underground.
After moving a few dozen meters downwards, they were inside a large open space.
Vritra had no interest in enjoying the venue; he urged her to bring them there.
And soon, they were standing inside a big chamber.
On the high platform, a big round metallic ring could be seen, its diameter around fifteen feet.
"Sir, this is the portal we use to explore all sorts of realms."
"Alright, you can leave now." Yasmine spoke, studying the portal.
The monarch nodded and left, closing the door behind her and sealing off the place.
She waited outside fearfully.
"Wifey, how do we do this?" Vritra looked at Yasmine, his number one problem solver, who nodded and took a step towards the portal.

chapters.title: Chapter 556 Threat
paragraphs: "Finding that realm wouldn't be hard with that treasure, but you really have to be careful once you are inside," Yasmine said. Only Vritra was capable enough to head inside.
If any of them went in, then they would certainly be lost or get severely injured.
"Alright." Vritra nodded and handed the glass ball to Yasmine.
Fiona and Teresa stood to the side, not interacting at all with one another.
The dragoness walked closer to a crystal embedded into the wall beside the portal. She injected mana into it, and within moments the portal came to life.
But currently, it was connected to a different realm.
"Hubby, I will be changing the portal destination quickly. Be ready, go inside once this tornado enters," Yasmine explained, before crushing the glass ball.
But the tornado didn't go rampant. She kept it under control with her energy and made it drift towards the portal.
Instantly, the tornado started trying to enter the portal, as if trying to go back home.
"I am ready." Vritra said, as he stood just beside the tornado.
Taking a deep breath, Yasmine focused all her attention on the crystal, using it to change the destinations rapidly.
They were going through each and every location this portal had connected to before.
Hundreds of locations changed each second. Without that tornado, it would have taken them a very long time to enter and check each dimension.
Vritra's fists were clenched. He was ready to launch forward like a spring at full speed as he pressed down on the space behind him.
This was his closest chance at finding Yennefer, and if she really was in there, then he would find her no matter what.
'I need to look for that tiny piece of the love pill...'
Vritra remembered the scene he had seen in that werewolf's crystal ball. He wasn't exactly sure how it was related to Yennefer's location, but that was a lead for now.
A few tense moments passed. Hundreds upon hundreds of locations had already been changed.
Suddenly, at one of the locations, the tornado passed through the portal.
Vritra wasted no time. Before the next location could be changed, he headed inside.
Yasmine stopped hastily. Her proficiency wasn't too high in space, but it was more than enough to remember the location of the realm he had entered.
For now, she kept it locked. Otherwise, the tornadoes might escape.
Right after entering, Vritra found himself in a slightly dark space. There were countless tornadoes wreaking havoc all over the place.
They were masses of energy that were even distorting space and time. This realm was way too dangerous.
Even for Vritra, some of the strongest tornadoes might be enough to hurt him, or so he felt.
Finding a tiny piece of a pill in such a large space was certainly going to be very difficult.
At full speed, he flew forward, letting his senses spread far and wide.
'Yenni, where are you?'
Outside the portal, the three women could only wait. They weren't even sure if there was a time difference in that realm.
Yasmine received messages from her kingdom asking for her help with something, but for now she ignored all of it.
Before long, even Vanessa, Maeve, and Diana arrived there.
The group was ready for any sort of situation, just hoping Vritra managed to find her.
Monk Shitless, who had injured some random guy a couple of days ago, received a message from Vritra.
Unfortunately, he wasn't able to attend the wedding. After escaping from the market, he met with Onest.
They were both told that Vritra had a surprise for them, so together, seated on Bullo's back, they were heading to the Yate realm.
"What do you think he has planned for us?" Onest asked. He was scared of such surprises from that devil.
"Maybe I am finally going to become the ruler of all the evil forces and create chaos everywhere!" Shitless imagined how great that would be.
"But why are those guys chasing us?" Onest looked behind and saw a group of four chasing after them.
One was Jack, second Raino, then Shorty, and finally the prophet girl who ran like a zombie.
"Oh, them? I accidentally made that guy explode and turned him bald. Ignore him."
Bullo ran at full speed. Jack could have caught the bull, but he had to be careful not to accidentally kill the surrounding people.
'That bastard, I am going to kill him!! My hair, I have put so much effort into it... t- they are gone!!' Jack felt like crying. After that explosion, he wasn't hurt.
But he was left completely naked and without any hair in the middle of the market, and someone even dared to spread posters of him after that.
Gritting his teeth, Jack felt that he had to kill Shitless today, or he wouldn't be a man.
Pushing against the ground, he leapt forward, jumping high into the air.
But midway, a portal opened and he flew directly inside it. The other members of his group stopped in bafflement.
While Bullo ran away, disappearing into the distance.
"W- Where did he go? Why does that bastard keep entering secret realms all the time and get treasures?" Raino cursed. He had only come with Jack to obtain some benefit.
But every time, only Jack benefitted while they barely survived.
"S- Should we enter?" Shorty asked, jumping to get ready like Mario.
Before they could, however, a figure appeared out of the portal. A big creature with a dinosaur-like face came out, holding Jack by the throat.
The people around were all frightened as they fled in all directions.
Raino and the other two did the same. Who cared about that self-proclaimed hero?
Drino looked around, sensing the presence of his target, but it was too faint.
'Thankfully Divine couldn't interfere, or I would never have dared to try to kidnap his sister.' Drino thought as he tossed the unconscious Jack away.
The hero was so frightened that a patch of liquid could be seen on his pants.
Instead of going out to search for her and getting further suppressed by the rules of this planet, Drino headed to the location where he was sure she would go very soon.
Vritra continued to fly around. Several tornadoes struck his body, but nothing could get past Loop and Atomic.
He tried not to get close to the most destructive tornadoes for now. Those would be the last places he would check.
Hours upon hours flew by. The realm was quite big, and even after a whole three days, Vritra was yet to find even a clue.
But neither did he slow down nor did he give up. His determination only grew. She had to be here.
A few more hours went by, and finally Vritra sensed something. The bracelet around his arm buzzed slightly.
It was given to him by Yennefer, which previously belonged to her parents.
She was wearing one before, but wouldn't it have been destroyed?
Ignoring the questions, Vritra flew towards the direction where the buzzing got stronger.
Soon, he started to sense a familiar presence. It was definitely Yennefer.
'She is close!!'
Finally so close to finding her, Vritra increased his speed and soon found the tiny piece of the love pill.
'Fuck...'
After flying for over three days straight, he finally came to a halt.

chapters.title: Chapter 557 One Step Ahead
paragraphs: Vritra finally saw the tiny piece of the love pill, but it was right at the centre of a really powerful tornado.
As if the tornado was born around the pill itself.
Vritra's defence stat was still locked. He wondered if such a powerful tornado would injure him.
'It is affecting space and time itself.
If this thing is brought back to the Zoratian planet, then most of the planet would be destroyed within a minute.' He sighed. In his life, why could nothing ever be simple?
Vritra waited for the day when he could finally meet the person who decided his fate, or the people who might be enjoying watching his suffering.
Shaking his head, he focused on the task at hand. It took him more than three days, and now he was stuck at this.
The tornado was quite large. He looked like a tiny ant in front of it. All the surrounding tornadoes that came in contact with it were destroyed instantly.
'Whatever, let's do it.' Locking his senses onto the piece of the pill, Vritra closed his eyes and created two small footholds.
Vritra planned to go at full speed, for the first time after becoming a demi god.
[Shift Activated.]
[Agility: 20]
He didn't divide the stat of his endurance. After all, there wouldn't be a point if he ended up dead.
BOOOOM
With a loud sonic boom, Vritra shot forward, his speed faster than ever.
He almost felt like he was warping through space, and finally he collided with the tornado.
Loop was able to shield the collision, but soon it couldn't handle the violent energy of the tornado. His clothes started tearing from here and there.
Atomic stopped most of the energy. Vritra even activated Suck! Suck! Suck! and used the black hole to pull energy, but it wasn't of much use.
His body started moving along the flow of the tornado. He could barely get control of himself, and soon tiny cuts started appearing over his skin.
It seemed his defences weren't really invincible, though he was still holding better than he expected.
Even his senses were getting affected. Vritra could only slowly drift towards the centre.
It seemed his defences weren't really invincible, though he was still holding better than he expected.
Even his senses were getting affected. Vritra could only slowly drift towards the centre.
Minutes passed. He just kept drifting through the violent current, the level of injuries worsening, but his healing speed was even faster.
BANG
Something struck Vritra's body, momentarily stopping him. This gave him a moment to think and compose himself.
It was a large piece of some mineral. Using it, he kicked himself forward. Using his skills in the best way he could think of, Vritra finally managed to reach the centre.
He took the tiny piece of the pill and broke away from the large tornado, not stopping until he was far away.
'That was... wild.'
His head was spinning, but as he glanced at the tiny piece in his palm, he smiled.
It was worth it. Yennefer's soul fragment was definitely inside.
He could think about how to bring her back later. First, he moved towards the portal which was covered by a protective layer.
Finding his way back wasn't really hard. He could, after all, sense the presence of his wives very clearly.
He knocked on it once and waited. After a moment, the portal opened and a slender arm pulled him out.
Yasmine hurriedly turned off the portal and then looked at her husband. Aside from his dishevelled hair, everything seemed fine.
"Hubby, are you okay?" the dragoness took a deep breath, hugging Vritra tightly.
"...Yeah haa, I am fine." He allowed himself to calm down. His biggest worry had just been resolved.
"Did you find her?" Fiona got closer and asked, hugging him just as tightly.
Diana, Vanessa, and Maeve followed, relieved that he was back safely.
"Yes." He revealed the tiny pill. All the women looked at it in confusion, then they sensed the familiar presence of Yennefer.
"Oh, a fragment of her soul is trapped inside. So this is all that's left of her?" Vanessa mumbled. She had gone through all that to protect Vritra.
"Wifey, do you know how we can bring her back from this?" Vritra looked at her hopefully. She had returned from a similar situation after all.
"Now that her soul is with us, at least she isn't in any danger. First, we need to strengthen her soul to some extent with soul potions." Yasmine said.
The goddess spoke, "I have created a lot of soul potions, so you don't have to worry about that."
"Hmm, that's good. And we also have nihil anima, so at least she would be fine once she is out of that pill. But we have to construct her body..." Yasmine mumbled.
'Looking at this pill, it should be around a tenth of its original size. Then...' He paused his thoughts and looked up before asking, "How long exactly have I been inside?"
"A little over ten days." Maeve answered. All this time, they had just been waiting there.
"Ten days!" Vritra exclaimed. Then the time difference should be over three times.
Which meant that although almost three years had passed in the outside world, in that tornado realm not even a year had passed.
'Oh, no wonder. With Yama's protection, she would be protected for a year.' He thought. Then it wouldn't be long before her soul would be out.
Probably a few days, but now she would be perfectly safe at least.
"How did you get your body back? Do you know of a way?" Vritra asked, turning to Yasmine.
"My parents had left behind a coffin. When my soul entered it, the coffin automatically started creating my body." She answered doubtfully.
Vritra felt a bit hopeful. For now, he put the piece of the pill away safely in his dimensional book, under his constant watch.
"Can we use it again?" he asked hurriedly.
"We can try, but I think it needed some source of energy which I have already used." Yasmine answered.
"What energy source? Like a core?" he asked, pulling out the energy core he had taken from Dago's body.
"Why don't we leave this place first and go somewhere else?" Diana suggested.
So they first decided to head to Diana's palace, where most of her soul potions were stored.
Before leaving, Vritra thanked the monarch of the Star family, and finally the group left.
The poor monarch finally relaxed. All the women in that group were so dangerous. These past ten days had been tough.
Although there were still things he needed to resolve, Vritra was a little happy now. Very soon, he would be back with her.
He held Fiona's hand and Teresa's hand, the two ladies sticking close to him. Somehow, it seemed they had developed some sort of rivalry.
And Yasmine was teaching strange things to Teresa, like how she should fight for him.
Before long, they arrived in the capital and inside the palace.
"Dear, these are most of the soul potions I have created over time." Diana handed him a storage glyph that was flooded with soul potions.
Vritra patted her head and put away the bottles. They were inside a large hall that was completely sealed off from outside.
Next, Yasmine took out the coffin, which looked rather simple.
"Yeah, I don't think we can use it. What sort of energy does it need though?" Vritra touched the coffin, and he could tell it was completely useless right now.

'Looking at this pill, it should be around a tenth of its original size.
Then...' He paused his thoughts and looked up before asking, "How long exactly have I been inside?"
"A little over ten days." Maeve answered.
All this time, they had just been waiting there.
"Ten days!" Vritra exclaimed.
Then the time difference should be over three times.
Which meant that although almost three years had passed in the outside world, in that tornado realm not even a year had passed.
'Oh, no wonder.
With Yama's protection, she would be protected for a year.' He thought.
Then it wouldn't be long before her soul would be out.
Probably a few days, but now she would be perfectly safe at least.
"How did you get your body back?
Do you know of a way?" Vritra asked, turning to Yasmine.
"My parents had left behind a coffin.
When my soul entered it, the coffin automatically started creating my body." She answered doubtfully.
Vritra felt a bit hopeful.
For now, he put the piece of the pill away safely in his dimensional book, under his constant watch.
"Can we use it again?" he asked hurriedly.
"We can try, but I think it needed some source of energy which I have already used." Yasmine answered.
"What energy source?
Like a core?" he asked, pulling out the energy core he had taken from Dago's body.
"Why don't we leave this place first and go somewhere else?" Diana suggested.
So they first decided to head to Diana's palace, where most of her soul potions were stored.
Before leaving, Vritra thanked the monarch of the Star family, and finally the group left.
The poor monarch finally relaxed.
All the women in that group were so dangerous.
These past ten days had been tough.
Although there were still things he needed to resolve, Vritra was a little happy now.
Very soon, he would be back with her.
He held Fiona's hand and Teresa's hand, the two ladies sticking close to him.
Somehow, it seemed they had developed some sort of rivalry.
And Yasmine was teaching strange things to Teresa, like how she should fight for him.
Before long, they arrived in the capital and inside the palace.
"Dear, these are most of the soul potions I have created over time." Diana handed him a storage glyph that was flooded with soul potions.
Vritra patted her head and put away the bottles.
They were inside a large hall that was completely sealed off from outside.
Next, Yasmine took out the coffin, which looked rather simple.
"Yeah, I don't think we can use it.
What sort of energy does it need though?" Vritra touched the coffin, and he could tell it was completely useless right now.

chapters.title: Chapter 558 The Coffin
paragraphs: They observed the coffin but couldn't tell what energy source it would need.
"Well, now that she is safe, we can take it a bit slow." Vritra mumbled, though he still wished to finish preparations before she is out.
"Yeah, she should be out in less than a week probably..." Vanessa said.
Putting away the coffin, the group decided to eat together, it has been several days since they had eaten.
Although at their strength level it didn't affect them at all, but still they craved the tasty food.
Diana ordered someone to prepare various dishes as soon as possible.
"Shitless and Onest will be in the Yate realm soon, I called them to give the two things I got from Divine." Vritra said, taking a stroll with all his wives.
"Who are they?" Teresa questioned.
"Onest is a thief and Shitless is, well, a monk." Vritra answered, now that two of them were almost done with their tasks, they could start their training.
"Hmm." Teresa hummed, quickly losing interest, as they approached the dining table.
Vritra pulled a chair and helped Teresa sit, then he had to do the same for Fiona.
Soon, aromatic and hot dishes were served one after another.
They ate while talking, and Teresa finally got to meet Vritra's mother, Vanessa.
Aside from Fiona, Teresa easily became open with all his wives, especially Yasmine and Vanessa.
After eating the food, for now Vritra planned to go back to the Yate realm, he would also continue to look for that energy source.
Vanessa, Maeve, and Diana decided to stay back and use their connections to find other ways to get Yennefer a body.
"Oracle's body was destroyed in the war, right? Does he possess a body now?" While walking towards the exit, Vritra suddenly remembered.
"Yes master, he does have a body now." Maeve answered.
"Good..." It seemed he would have to go to the Golden Moon's base faster than he expected, and maybe there he could finally obtain a way.
"Let's go together to their base." Vanessa spoke, she too held grudges against that organization.
Vritra nodded, but he wasn't going to go there immediately, but first head to the Yate realm.
He had been gone for more than ten days, who knows what was happening there.
Especially the people who kept attacking or negotiating to get Teresa to work for them, he didn't want the family to be destroyed.
And he also needed to meet Shitless and Onest there.
It was already evening, so he decided to go there the next day.
"Let's go meet Oracle tomorrow, I wonder how he would react after seeing me." Vritra smiled just thinking about it, now Yennefer was safe, he didn't have to worry about exposing himself.
Like before, Fiona, Yasmine, and Teresa flew along with Vritra.
"Doesn't your kingdom need you?" Vritra looked at his red-haired wife, she has been away all this time and didn't seem to care at all.
"No, they will be fine." Fiona replied, none would dare do anything wrong in her absence.
While talking they flew back, Yasmine received some news from the Dragon Kingdom.
"Hubby, I will be going there for a couple of hours... I could also look if there is any mention of some source of energy." The dragoness said.
"Okay." Vritra nodded, as he watched Yasmine disappear into the distance.
He was too used to her presence now, and started missing her whenever she wasn't around.
After staring into the sky for a few moments, the three flew back.
Arriving outside of the Yate realm, they saw a large crowd gathered in front of the gate.
It was all the people who needed treasures from Teresa or for her to work for them.
Vritra was just going to enter but he noticed the two men at the back of the group.
Shitless and Onest were already here, they too were stopped outside.
After a moment they too noticed him, Shitless smiled but before they could speak anything, Vritra just threw the two men and Bullo into his dimensional book.
Then they entered the Yate realm, flying towards the palace.
Gunter could be seen walking back and forth outside the palace door, his face tensed up.
"We are here." Vritra announced, of course Fiona had already entered the disappearing state.
"Art!! Where have you two been all this time? I was so worried that someone kidnapped you, sigh, it's been more than ten days..." Gunter pinched the bridge of his nose, his head was hurting so bad.
The constant assassins, uninvited guests, and whatnot only made it worse.
"Sorry, we were stuck somewhere, but we are fine." Vritra answered, he was in a good mood.
Very soon, he will be with Yennefer again.
"Why don't you meet your mother first? She has barely been eating in worry, sigh." He sighed again.
Vritra nodded and together with Teresa he went to meet Aya, after talking with her they came outside the palace.
"What do you think we should do about them?" Gunter scratched his head, looking at the people swarming outside the realm.
"Just tell them that Tess won't be making anything for them, tell all of them to leave immediately." Vritra replied.
It would make many enemies of the Yate family but who cares, not that they can do anything.
"Okay, and the number of people sneaking into our realm has increased, but... somehow we only find their dead bodies... do you know anything about it?"
Gunter was worried some dangerous psychopath might have entered, but he was only killing the intruder.
"Yeah, it is someone who works for me, so don't worry about that."
After chatting for a while longer, Gunter turned to Teresa and asked:
"You don't have any problem here, right? If there is anything troubling you, just tell Art or me, don't worry about anything else and enjoy your life." Gunter wished he too had a daughter.
"Yes father." Teresa said.
Finally Gunter left, leaving the three alone.
Vritra moved away to an open field and covered themselves with a barrier and finally he moved the three out of the book.
Muoooo
Upon seeing Vritra after so long, Bullo was quite happy. It ran forward and enjoyed Vritra's patting over its head.
"We meet again!!" Shitless exclaimed, then wondered why his bull was so happy to meet Vritra.
"Hey Vritra, congrats on getting married yet again." Onest said, with a shake of his head.
He looked around and saw Fiona and Teresa, who was completely covered up.
"Thanks, anyway, I have something for you guys." Vritra said and took out the two objects.
He passed the metallic bell to Shitless and the map to Onest, then explained how they could increase their strength using them.
"It isn't anything dangerous or shady, right?" Onest asked skeptically, remembering the past instances.
"Of course not, just go and see for yourself, if you don't want to grow strong then forget it." Vritra said with a shrug of his shoulder.
"W- Won't hitting it hurt?" Shitless asked, though he would love to increase his defences.
"It's up to you whether you want to do it or not." Vritra replied.
The two pondered for a few moments and knew it was for their own good, so they decided to do it.
"Okay, then we will be leaving. I will start practicing immediately." Shitless spoke with determination, then he added:
"Thank you piti- uhm sir Vritra."

chapters.title: Chapter 559 The Revelations
paragraphs: "Thank you piti- uhm sir Vritra." Shitless said with a big smile, putting away the bell carefully.
"Thank you, Vritra. I will do my best." Onest too showed his gratitude.
Vritra nodded, as the two started to leave, but then he tilted his head in confusion. Didn't the monk always call him pitiful one?
Why not now? Well, that wasn't really important, but Vritra still felt he needed to know and called out.
"Shitless."
"Yes?"
"Just now, why didn't you call me pitiful one? And to begin with, why did you always call me that?" Vritra questioned, though he had always neglected it.
"Hmm." Shitless narrowed his eyes and then looked him up and down before answering.
"You used to have such a big bubble of misfortune on you before, which represented the miseries of your life and regrettable end." Shitless said before adding:
"But I can no longer see it on you, almost as if it had been separated away from you somehow..."
Monk Shitless himself seemed a bit confused while saying it.
"Huh?" Vritra wasn't really surprised that Shitless could actually see through one's fate, but how could all that misfortune just disappear?
Could it be because of my rebirth?
He pondered and then questioned:
"The last time we met, when you had just destroyed that temple, did I still have all that misfortune? I remember you calling me that even then."
The monk thought hard. They indeed met after Vritra had returned more than two years later after the war.
"Yeah, you still had it then." Shitless nodded and replied.
Then it certainly wasn't because of rebirth. How did all his misfortune just disappear then?
'Was I that unlucky?' Despite all the dangers and challenges, Vritra considered himself lucky enough to be able to live with his family.
But that too wasn't important now.
While pondering, Vritra's gaze landed over Teresa.
'Wait, could it be that Tess stole all my bad luck? But I thought contact with me wouldn't harm her, and she did say it didn't.'
If it was really true, then that would be bad. He turned to face her and questioned:
"Tess, answer me honestly. Did you steal my bad fate?"
Teresa was paying attention to their discussion. Her ability didn't allow her to just see others' fate, or not yet at least.
Only by coming in contact could she even see their fate currently, and from the beginning she was not able to see Vritra's fate.
"No, I couldn't do that even if I wanted to." Teresa shook her head.
But just to confirm, Vritra pointed at Teresa and asked:
"Shitless, does she have that bubble or whatever of misfortune?"
"Hmm, no. She does have a lot of misfortunes in her life, but her bubble is way smaller than what you had previously." Shitless answered.
Fiona just stood there silently. At first it was just Vritra's curiosity, but somehow now it seemed a bit serious.
'Then what could be the reason? How did it separate... separate?' Suddenly his eyes widened as he thought of something.
Yasmine!
Her soul was stored in his body previously. Could it be her misfortune that Shitless mistook for Vritra's?
After the dragoness had obtained her body, she had never appeared before Shitless, or even in her soul form she never really appeared in front of others.
The more Vritra thought, the more it made sense. That was the only possible reason.
Suddenly filled with worry, Vritra called her out in his mind.
Since the two were still connected, he could still talk to her and share his senses with her.
'Wifey... Wifey? Wifey! Yasmine!!'
Vritra called out several times, but there was no reply. This only increased the worry in his heart.
From the beginning, he had a bad feeling about the dragons, like they might have somehow betrayed Yasmine.
Most didn't seem very happy to see her back, they just pretended.
Vritra was about to dismiss them and go check the dragon realm, but then Shitless spoke:
"Now that I look closely, I can see similarities between her and your previous bubble of misfortune in fate."
While speaking, he pointed towards Teresa and added:
"If you still had it, I would have said you two shared a very, very close bond, like... like siblings."
This piece of news surprised Vritra even more.
'Siblings? Then does that mean Yasmine and Teresa are sisters? Huh?' Vritra felt as if someone was messing with his mind.
Yasmine was one of the Divine's sisters?
The one who possessed two abilities and after death created two of the strongest mythic halos?
Was that why the demon gods went out of their way to kill her? The demons instantly put her at their top priority the moment they knew Yasmine was alive.
"Are you sure that they could be considered siblings?" Vritra asked again, all sorts of thoughts running through his mind.
"They? Based on your previous fate, yeah, I am sure. I can clearly see the similarities and connections." Shitless answered, absolute surety in his voice.
Vritra frowned and called out Divine in his mind but received no response.
He started forming connections from the beginning. Yasmine was saved by Nihil Anima, the mythic halo which was so weak at that time. It consumed all other souls, but not only did it not consume her,
this mythic halo protected and nurtured her soul, sharing some of the soul energy with her.
Maybe it was because they knew about her connection with the Divine that they tried to kill her previously.
The more he thought, the more facts started to align with one another.
Divine went through all that trouble, putting Vritra through hell only to increase his strength and push him so he could protect his sister.
All that for Teresa. Otherwise, Vritra could have grown stronger safely and slowly.
So him meeting Yasmine in that cave and many other things were not coincidences at all.
Maybe Yasmine's parents also knew about it. They passed away while protecting her.
Normally, once someone found out about one of the six truths, they would be under the gods' wrath and die.
But Yasmine knew the truth of gods, she knew their names, yet nothing happened to her.
If she was truly the other sister of Divine, then certainly nothing would happen to her.
In the vision Vritra had seen, Teresa was the youngest sister, while the other sister was the oldest among the three.
"Huh? Siblings? What does that mean?" Teresa looked strangely at the monk. There was no way she was Vritra's sister.
Vritra remained unmoved, his mind swirling with all sorts of thoughts, but then he put everything to a pause.
None of it was important right now. Yasmine might be in danger, and that was all that mattered.
He looked at Fiona and spoke: "Stay here and wait for me, I need to go check on Yasmine."
Then he looked at Teresa and, after pondering for a moment, sent her to the Divine realm.
For now, she would be safe there. He couldn't leave her alone.
'But there isn't a lord in existence who could defeat wifey, and even if it was someone from the Divine Kage, then she would still have enough time to tell me.'
Vritra had a feeling that whatever the cause might be, the level of danger far surpassed everything else.
Without wasting a moment, he teleported out of the Yate realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 560 Bloodbath
paragraphs: Vritra teleported out of the Yate realm, whatever might be the threat she was facing, it far surpassed the lord rank.
In less than an instant, Vritra was back to the dragon kingdom. Because he had his doubts about the dragons, he had left behind a knight and a Hellmancer there to keep an eye.
But it seemed Yasmine never got here.
Arriving right outside the palace, he rushed towards the houses of all the dragon elders.
With a snap, all of them appeared before him, forcefully teleported out.
"Huh? What happened?" one of them fell back, it seemed he was in the middle of eating.
"How did I come here?!!" another one exclaimed, barely any clothes over his body.
Not wanting to waste even a moment, Vritra spoke in a loud voice: "WHERE IS YASMINE?"
"E- Empress? W- We know nothing about her..." one of the elders spoke, while he looked strangely at the other council members.
Dago's father was not there, he was completely in Vritra's control but it seemed he knew nothing about it.
Or he must have been kept out of it all.
"Y- Yeah, we asked the Empress to come here to help us with a problem but... she never arrived here." Another member added.
Vritra's anger was increasing with each passing second, the entire dragon realm suddenly started quaking.
An aura that made everyone present there shudder spread, the ground started cracking while buildings collapsed.
The sky turned dark and a chaotic energy spread all over.
"I am giving you the last chance or I will erase the entire dragon race!" Vritra suddenly flashed in front of one of the lords.
Both his hands moved up, clutching his head, his thumbs pierced into his eyes and in the next moment, the head exploded in a mess of bone, flesh, and brain matter.
Then his body was torn apart, the physique got absorbed while the soul got eaten.
"TELL... ME..." Right after speaking, dozens of tentacles came out of his back, as they spread thousands of meters.
BOOOOOOM
Explosions started taking place all over the kingdom, the group had no chance of fighting back so they tried to flee.
But the moment one tried to even flinch, they exploded. The lords were getting killed just like that, now they were truly afraid.
Vritra's body started transforming, his skin covered by a mess of colors, transforming into a deadly energy.
Two big horns appeared over his head, the space buzzed dangerously as if the realm was about to collapse.
BANG
He stomped, sending forth a jolt that instantly killed two lords.
Vritra was going mad with rage, yet he was still calm enough.
He would have used psyche if he had time but there was no way he could check every single one of them.
He read the expressions of them all, when met with such a level of fear, there was no way they could hide their emotions.
All of them were afraid but a few of them looked especially suspicious, as if they were weighing their options.
Almost like they were deciding whether telling everything would guarantee their life.
"..." Without saying a word, Vritra flashed before one of them.
Time seemed to stop, his gaze seemed to pierce through the very soul of the person.
The third eye opened over his head, and flames of corruption instantly swallowed the dragon.
Screams of pain filled the entire place instantly, he tried to transform into a dragon but couldn't.
"Aahhhhhh make it stoppppp I will telllllll-"
"Don't do it, we would be-"
BOOOOOM!!
The council member who tried to stop him instantly exploded, Vritra only slightly decreased the flames of corruption.
"Tell me!" His voice had stopped resembling a human, the sight alone made all the surrounding dragons shiver and almost faint.
Who could have thought there was someone like this behind their Empress, had they known they would never have dared to mess up.
This devil, they couldn't tell who it really was but they had no chance against him.
"T- That way... towards the south gate of the continent." He said barely.
Vritra disappeared in the next moment, but one after another, all lords exploded and died right there.
Yet a colorless flame swallowed them and they all transformed into wraiths.
Vritra should have just done that from the beginning, for Yasmine he had let them live.
But in the end they betrayed her, Vritra wanted to make the whole dragon race disappear but that was not of the least importance right now.
Vritra extended his senses, trying to locate his wife but she was nowhere around or maybe her presence had been hidden by someone.
Teleporting directly, he arrived over the continent gate, Vritra looked around, scanning hundreds of kilometers but couldn't find anything.
"Could he have lied to me?"
Each second felt like a fight against time itself.
Calming himself for a moment, he tried to think.
Whoever it was, they had not killed Yasmine but had probably taken her away.
Even if he couldn't sense her presence, Vritra had a feeling she might not be on this planet anymore.
'Right, the spatial fluctuations...'
[Null Activated.]
Vritra instantly found himself in a strange realm where he could clearly see time and space.
But it was still not enough.
The field palette.
Without wasting a moment, Vritra poured sin points into the Null field which was just at 50% initially.
Filling up 50% at once was far too dangerous, yet Vritra had no choice or time right now.
In the next moment, a vast amount of knowledge rushed into his brain as his comprehension of the Null ability started to flare up.
Intense pain shot through Vritra's mind, this was the first time he had felt such pain in his head.
It really felt as if his body was just about to explode, far too painful.
His consciousness faded within moments as his body started falling down, bloody tears started leaking from his eyes.
[Cry Baby Activated.]
Suddenly Vritra's eyes shot open, a current of energy flooded into his body. He felt as if his strength had suddenly shot up, even his skills and mental strength seemed stronger.
But the pain was still so extreme, at least now he had some control over his body.
Contrary to his expectations, the skill Cry Baby was rather powerful, even the last time it was activated, it had helped him greatly.
A storm soon covered the continent, the energy around Vritra's body started to transform too.
Vritra once again activated Null, he now had completely comprehended this field, increasing its capability infinitely compared to before.
Just after a glance, Vritra was able to sense faint spatial fluctuations not too far away from the gate of the continent.
The figure made of blurry destructive energy suddenly flashed right before the fluctuations which seemed to be fading away.
He gripped the space tightly, and with all his might tore it apart, letting out a fiendish cry that made the whole continent shiver.
It seemed far more deadly than what many of them had sensed during the war.
Vritra went all out, his body entered the passage, moving so fast that time started to flow backwards.
Suddenly a bubble appeared before his eyes, he could sense familiar energy from it.
He was moving so fast that Vritra couldn't make sense of his surroundings, he just gripped the big bubble and with all his might pulled it back.
The passage started to crack and tremble.
