chapters.title: Chapter 561 The Bubble
paragraphs: Almost all of Vritra's skills were activated.
He shifted all the stats to strength, not caring about defense even as his head was full of pain.
Yet the bubble seemed to be stuck, burning out his mana, Vritra started to make the surroundings explode.
The cracks expanded and the passage started to shake, it really seemed everything was about to collapse.
And finally the opposing force disappeared, the bubble came free.
Wasting no time, Vritra rushed back, the flow of time was still moving back and forth.
BOOOOOOM!!
With a loud explosion in the sky, his body shot through into the distance, traveling hundreds of kilometers away from the continent.
BANG
Vritra collided into the ground, creating an enormous crater as he skidded for several more kilometers and only came to a halt after traveling very far.
His body and mind were both aching so badly, with difficulty he opened his eyes and saw the bubble in his grasp.
Yasmine was inside the bubble, unconscious, but completely fine.
This bubble seemed to be the cause of stopping Vritra from sensing her presence, and it was rather sturdy.
Breaking it wouldn't be hard but he didn't have that kind of time right now, his priority was to secure his wife.
Directly, he sent her into the divine realm and jumped away.
BOOOOOOM
A moment after, a figure fell at the exact same spot, increasing the size of the crater as an explosion made the surroundings tremble.
"Oh, a demi god? I didn't expect this planet to have one... were you created by those evil cults?
The last time I checked, they had failed because of that fist... charged fist or whatever guy." From the dust, a heavy voice sounded.
Vritra floated in the air, looking down at the new threat solemnly. He could sense whoever it was, this creature was stronger than him.
"Not too talkative, I see. You are just a level 1 demi god but that's quite impressive for a planet like this." The creature floated up as his figure finally became clear.
"And you are?" Vritra finally spoke, crossing his arms over his chest.
"Just a random demi god someone hired to take that woman away. Hmm, the game trials will be happening soon." Drino looked around and then added:
"With your strength, you should have no problem passing the trials at least. So why don't you just hand her over, and I could be on my way?"
Honestly, Drino was quite annoyed. He had completed this mission without any trouble, it was actually a bit too easy to get the god's favor.
But right at the end, when he was just on his way back, someone managed to snatch his prey.
He was so close to completing his mission, just a few moments and he would have been back.
But at the last moment, this person came and almost destroyed the passage, so Drino had no choice but to let go of the bubble.
Drino really wanted to kill Vritra right there and then, but fighting there would increase the planet's pressure on him.
If he stayed too late there then he would be forever locked there.
"That's not happening, why don't you go back and tell those fuckers to come themselves." Vritra's eyes were burning with hatred, glowing red.
Though his body had returned to normal after suffering so much, he would have taken down Drino along with himself had he continued trying to make the passage explode.
"Tch. And here I thought this would be easy." Drino shook his head, then he pulled out a strange looking weapon.
It was over five feet long and covered with scales, heavy and pointy all over.
"I am a level 3 demi god, are you sure you want to fight against me? You have no chance." Drino said confidently.
Between each level, there is a huge difference.
Even with all his skills, Vritra's strength was not comparable to Drino's. Maybe with Titan's Fall he might have a chance at winning.
But the cost was just too high, everything including Vritra would be destroyed.
"We can't know unless we try." Two long blades appeared in his hands as goop transformed.
No matter what, he wasn't going to give up.
"Sigh, if that's what you wish..." Shaking his head, Drino suddenly disappeared.
"Forbid: Speed-"
[Forbidden Activated!]
BOOOOM!
Just as the skill activated, a heavy strike landed over his back, shooting Vritra's body back toward the ground.
But Vritra's condition was actually getting better as the pain in his head started to dissipate, his physical injuries healed within moments.
And now with his high comprehension of Null, he could manipulate time and space he didn't think were possible before.
Before his body touched the grass, Vritra teleported away.
The space started to buzz all around Drino, after a moment, he popped to his right and kicked the strange creature's wrist.
BOOOOOOM!
"You damned lizard!" That strike alone consumed nearly a quarter of Vritra's energy reserves.
Exhausting so much mana, the strike was just as deadly, as the sky got covered by destructive flames.
But it barely made Drino's wrist jerk, but that was enough for Vritra to continue.
The T rex like demi god was too proud and didn't take Vritra seriously at all, otherwise Vritra stood no chance.
Still, this moment of carelessness didn't give Vritra any advantage, but he was at least able to get something.
Drino was about to launch his second attack when he noticed the blackish material that had covered his weapon in that moment.
"Noo-" This was his favored weapon and he knew perfectly well what Vritra must be planning.
"DEVOUR!" With a shout, goop ate Drino's weapon, making the big heavy thing disappear in an instant.
Not wasting a moment, Vritra teleported away, letting goop digest it.
Several messages popped before him, but he ignored them.
"Hmm. Good weapon, its rank... is pretty high." Vritra exclaimed, he hadn't expected much from that.
But it was actually at the Demi God rank, the weapons followed ranks similar to all other creatures.
After swallowing it, Goop's abilities got stronger by a big margin.
"You damned bug, how dare you steal it!!" Drino moved extremely fast, Vritra didn't even have the chance to notice the change.
BOOOOOM!!
Again his body got thrown away, and this was mere physical strength, the difference in power was just too huge.
COUGH
Vritra almost coughed out blood, his body landing heavily on the ground.
Escaping or hiding wasn't an option, but he also knew defeating that thing was impossible for the current him.
'What can I do? What can I do?'
Was trying to survive against this lizard demi god until he was suppressed enough by the planet's rules his only option?
Vritra didn't even have time to think, even with mastery over space and time, he somehow couldn't do much.
Forbidden, shift, null, Vritra was trying everything, but Drino's strength only seemed to be increasing.
All scales on Drino's body started to shine, his body becoming slimmer and more agile.
Terrifying energy started to swirl around his body, then he surrounded the whole area with his demi god's domain.
As suddenly, heavy pressure descended over Vritra, each strike started to become fatal.
Goop and Atomic too couldn't do much, his defenses started to break as Vritra was forced into a defensive position.

chapters.title: Chapter 562 End?
paragraphs: BANG
The place several kilometres around was thoroughly destroyed with one of Drino's attacks, his domain looked as if it was made of countless scales.
Inside his domain, the speed and strength of Drino kept increasing, while Vritra couldn't even open his own domain.
The difference in strength was clear.
With all his strength and abilities, Vritra was barely managing to protect himself, with each strike the injuries on his body kept getting worse.
BOOOOOOM!
The sky was suddenly covered by greenish energy as a tsunami of scales left countless long cuts over his skin.
'How long before the planet's rules start suppressing this bastard?' Vritra had tried everything but just a two level difference was so enormous.
"Regretting now, are you? Why don't you hand her over, my offer still stands." Drino suddenly flashed behind Vritra, his hand shooting forward to stab into Vritra's back and rip his heart out.
But all he hit was an illusion, thankfully misty essence was still useful.
"Knight, Hell, everyone!" Vritra called out as all the soul wraiths rose from the darkness, appearing around him.
They weren't even at the demi god level yet, but might still help lessen his burden.
[Suck! Suck! Suck! Activated.]
Instantly, Vritra sucked in a long breath, his energy reserves once again returning to full.

"So you are using the divine's abilities, no wonder I found them familiar. Is that why you are protecting his sister? How about I give you a nice gi-" before his sentence could finish, however, two hands rose from nowhere and held his feet tightly.
Hellmancer let out a loud shout, waving the staff around and then bringing it toward Knight.
Surprisingly, the space around Drino's body was torn and instead of moving his body, Hellmancer moved that very space, throwing it toward Knight.
WHOOSH
Knight raised the heavy sword, goop hurriedly climbed onto the large sword, strengthening it further and then...
BOOOOOOOOM
Knight waved the sword with all his might and struck the demi god who didn't even try to defend.
The sky was covered with darkness after the first heavy strike. Knight didn't stop, its eyes glowed and the sword started flashing.
BANG BANG BANG
One after another, strikes after strikes kept landing over Drino's body.
The Demi God's gaze, however, was still fixed on Vritra, that was the only person who could pose any threat with his strange abilities after all.
Hitting the same place again and again, Knight finally succeeded in drawing a drop of blood from Drino's arm.
'Good.' Vritra moved back as he teleported the drop of blood and touched it, instantly activating the blood lock.
Now it truly was a fight against time, if he could just manage to survive for a little longer then-
"Hah, you think such tricks would work on me?" Drino chuckled, pulling out a glass tube from his inventory, then crushing it.
His body instantly got covered by a thin layer of fog and all connections from the outside world were cut off.
And unfortunately, even blood lock was on pause for now, Vritra's strength wasn't enough to bypass that layer of security.
'Fuck!' Cursing, he launched himself toward the creature, all his soul wraiths attacking at the same time.
"You seem to have quite a lot of treasures on you, I have now changed my mind." Drino took a straight posture as if he had just gotten serious before adding:
"Now you will have to die first, nihil anime and misty essence, two of the mythic halos? Haha, that alone is worth it. Your weapon and much more will all be mine soon."
Looking at Vritra as if he were some lost treasure, Drino chuckled and disappeared.
The area inside the domain suddenly became dark, in an instant, all soul wraiths were destroyed and returned to his body.
Before Vritra even had the chance to teleport away or slow down time, something sharp slashed at his chest.
Tearing through goop's defenses and atomic, it reached deep into his skin as blood spluttered out.
Vritra didn't feel any pain but if things continued like this, then he would be weakened greatly.
Drino's speed had increased even more, Vritra slowed time but it was quite difficult to do so with the other demi god.
"Give up! You have no chance, hahahah!" the heavy voice sounded from all around as strike after strike kept landing over Vritra's body.
Using Lost, he tried disappearing into the surroundings but it still wasn't enough as another cut appeared over his back.
CLANG
Drino's tail suddenly stabbed toward his face but Vritra moved just in time and barely managed to save himself.
The domain seemed to have strange effects on them both, on one side it was weakening Vritra greatly while strengthening Drino.
So the difference in their strength kept increasing.
Vritra could only curse Divine, that pathetic bastard just loved playing games. But on second thought, he wouldn't play around with his sister's life, so maybe there was some reason.
No, he was a bastard who would have his ass whooped later on. He didn't play around with his sister's life but with Vritra's.
BOOOOM
But the tail too suddenly exploded, both of Vritra's hands below the wrist exploded at the same time, his defenses were getting weaker and weaker.
If only his soul wraiths were strong enough to give him some time.
Still, his second last option would be the charged fist and the last option being Titan Fall, but he really didn't want to activate that.
'Good, I should charge it even further-' his thoughts were cut short.
The moment his hands had exploded, the tail again shot forward and stabbed his head, making it explode.
Vritra's body fell down heavily and slowly he was starting to feel the pain.
But his injuries healed within moments, he teleported again and touched Drino's head, then poured out all his mana as radioactive waves.
Hoping to break his defenses.
Using Suck! Suck! Suck! at the same time, the powerful radiation actually started to melt the scales but it wasn't fast enough.
"Haha, why does it seem you are at the end of your road?" Drino laughed, slashing with a long blade.
The blade tore through Vritra's torso and almost cut him in two but he teleported away at the last moment.
The serious injury healed, but he noticed that the healing process was getting slower.
Drino was actually inserting his own mana with each strike, weakening his body from the inside.
'It can't continue like this for long, should I just use charged fist?' Vritra had just flashed higher but he wasn't even given a moment as suddenly thousands of scales tore through his body.
Almost shredding him to pieces.
Then Drino launched attack after attack, he was no longer holding back but was surprised that a new demi god could actually hold on for this long against him.
"You are quite tough, aren't you? Well, let's see how you do against this..."
A grim expression appeared over Vritra's face as his body healed back and he teleported near the ground, his body was slowly getting exhausted.
Drino made a strange gesture with his sword in the air, then pointed at Vritra with a dark smile before muttering:
"It was fun fighting with you, now go die..."
There was absolute silence and all of a sudden, Vritra lost all senses as his body exploded, creating an extremely large storm.

Inside his domain, the speed and strength of Drino kept increasing, while Vritra couldn't even open his own domain.
The difference in strength was clear.
With all his strength and abilities, Vritra was barely managing to protect himself, with each strike the injuries on his body kept getting worse.

chapters.title: Chapter 563 Lost
paragraphs: Drino laughed loudly as he saw one of his strongest attacks succeed as always, now he just needed to finish the job and collect his loot.
'Unexpectedly, along with the god's favor I can get two of the mythic halos, how lucky!!' Drino was quite satisfied.
He felt that Vritra was such a fool, he dragged Drino back just to deliver all his treasures away like that.
But just as he got close to the center of the explosion, everything was suddenly sucked away and then a brand new Vritra appeared.
"Hmm, Null has so many applications, not bad." He mumbled, his body was still weak but at least he was in one piece.
"Oh, how surprising, no one has survived against that attack of mine. You aren't bad, actually you could have been excellent but you should have listened to me." Drino heaved a sigh of relief.
Thankfully he had decided to kill Vritra right here, or in the future he would have been big trouble.
"Lizard, how much time do you have left on this planet?" Stretching his body, Vritra questioned.
"Enough to kill you and take that woman back." Drino's face twisted with an ugly smile and once again the battle began.
Vritra was fully on defense, while Drino became even more aggressive.
WHOOOSH
Vritra dodged and landed a heavy kick over the creature's head but it barely made his head tilt.
'Damnit, even with shift, forbidden, and all my skills, I can't hurt him. That radioactive fist might be my only option so let's charge it a bit more.' Vritra gritted his teeth and flashed away.
Whether he got hurt or he attacked someone, the meter of radioactive fist would keep going up.
And Drino's attacks were so powerful, surely the final attack with this fist would be very powerful.
BANG
BOOOOM
Drino was moving at full speed, his strength increasing constantly. He was trying to hit Vritra's critical points but every time he managed to slip away.
"You damn bug, just stop struggling. You can't win this fight!!" Drino's rage was increasing, he couldn't understand how a level 1 demi god was still alive against him.
Creating a large sword from goop, Vritra swung it around and struck Drino's neck, but it barely had any effect.
The large creature jumped high, then kicking the surface of his domain, Drino launched toward Vritra, whose body was slowly disappearing.
SWISH
Vritra's left arm was cut off just an instant before he teleported away.
Even with teleportation, Vritra was finding it hard to dodge the attacks now. Gritting his teeth, he stopped time, exhausting a large amount of his mana.
And then he called out his soul wraiths again, and together they started to attack, yet Drino's natural defenses were quite high.
"ENOUGH!" the demi god exploded in rage, he broke free and destroyed the soul wraiths again and this time, his hand stabbed straight into one of Vritra's hearts.
And then he called out his soul wraiths again, and together they started to attack, yet Drino's natural defenses were quite high.
"ENOUGH!" the demi god exploded in rage, he broke free and destroyed the soul wraiths again and this time, his hand stabbed straight into one of Vritra's hearts.
BOOOOOM
With a loud explosion, they were separated as one of the hearts got destroyed. Vritra coughed out blood, his complexion becoming paler, the situation was too hopeless.
He fell down, and just a moment before Vritra could have moved away, Drino landed heavily on him, stomping hard over his chest.
His tail moved at extreme speed, stabbing his chest again and destroying the second heart, as Vritra's vision started to turn blurry.
His body was doing its best at healing but there was just not enough time and Drino's energy was already causing chaos in his internal organs.
"Enough playing around, just die now!!" Drino shouted, he brought his sword down and tore off Vritra's right hand as well.
"Be happy that you got to die by my hand, and thank you for delivering all those treasures to me." Drino's smile twisted, then he brought the heavy sword down.
Atomic, elegy parasite, and goop instantly reacted, protecting him against the vicious strike.
CLANG
And the blade actually bounced off his chest, yet goop was too weak now and atomic could barely stay active.
Elegy parasite too couldn't do anything in this situation.
"Hmm, just how many abilities and treasures are you hiding? Looks like I am going to obtain quite a lot this time, hahaha." Drino was extremely happy, he could even take the divine's skills.
Then wouldn't one day he be able to even surpass the gods?
Without wasting another moment, his arms rose up as he held the heavy blade with both hands.
Energy poured out crazily as he decided to use his strongest attack to kill Vritra in one strike.
Drino's arms started shaking, the size of the blade kept increasing, even the space around it started to buzz.
If it really landed, Vritra would have little to no chance of survival.
'Move... move...' As his senses slightly returned, Vritra tried teleporting away but failed, he could only stare as the enormous blade began to approach his body.
Collecting whatever mana remained, Vritra healed his right arm, he weakly pointed it toward Drino and was about to activate the radioactive fist.
WHOOSH
But right at that moment, a long pinkish cloth flew from somewhere and wrapped tightly around Drino's arms, forcefully shifting him.
BOOOOOOOM
Drino wanted to stop but it was already too late, instead of striking Vritra, he struck the space just beside him.
A chaotic scene played out as Vritra finally teleported away. The land hundreds of kilometres around got destroyed, a powerful cloud of destructive force rose into the sky.
Even the people who were far away on the continent saw the baffling scene, it was as if the end of the world was approaching.
It was far more dangerous than even the war, the Golden Moon and other organizations decided not to even go there to check.
There was no way they could handle something of that scale, so they just thought it must be Divine Kage making its move against someone.
It took a couple of minutes for things to finally calm down, Drino stared at the enormous crater before him in a daze.
Yet again he had failed to kill Vritra, but what had pulled him at the last moment?
He looked back in rage and saw several women standing beside the injured Vritra.
Vanessa, Fiona, Diana, and Maeve were all standing there.
Just now, Vanessa had used the weapon given to her by the Divine, it was truly quite powerful.
But with her current strength, she couldn't make much use of it.
"M- Mom, Diana, Fiona, Foxie, why are you all here?" Taking several long breaths, he questioned as his body started to heal.
"What do you mean why? We are here to help you." Vanessa looked at the injuries on her son's body and glared at Drino.
"He isn't someone you can handle at your current level-" Vritra was just speaking when Drino interrupted.
"So they are your family? Good, now that they are here, let's put the entire family to rest at once."
Drino gazed at them, wondering if he was going to get more treasure by killing them.
They were all at the lord rank, what could they even do to him?
Fiona's body was shaking in extreme rage, someone dared to hurt her husband, she was going to burn that bastard alive.
She was the first to move, before even Vritra could react, the redhead had already launched toward the monster.

chapters.title: Chapter 564 The Weak Group
paragraphs: Drino chuckled, watching the small family before him. Did they really believe their pitiful strength would be enough to stop him?
There was still quite some time before he got weakened by the planet's rules.
'I never expected Divine to have invested so much in someone here, he is already a demi god on such a weak planet.' Drino thought, seeing Vritra's capabilities.
Fighting prowess, perseverance, fearlessness, he didn't just receive all that as a gift, and Divine must have sent him through hell to make him this strong.
'But what if that god decides to take away my treasures? I would have to hide them properly.' The demi god was already thinking of ways to hide his loot.
Just then, before anyone could react, Fiona shot toward him.
Vritra tried to stop her but his body was still healing so he couldn't react in time.
Her body transformed into red flames, losing any resemblance to a human.
'OH!! The undead mythic halo!!' Drino saw the blood red flames and his eyes widened in shock, this was one of the most sought after mythic halos.
Even more than nihil anima, as it could literally turn one into an immortal and possessed such destructive power as well.
Drino was overjoyed, how could his luck be this good? Three mythic halos in one place and on top of that, all were at the top of the rankings.
This was far more than he had asked for.

"Haha! Even your family knows how to make a guest happy, they came on their own to deliver all these treasures to me!!" Drino laughed madly, he might be a demi god but these treasures could instantly increase his strength by leaps and bounds.
Fiona's body had become intangible, the temperature of the surroundings rose dramatically as everything got consumed by the red flames.
Drino kept laughing madly, just one punch would be enough to severely injure her even with that mythic halo.
She was just a lord, how strong could she be?
BOOOOM!!
A loud sound reverberated as Drino's punch sent a shock wave through the air. Vritra teleported close to them but the punch had already struck Fiona's body.
But unlike their expectations, the punch just passed through her body, then the flames covered his right arm and quickly climbed onto the demi god's face.
Drino let out a grunt as his eyes started burning, Fiona reappeared a dozen or so meters away from him.
Not even a scratch on her body, the blood red flames continued to burn over his head and arm, it was nearly impossible to put the flames out.
And Drino was well aware that if he used his mana to stop the flames, then he would just be providing it with fuel.
The flames were dangerous but still didn't threaten his life, if he could just kill Fiona and take over the undead flame then everything should be fine.
Turning toward the redhead, Drino let out an enraged roar but right before he was about to charge forward, a long piece of cloth wrapped around his feet.
And he was actually unable to free himself or tear that simple looking cloth. Glancing back, he saw Vanessa controlling it.
He was just about to attack her, but suddenly a large door opened behind the woman with white hair.
"A- A lesser goddess?" Drino looked surprised but his surprise turned to shock upon sensing the holy energy as the ethereal gates opened.
"T- There is no way you can control a god's power!!" Drino shouted in bewilderment, as he could sense the strength of several gods coming from inside those doors.
Diana had her eyes closed, her body was glowing brightly, making her really seem like a goddess.
The enormous gates behind her opened completely as extreme pressure descended upon Drino, then a hand took form in the air whose size was hundreds of times bigger than the demi god.
The space trembled, Drino tried to move but was held in place momentarily by the tight cloth wrapped around his feet.
And he couldn't properly use his mana because of the red flames, in the next moment...
BOOOOM!!
The large palm struck the demi god's body, he was only able to hold on for a moment before getting blasted into the ground.
Diana coughed after exhausting all of her mana, her body started falling but Vritra caught her in his arms softly.
"Oh!" He stared at the combined attack of his wives, he was quite surprised to say the least.
It seemed they really weren't as helpless against the demi god as he thought.
"Are you okay?" Looking at the goddess's beautiful face, he asked.
"Haa, yeah..." Diana relaxed in his arms and took deep, exhausted breaths.
"Here, drink this." Taking out a powerful mana potion, Vritra brought the glass bottle to her lips.
He looked up at Vanessa and Fiona, the two were perfectly fine as well.
The earlier strike was quite powerful but still it was not enough to kill Drino.
"Honey, let's fight together." Vanessa got closer to Vritra, the pinkish cloth floating around her body, she already had good control over it.
"Darling, don't worry, we aren't as fragile as before." Fiona too got closer and spoke.
Vritra really had underestimated his wives, he had gotten too used to protecting them, but this time they were the ones helping him.
"Alright, let's fight that lizard together." Vritra nodded, then he looked at Maeve. She was yet to receive any powerful treasure so she couldn't be of much help in the battle.
"Master, be careful." Maeve understood this as well, she didn't stubbornly try to fight.
Vritra smiled at her and then sent her into the divine realm as well.
After a moment, the angry demi god flew up, the red flames were still burning around him and deep marks could be seen on his scales.
"You are all going to die!!" he screamed, pulling out two long whips made of some metal.
But before he could swing them around, the magical cloth wrapped around them, Fiona once again turned into flames and disappeared.
Vritra had already regained most of his strength thanks to his wives, he too disappeared.
"You think you can stop me?!!" Since the cloth was unbreakable, he just pulled it forward, his strength was far superior to Vanessa after all.
But right then, a heavy kick landed on his jaw and after kicking him, Vritra disappeared, then Fiona reappeared behind him.
Waves of terrifying flames burst forth, engulfing his body.
Vritra used misty essence to make Drino's attack miss entirely, while letting nihil anima try to corrupt his soul.
The four of them began attacking Drino together. Although with the undead mythic halo, magical cloth, and god's tomb, the three women could attack the demi god.
But they were far too weak, so Vritra blocked all the attacks, protecting them while filling up the meter of radioactive fist.
Whenever Drino tried to attack anyone, he got attacked from three other sides and not a single one of his attacks connected.
Vritra let goop devour two more of his weapons, making his weapon even more powerful.
They kept moving around at high speed, defeating Drino still seemed impossible but at least together, they were holding on.
The demi god was getting annoyed, Vritra wouldn't let him attack any of the women and they kept interrupting him.

Her body transformed into red flames, losing any resemblance to a human.
'OH!!
The undead mythic halo!!' Drino saw the blood red flames and his eyes widened in shock, this was one of the most sought after mythic halos.
Even more than nihil anima, as it could literally turn one into an immortal and possessed such destructive power as well.
Drino was overjoyed, how could his luck be this good?
Three mythic halos in one place and on top of that, all were at the top of the rankings.
This was far more than he had asked for.
"Haha!

Even your family knows how to make a guest happy, they came on their own to deliver all these treasures to me!!" Drino laughed madly, he might be a demi god but these treasures could instantly increase his strength by leaps and bounds.
Fiona's body had become intangible, the temperature of the surroundings rose dramatically as everything got consumed by the red flames.
Drino kept laughing madly, just one punch would be enough to severely injure her even with that mythic halo.
She was just a lord, how strong could she be?
BOOOOM!!
A loud sound reverberated as Drino's punch sent a shock wave through the air.
Vritra teleported close to them but the punch had already struck Fiona's body.
But unlike their expectations, the punch just passed through her body, then the flames covered his right arm and quickly climbed onto the demi god's face.
Drino let out a grunt as his eyes started burning, Fiona reappeared a dozen or so meters away from him.
Not even a scratch on her body, the blood red flames continued to burn over his head and arm, it was nearly impossible to put the flames out.
And Drino was well aware that if he used his mana to stop the flames, then he would just be providing it with fuel.
The flames were dangerous but still didn't threaten his life, if he could just kill Fiona and take over the undead flame then everything should be fine.
Turning toward the redhead, Drino let out an enraged roar but right before he was about to charge forward, a long piece of cloth wrapped around his feet.
And he was actually unable to free himself or tear that simple looking cloth.
Glancing back, he saw Vanessa controlling it.
He was just about to attack her, but suddenly a large door opened behind the woman with white hair.
"A- A lesser goddess?" Drino looked surprised but his surprise turned to shock upon sensing the holy energy as the ethereal gates opened.
"T- There is no way you can control a god's power!!" Drino shouted in bewilderment, as he could sense the strength of several gods coming from inside those doors.
Diana had her eyes closed, her body was glowing brightly, making her really seem like a goddess.
The enormous gates behind her opened completely as extreme pressure descended upon Drino, then a hand took form in the air whose size was hundreds of times bigger than the demi god.
The space trembled, Drino tried to move but was held in place momentarily by the tight cloth wrapped around his feet.
And he couldn't properly use his mana because of the red flames, in the next moment...
BOOOOM!!
The large palm struck the demi god's body, he was only able to hold on for a moment before getting blasted into the ground.
Diana coughed after exhausting all of her mana, her body started falling but Vritra caught her in his arms softly.
"Oh!" He stared at the combined attack of his wives, he was quite surprised to say the least.
It seemed they really weren't as helpless against the demi god as he thought.
"Are you okay?" Looking at the goddess's beautiful face, he asked.
"Haa, yeah..." Diana relaxed in his arms and took deep, exhausted breaths.
"Here, drink this." Taking out a powerful mana potion, Vritra brought the glass bottle to her lips.
He looked up at Vanessa and Fiona, the two were perfectly fine as well.
The earlier strike was quite powerful but still it was not enough to kill Drino.
"Honey, let's fight together." Vanessa got closer to Vritra, the pinkish cloth floating around her body, she already had good control over it.
"Darling, don't worry, we aren't as fragile as before." Fiona too got closer and spoke.
Vritra really had underestimated his wives, he had gotten too used to protecting them, but this time they were the ones helping him.
"Alright, let's fight that lizard together." Vritra nodded, then he looked at Maeve.
She was yet to receive any powerful treasure so she couldn't be of much help in the battle.
"Master, be careful." Maeve understood this as well, she didn't stubbornly try to fight.
Vritra smiled at her and then sent her into the divine realm as well.
After a moment, the angry demi god flew up, the red flames were still burning around him and deep marks could be seen on his scales.
"You are all going to die!!" he screamed, pulling out two long whips made of some metal.
But before he could swing them around, the magical cloth wrapped around them, Fiona once again turned into flames and disappeared.
Vritra had already regained most of his strength thanks to his wives, he too disappeared.
"You think you can stop me?!!" Since the cloth was unbreakable, he just pulled it forward, his strength was far superior to Vanessa after all.
But right then, a heavy kick landed on his jaw and after kicking him, Vritra disappeared, then Fiona reappeared behind him.
Waves of terrifying flames burst forth, engulfing his body.
Vritra used misty essence to make Drino's attack miss entirely, while letting nihil anima try to corrupt his soul.
The four of them began attacking Drino together.
Although with the undead mythic halo, magical cloth, and god's tomb, the three women could attack the demi god.
But they were far too weak, so Vritra blocked all the attacks, protecting them while filling up the meter of radioactive fist.
Whenever Drino tried to attack anyone, he got attacked from three other sides and not a single one of his attacks connected.
Vritra let goop devour two more of his weapons, making his weapon even more powerful.
They kept moving around at high speed, defeating Drino still seemed impossible but at least together, they were holding on.
The demi god was getting annoyed, Vritra wouldn't let him attack any of the women and they kept interrupting him.

chapters.title: Chapter 565 Easy Success?
paragraphs: Drino took out a powerful weapon from his inventory, but just a moment before he could use it, a cloth wrapped around his arms.
Then blood red flames burst out around his wrists, making the demi god let go instinctively.
In the next instant, a heavy palm descended from the sky, smashing Drino into the ground, and Vritra allowed Goop to devour another weapon.
Then he flashed away and took the blow that was aimed for Vanessa, getting his body blasted away.
Each time Drino tried to make a big attack, he was stopped by the four of them. They were attacking him in sync, leaving no openings.
Although Drino was not getting weaker, tired, or wounded, holding on was pretty much all they could do now.
"Darling, do you have a plan?" Fiona transformed back to her human form and asked. By now, Drino was completely covered by the blood red flames.
His scales had started to crack and boil over under the constant heat.
"...Radioactive fist, but it's a one time thing. So I will charge it a bit more. If it doesn't work, then we can just keep him busy," Vritra replied.
By now, all his wives fighting here were getting exhausted. Those treasures were taking a toll on them.
"Okay, let's continue then." Fiona nodded, and her body turned into blood red flames.
Even soul wraiths had joined the fight. They had no fear of death, so they kept jumping directly at him.
Drino was a level 3 demi god, and yet he was not able to kill a new demi god and a few lords. He was bubbling over with rage.
Not to mention, several of his weapons got swallowed by that despicable man.
ROOAAARRRRRR
Drino underwent a drastic change all of a sudden, but before Vritra even had a chance to see his figure, he felt a heavy strike land over his chest.
BOOOOOM!
Vritra was instantly blown a few dozen kilometres away, but midway he teleported back and reappeared in front of Diana.
"You are going to die now!!" As Drino spoke, even the domain started to change. The scales buzzed and glowed.
"Oh shit..." Vritra knew that now even their combined power would not be enough to stop this creature.
Just a moment before Drino could attack, Vritra hurriedly sent the three women into the divine realm and took a fighting pose.
"Why are your punches getting weaker? Is that all to your bragging?" Vritra said, but there really was no need for such provocations, as Drino was already extremely angry.
Kicking the space behind him, Drino appeared before Vritra at extreme speed, and once again the winning side changed.
Vritra shielded himself by crossing his arms, but the moment Drino's fist collided, both his arms broke and then it hit his chest.

'Just how long is this bastard going to last? Such useless planet rules, I am sure the gods must be delaying it further,' Vritra cursed internally. Currently, he really had no way of killing such a powerful being.
Even if he charged that attack more, it could certainly injure Drino, but he doubted it would be strong enough to kill him.
'What? What can I do?' Vritra thought hard as his body started to receive attacks from all sides.
His wives had helped him quite a lot, but with their current strength, there wasn't much they could do.
Just one moment of carelessness would be enough, and they might end up dead.
WHOOOSH
Drino's tail pierced through Vritra's chest, pinning him down on the ground, then pulling out a rather simple looking weapon from his inventory.
He started striking Vritra again and again, each collision sending shock waves through the air.
Goop and Atomic were doing their best to shield most of the damage, but under Drino's wrath, they couldn't last much longer.
And just after a minute or so, the strikes started landing directly on his body, creating deep injuries.
Vritra tried to pull the tail away, but even with Shift and Forbidden, he failed.
Locked inside the domain for so long, Vritra's strength had decreased, whereas Drino had gotten even stronger.
'Should I just use it?' Vritra wondered, but his body could still hold on, so he allowed the radioactive fist to charge more.
"Die! Die! You weak bug, how dare you oppose me!! After you, I will kill those women and take away all your treasures!!" Drino madly struck him, each blow deadlier than the last.
Before long, Vritra's healing ability had greatly slowed down.
But just then, he noticed some sort of change in space, specifically in the space of the divine realm.
And then someone disappeared from there, and a figure appeared in the sky.
"H Husband!!" Teresa looked at the scene in shock. It really seemed Vritra was about to die because of that disgusting creature.
"Nooooo." Her body trembled as she moved on instinct. She had just fallen in love with him, starting to enjoy her new married life.
How could she allow someone to hurt her husband?
Teresa pulled something out of her inventory and threw it into the air, but there didn't seem to be anything.
Drino paused upon hearing her. He glanced back and saw a new woman.
'Just how many women does this guy have?' he wondered, but since she was all covered up, he couldn't really see her.
'Interesting. Even my senses failed to see her true appearance.' Drino was deep in thought when a bug softly landed on his nose, and then...
CRACK
Suddenly, the tiny dot made a cracking sound. The space in front of Drino shuddered and started cracking, like a mirror breaking apart.
Before Drino could move, his body was swallowed into the broken mirror world, locking him away.
Vritra was finally able to breathe. He flashed away as his injuries once again started to heal.
"Husband, are you okay?" Teresa looked at Vritra with a pained expression. Her clothes were covered in blood as she hugged him.
Then, taking a ring from her inventory, she pointed it at Vritra, and instantly his injuries started to heal.
"Yeah, I am fine." Vritra touched her cheek. Once again, he was helped by his women. He really needed to stop underestimating them.
He was curious how she was able to come out of the divine realm on her own, when Vritra was the only one who could control entry and exit.
But that would have to wait.
"Husband, killing him right now is nearly impossible, but I do have a way to throw him out of our planet, for now." Teresa looked at the demi god who was desperately trying to leave that space.
Vritra couldn't help but smile. Maybe getting beaten here wasn't all bad. At least it ignited a spark of change in her heart.
And this time, she didn't seem hesitant to actually hurt someone.
Teresa quickly told him about the plan, and Vritra made some adjustments.
"Alright, let's do that. Tess, be careful," Vritra said as he turned to face Drino again.
The demi god finally broke through the mirror dimension and came out, staring at the figure standing behind Vritra strangely.
'It can't be her... right? But who else is capable of creating such treasures? Or maybe someone else built them?' Drino scratched his head.
Wouldn't it be too easy if this really was Divine's second sister?
Was success really trying this hard for him to catch it?

chapters.title: Chapter 566 Fuck!!
paragraphs: Drino stared at the woman behind Vritra in a daze for a few moments and decided not to kill her.
If she truly is one of the divine's sisters, then he would make a whole lot more profit by handing her over to the god.
Vritra pulled in more mana from the surroundings, but that only managed to fill his core by half.
Then, creating a long whip from Goop, he rushed forward, leaving his soul wraiths behind to protect Teresa.
She had already deployed various protective layers around her, then took out a glyph.
It started to float before her and Teresa started to modify it to meet their current needs, her fingers weaving it to life.
Her creations were far above the lord rank.

'No wonder they are sisters, Wifey is such a genius and Tess too has godly intelligence, they don't really belong to this world.' Vritra thought as he glanced back briefly at his wife, who was focusing fully on the glyph.
Then, turning forward, Vritra swung the long whip towards the dazed Drino, letting it tighten around his neck.
"I am done, husband." Just a few seconds passed and Teresa was done creating such a powerful treasure, though she seemed quite exhausted.
Vritra shifted everything into strength, using all his skills to bring his strength to its peak and then tugged forcefully at the whip.
Drino stumbled forward, coughing loudly as he returned to his senses and finally came out of his dream realm.
Remembering that there were still a few bugs left before he could take back the two sisters.
"Ugh, you are-" but his words were cut short.
Vritra exerted all his strength, all the mana, as the surroundings started to tremble.
His body started transforming, becoming a mess of various types of energies. Scales and horns appeared, and he appeared more like a monster than Drino.
Going all out, oppressive pressure filled the air, massive waves of mana stacking over his fists.
[Nuclear Fist Activated!]
His skill, Nuclear Fist, had gone through a big change as well, filling the meter was now several times more difficult, plus the power was even more incredible.
The charge might be less than the previous time, but the power was certainly many, many times higher than before.
Previously it had reached over 1,900%, but if compared to the current charge, that level would have been met even before reaching 1000% charge.

Vritra knew the whole place around would be destroyed by the aftereffects of that strike, so he started creating hundreds of large protective layers around them to keep the damage away from the continent.
Teresa threw the glyph into the air, and in the next moment returned to the divine realm.
Somehow, she was able to enter and exit on her own.
Drino wasn't able to react in that instant, as the glyph broke into tiny sparkles of light and flew upward.
They seemed to have created a large barrier around the planet itself, though its effect was quite special.
An extreme amount of energy started to flood his fist the moment Nuclear Fist was activated.
The area thousands of kilometres around them turned dark, space started to crack under the pressure.
All creatures around started to flee as if a world ending event was about to happen.
'This?!! How does he possess so much power? Wasn't he at the 1st level?' Drino was baffled by the pressure this single attack put on him.
He felt as if something massive and terrifying was approaching him and he had no way to stop it, Vritra's fist was small compared to Drino's.
But at this moment, that same fist seemed to have become hundreds of meters large, and Drino felt small in front of it.
And finally, the strike collided with the body of the demi god.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!
For a moment there was complete silence, as if everything had stopped to exist, and then chaos consumed everything.
All of Drino's limbs were torn the moment the destructive energy collided, his scales were torn, and organs became messed up.
And the strange destructive energy started to wreak havoc inside him, the storm of energy consuming him whole.
The ground was obliterated, the sky filled with destruction, and the space started to break like fragile glass.
This planet was not yet ready for such a level of battle, there wasn't even supposed to be a demi god there yet.
Vritra knew if he too got entangled in the mess of the storm, he would be badly injured as well, so he decided to disappear into the divine realm.
But just as his body was starting to disappear, the tail of the hateful demi god struck his chest, piercing deep.
Drino's body shot away from the Zoratian planet at extreme speed, breaking through space, and in an instant he was far away from the planet.
But that bastard dragged Vritra along, not giving him a chance to escape.
The barrier Teresa had set instantly started to work, it changed Drino's destination which originally was his planet.
But now he would be thrown far, far away into space, a place where it would take him quite some time just to find his own planet, let alone the Zoratian planet.
And the next time, he wouldn't be able to teleport there, but because of Drino's last effort, Vritra was dragged along.
He must have hated the fact that he was beaten to this extent by such weak creatures, his pride must have been wounded.
Which is why, instead of extending that energy into protecting himself, he tried to drag Vritra to death with him.

'Fuck this bastard, I am so going to kill him, damnit.' Vritra shielded his face as the space around him started to act like sharp broken pieces of blades while they travelled at such high speed through rifts.
No matter how much Vritra tried to free himself, nothing worked, even in that state, he wasn't able to overpower Drino.
'Just two levels could mean such a big difference? How do I even level up?' Vritra wondered, and he was panicking as well.
The force of the Nuclear Fist was so much that they continued to drift endlessly, plus Teresa's treasure had given another push.
After some time, the panic disappeared and now Vritra wondered when it would end, they just kept going on and on and on.
'Huh? How far have we even travelled? Why isn't it ending?' A surprised and bored expression appeared on his face as Vritra finally looked around and saw the speed they were travelling at.
The two were already very, very far away from the Zoratian planet, they passed through all sorts of realms but the power of Nuclear Fist was yet to end.
Vritra glanced down and saw the tail that was embedded into his chest, then at the boiled and broken demi god.
Drino's body was still getting destroyed by the violent energies, radioactive radiations, and whatnot, stopping the healing and injuring him more.
Vritra waited a bit longer but nothing changed, crossing his arms, he tapped and questioned.
'Divine, is there a way for me to kill him and increase my level?'
It would certainly be great if he could reach level 3, the power difference was astronomical after all.
With that level of power, he could breeze past a couple of games without any difficulty.
For a few moments, there was no reply, while Vritra just continued to drift through space.
But finally, the Divine replied...

'Fuck this bastard, I am so going to kill him, damnit.' Vritra shielded his face as the space around him started to act like sharp broken pieces of blades while they travelled at such high speed through rifts.
No matter how much Vritra tried to free himself, nothing worked, even in that state, he wasn't able to overpower Drino.
'Just two levels could mean such a big difference?
How do I even level up?' Vritra wondered, and he was panicking as well.
The force of the Nuclear Fist was so much that they continued to drift endlessly, plus Teresa's treasure had given another push.
After some time, the panic disappeared and now Vritra wondered when it would end, they just kept going on and on and on.
'Huh?
How far have we even travelled?
Why isn't it ending?' A surprised and bored expression appeared on his face as Vritra finally looked around and saw the speed they were travelling at.
The two were already very, very far away from the Zoratian planet, they passed through all sorts of realms but the power of Nuclear Fist was yet to end.
Vritra glanced down and saw the tail that was embedded into his chest, then at the boiled and broken demi god.
Drino's body was still getting destroyed by the violent energies, radioactive radiations, and whatnot, stopping the healing and injuring him more.
Vritra waited a bit longer but nothing changed, crossing his arms, he tapped and questioned.
'Divine, is there a way for me to kill him and increase my level?'
It would certainly be great if he could reach level 3, the power difference was astronomical after all.
With that level of power, he could breeze past a couple of games without any difficulty.
For a few moments, there was no reply, while Vritra just continued to drift through space.
But finally, the Divine replied...

chapters.title: Chapter 567 Professionals
paragraphs: Vritra waited for the reply as he gazed at his surroundings and finally at Drino, whose body was deteriorating constantly.
"Even becoming a demi god is near impossible before the games start, and the only way to level up is by those games designed by the gods." Divine spoke.
Vritra nodded as he continued:
"After the trial, the hero would have a chance at becoming the demi god. The other planet would be destroyed and they would obtain its core and most of the energy."

'I see, so the participants of the actual games would be the demi gods and their teams, and each level up is through defeating the other side?' Vritra didn't know what sort of games they would be playing.
Would only two planets be participating in each game, or would there be more?
There were so many things he wasn't sure about, but he could only wait for the answers.
"Yes, the only way to level up is through those said games, though the difficulty is absurd." Divine added.
'So I can't use this lizard to level up?' Vritra frowned. This was such a waste, but at least he could use it to evolve his physique, maybe.

"Yeah, as unfortunate as it is, leveling up as a demi god is impossible without entering those games. You can't become a true level 3 demi god, even I can't help you with leveling. But..." Divine paused dramatically.
Vritra was glad that there was a but in that sentence, increasing his strength right now was one of his priorities.
"But I can help you reach the fake level 3. Most of Drino's strength is related to his physique. Start with absorbing his physique, I will instruct you further then." Divine said.
'Okay.' Without wasting any time, Vritra held the tail tightly and closed his eyes. Just this contact with him was enough to absorb the physique.
[Absorbing the physique of demi god Drino!]
Just as the process began, the dazed demi god noticed something. Some sort of energy started leaving his body.
Hurriedly, he tried to pull away, but it was impossible. Vritra wouldn't let go at all.
A faint feeling of weakness started to enter his being. Drino couldn't tell what exactly Vritra was doing, but he knew he had to stop him.
Drino tried to resist. He peeked into his inventory to try to find something, but his senses were pushed away.

"Not so fast, lizard. You thought there were no consequences to trying to hurt my sister? You see, the guy you dragged with you is going to make you disappear. He is going to take away all your strength, and even take your soul." Suddenly a voice sounded in Drino's mind, and his body shivered.
'D Divine?!! How are you? Weren't you dead?' Drino felt his body go limp. If he had known Divine was not yet dead, then how could he dare to hurt his sisters?
'F Forgive me, I will do as you say. Whatever you want, I I will-' Drino started begging instantly, knowing fully well that even gods didn't dare to fight the Divine directly.
And by now, he must have grown even stronger.

"Hmm, I can still forgive you, but he won't. You see, my brother in law is quite possessive when it comes to his family. Just endure the pain, it will be over very soon." Divine said, pitying the poor demi god.
Of course, Vritra couldn't hear the conversation between the two.

Drino looked at Vritra faintly. Why did he have to bring this disaster upon himself? Maybe getting thrown out of that planet was still a light punishment, but he was stupid enough to bring his death along.
Vritra, on the other hand, was completely focused on absorbing Drino's physique. They were flying at such a high speed, making most movements impossible.
It was actually taking a lot longer to absorb this physique, but the changes were astronomical.
He had absorbed Dago's and Sir Giant's physiques, but the two combined weren't even a thousandth of Drino's physique.
'After so long, I can finally feel myself getting stronger. I wonder how much my defenses and physical strength will increase after this...' Vritra thought without pausing the process.
He also wondered how long they were going to fly. Did he really hit Drino so hard? Even Teresa's final push shouldn't be this dramatic.
It had already been a few minutes and they just kept going on and on.
'Divine, what's going on? Where are we going? You have something to do with this, right?' Vritra really wished he could meet the Divine and beat him up for all his games.
"Yeah, don't worry. Didn't I promise that I would give you a gift? You are soon going to get it, but the journey is a bit long." Divine replied in a carefree tone.
Vritra clicked his tongue and just focused on absorbing the physique.
More than thirty minutes had passed, yet their speed hadn't slowed down at all.
They kept getting dragged. Even the force of the Nuclear Fist hadn't decreased. Drino was still not able to heal.
With Vritra's strength alone, injuring Drino to this extent wouldn't be possible, so Divine really must have done something.
By now, the process of absorption was complete by more than 30%. Vritra forgot about everything else for now.
Drino had already stopped his useless resistance. It was Divine who was against him, how could he do anything?
'Am I just going to die like this? God! God! Help me!! Please help me, I have even found Divine's other sister...' Drino screamed in his mind, as currently speaking out loud was impossible.
"It is useless. Whatever you might think to try, I have already blocked off everything." Divine spoke. He was quite angry that Drino dared to hurt his sister.
But what better use could these people have than being used for Vritra's level up, indirectly making his sisters safer?
Finally, after a few hours...
[You have absorbed the demi god Drino's physique!]
[Your physique grows stronger.]
[Your physique grows stronger.]
[Your physique grows stronger.]
This message popped several times before Vritra the moment he was done.
He could clearly sense the obvious change in his body. His defenses had grown dramatically, and his strength had increased too.
'Not bad. Now, Divine, what do I need to do?' Vritra asked after observing the changes.
"Now we are going to do your favorite thing. We are going to steal some things..." Divine spoke. Just stealing the physique was not enough.
'Oh, are we emptying his inventory?' Vritra smiled faintly, his gaze making Drino shiver for some reason.
'W What are they planning now? They have already taken away my physique, isn't this enough?' Drino shuddered, regretting taking the god's mission.
And he had thought this mission would be very easy.
"Well, inventory too, but something even more precious than that." Divine answered.
'And what might that be?' Vritra tilted his head. He pulled Drino's tail out of his chest.
The wound healed instantly. Never before had he felt this strong. His body was simply brimming with energy.
Stealing someone's physique didn't give him their abilities, but it also wasn't as simple as just increasing defenses and strength.
Though Vritra would have to find out more about it later.
"We are going to take his Mana Core and heart." Divine answered, his voice sounding sinister.

chapters.title: Chapter 568 The Surgery
paragraphs: "We are going to take his Mana Core and heart." Divine answered, his voice sounding sinister, then he added:
"That could temporarily increase your battle prowess when in a battle. Combined with your strengthened physique, your overall strength would still be lower than a real level 3 though."

'Well, I doubt I am going to face such high level demi gods right off the bat, so that much should already be enough. Now tell me what I have to do?' Vritra moved closer to Drino, a big smile spreading over his face.
He was always ready to increase his strength, and after such a difficult fight he really needed some nice rewards.
Divine started explaining. Using that core, Vritra would be able to launch powerful attacks a few times during a fight, though the core would take quite some time to recharge.
And to use those cores and keep the energy regenerating, he needed that heart.
Following the Divine's detailed instructions, Vritra used Goop to expertly make a cut over Drino's chest. He was so serious, as if he were performing some delicate surgery.
After devouring several of Drino's treasures, Goop was now powerful enough to cut the injured Drino's skin without any trouble.
The poor demi god tried to resist, but there was only so much he could do now except regret his decisions.
They continued to fly as Vritra performed the surgery. Without disconnecting the core from his heart, he took them both out gently.
The procedure was long and slow, but they seemed to have all the time in the world, as their journey just wouldn't end.
Drino looked as if he had suddenly become an old man. His skin became wrinkly and he looked extremely weak.
Yet the hatred in his eyes for Vritra remained the same.
Vritra looked at the heart and the core. Despite having been separated, they still seemed perfectly fine.
'Alright, how do I use them?' Vritra questioned. He could still remember when he had gotten the core of a Demon Lord accidentally.
He barely survived that incident, but that core had helped him many times, so this would also be of great use.
"Use Suck! Suck! Suck! and devour the core like you did before." Divine replied.
'Huh? And what about the heart?' Vritra's brows furrowed. He created a platform from dust and sat down.

"Use your Titan race's skill, just like how you absorb a physique. Let it merge with your own hearts, let it strengthen your heart. Absorb it." Divine explained, then added, "After you do that, these cores will continue to work normally. Of course, the regeneration speed will be a lot slower, and don't overuse it."
Nodding, Vritra got to work.
[Suck! Suck! Suck! Activated.]
In the next moment, the core was sucked into his body. Then he touched the heart and started trying to absorb it.
The moment the core entered his body, its energy started to wreak havoc, but Vritra knew this would happen and remained focused.
'Keke, cough, die, die you bastard. Did you think you can handle my mana core just like that?' Drino cursed internally. He wanted to see Vritra's body explode while trying to handle that core.
[Switch Activated!]
Mutamorphis didn't have to find a new solution, as it temporarily trapped the core inside a barrier, though trapping it for long was nearly impossible.
Before long, the heart started to turn into particles of energy and began fading.
'W- What is he doing?' Drino stared with his half lidded eyes in a daze. His entire body was hurting badly.
It wasn't long before the heart finally disappeared, completely absorbed by Vritra.
THUMP THUMP
THUMP THUMP
The two hearts inside Vritra's body started beating rapidly. They completely absorbed the properties of Drino's heart.
Then new direct energy channelling paths formed and connected with the core trapped inside the barrier.
Mutamorphis let the change happen. Tiny vein like structures connected the hearts to the core.
Finally, the rampaging core started to calm down, as if it were back in its original body.
"Hoo." Vritra let out a long breath. He was perfectly fine and could easily control that core.
Opening his eyes, Vritra raised his right hand and a greenish glow appeared around it.
'H- How? How can he use my mana?!!' Drino almost died upon seeing the absurd scene before him. Vritra had actually managed to subdue his core.
'Alright, this is great!' Vritra smiled, removing the green mana which looked almost like flames.
There were limitations on its usage, but in dangerous times it would be of great use.
'Hmm, killing him now won't be hard, I guess, and there are still things we can take from him.' He was yet to loot the inventory after all and take his soul away.
"Tell me, which of your soul wraiths do you plan to feed this soul to? But let me remind you, the process will be a bit long and there are always chances of failure."
After a pause, Divine added, "And the people of his planet might be able to locate that soul."
'...' Vritra nodded in understanding. That meant other demi gods might try to attack him in the future, and even that god would know who interrupted his plans.
But there was no point in wasting such a powerful soul. Then he wondered which wraith he should feed it to.
The main choices were Dark Knight and Hellmancer. Both were great, but when it came to pure battle power, the choice was simple.
'Knight, devour it.' He commanded, as darkness flooded out of his body and wrapped around Drino.
But that soul was still quite powerful. Just Knight wouldn't be capable of subduing it, especially when Drino was trying his best to resist.
So Vritra used Nihil Anima and the third eye to help Knight. After all, time was one thing they didn't lack right now.
The first step was tearing off the connection between the body and soul, which took several hours despite Vritra using all his means.
And finally, locking Drino's soul and letting Knight slowly and safely consume it.
In his soul wraith inventory, Vritra sensed a dark cloud surrounding the powerful soul of the demi god.
Knight started to devour the soul, but even Vritra was not sure how long it would take.
He finally relaxed after finishing the tasks and leaving Knight to deal with the soul, letting him evolve.
'Well, that's done now. What else is left now?' Vritra felt a bit tired after all that, not to mention he had gone through such a dangerous battle.
Now Drino's body was just a shell of his past self. He wasn't completely dead yet.
Killing demi gods was far more difficult than killing lords, it seemed.
Vritra also needed to destroy the mental strength completely, and Drino might still have some sort of backup.
First, he took away all of his items from the inventory. This demi god was surely very rich.
While continuing to check his loot, Vritra used the Nether Eye to corrupt Drino's mind and completely kill him off.
They continued to fly, hours upon hours, and the speed hadn't even decreased.
Vritra was feeling a headache by now, and just when he was about to curse Divine out...
BOOOOM!!
They finally landed.

chapters.title: Chapter 569 Crash Landing of a Con Man
paragraphs: Using the corrosive properties, Vritra made Drino's consciousness go kaboom.
His mind started to rot, and before long, Drino's body was completely empty. But just to be sure, Vritra started checking his inventory to make sure he hadn't hidden any backup plans.
As a demi god, Drino must have all sorts of treasures and resources.
And he did find several things that Drino could have used to resurrect himself, so Vritra destroyed them.
He transferred other treasures to his own inventory and decided to check them later, as finally, he was able to see some surface in the distance.
Removing the dust platform he was seated on, Vritra stood over Drino's corpse, using it to lessen the impact.
BOOOOOOM!!
The moment Drino's body hit the surface, it exploded into tiny pieces, spreading all over the place.
But soon they got consumed by the red flames left by Fiona. This flame truly didn't die down.
After seeing Drino's corpse disappear, Vritra finally looked around.
And... he found himself on the border of an enormous piece of land standing in the middle of nowhere.
It was surrounded by high walls and a large gate stood before Vritra. The surrounding space was nothing but darkness.
'Where am I?' Vritra wondered, and the Divine gave a reply:
"Just follow along, and don't reply to his questions."
'Huh?' Before Vritra could curse him, however, the gates opened slightly.
Then a figure clad in white armor flew out and landed before Vritra.
It was a... gnome?
The small man looked at Vritra suspiciously and asked, "Who are you, and what is your purpose for coming to the World Bank?"
'World Bank? Is this like a place where all powerful beings keep their treasures and stuff?' Vritra wondered.
"Just raise your right hand slightly." Divine instructed.
Vritra did as he was told. This gnome didn't seem all that powerful, but the armor around his body had a godly aura.

"..." Vritra brought his hand down and remained silent, many questions swirling in his mind.

On the other hand, Vritra was quite shocked. 'Zihong was a demi god?!!'
Zihong was the same guy from whom he had obtained the charged fist, which later became Nuclear Fist.
Vritra only knew a few things about him, like how he appeared out of nowhere and soon all demons went into hiding for some reason.

'Was this the reason why all demons were hiding? I guess it wasn't because of that one attack just as I had thought. But why was he even there in the first place? And is he still alive?' Vritra wondered while following behind the gnome, who was talking nonstop.

Very, very few of them were even at the demi god level.
Vritra wondered what sort of treasures must be kept in this place. For a moment, he almost wanted to check out all the lockers, but in the end he held back.
With his current strength, he can't attack this bank.
'Are demi gods the only customers of this bank?' Vritra asked in his mind.
"No, even many gods and higher beings have accounts in this bank. The security you are seeing is just the surface. Not even a god would dare to try to steal from here." Divine said.
'Aren't we here to do just that? Becoming a con man and trying to steal from this place...' Vritra was suddenly a little worried. With security that high, wouldn't he get caught?
After a moment, he questioned, 'By any chance, if I did get caught, what would be the punishment? Would I be locked up or executed right away?'
"You are better off not knowing it. It is worse than dying. Anyway, just stay silent and you won't get caught." Divine said, shaking his head.

Divine's reply came after a moment, "Zihong isn't dead, but he got caught by the planet's rules. He is still locked there. So you kind of stole his ability right under his nose."
'...Oh. Why did he even go there? To capture Wifey and Tess as well?' Vritra questioned.
The gnome stepped onto a moving platform connected to the corridor. As soon as Vritra got on, it started moving.
Along with the platform, the entire corridor was moving, though slowly.
"No, he didn't go there for my sisters, but to obtain my abilities, the Sin Wheel, and information about the first mythic halo." Divine answered.
'I see.' Vritra and the gnome continued moving, traveling across the mess of corridors.
A few others could be seen heading toward their lockers. Anyone below a demi god wasn't even allowed to enter that place.
A few of the guards stopped them for questioning, but Vritra didn't have to say a word as the gnome explained it, and they were allowed to pass.
After a few minutes of travelling, the platform finally came to a halt.
"This way, sir. Your locker number one thousand six hundred twenty one is just ahead." The gnome spoke while continuing to chatter endlessly.
After walking for a couple more minutes and passing a few security checks, they finally arrived at their destination.
Since Vritra had just recently used the Nuclear Fist, just by the aura, most didn't even question his identity and assumed him to be Zihong.
They stopped before an enormous round metallic door. The gnome pointed at the locker and said, "Sir Zihong, now can you give me the key for your locker room?"
Vritra: "..."
'What key? Divine, do I have it? I don't think silence is the key anymore.' Vritra thought while maintaining a solemn look on his face.
"Sir, by any chance did you forget to bring it here?" The gnome's expression changed as he looked at Vritra suspiciously. Every person with a locker here would always keep the key close to them.
The chances of forgetting it at home or somewhere else were close to nil, but there was a high chance that this might be an impersonator.
"You do have it." Divine finally spoke, as a stone flew out of Vritra's inventory and landed on the gnome's palm.

'What?!! Zengis was a key all along? How can this be?' Vritra stared in bafflement as the gnome nodded and turned, then he placed Zengis over a small stone pillar and the gate automatically started to open.
"There you go, sir. Here is your key. Sorry for doubting you just now. You see, many have been trying to enter lockers through shady means." The gnome handed Zengis back to Vritra with a loud laugh.
Vritra sighed internally. Even his best friend was planted there by Divine?
"Please go inside. Of course, I will wait out here unless you want me to go with you and see what you have kept." The gnome looked at Vritra hopefully but received only silence.
Stepping inside the large room, the metallic door closed shut on its own.
"Haa. What the hell is going on? Why are we even here in a bank?" Vritra was finally able to speak freely.
He looked around and saw several things secured safely inside different barriers.
