chapters.title: Chapter 570 The House
paragraphs: Vritra gazed at the various things stored in different barriers before him, since he had already broken into one of the safest banks.
What choice was there other than taking all the items with him?
And Zihong was locked away anyway, wouldn't it be such a waste?
So as a good person, Vritra decided to do the right thing and help out that poor demi god.
Walking up to the first barrier, Vritra paused. He couldn't clearly see the contents inside, but there was a small pillar beside each barrier.
Exactly similar to the ones that were used to open the door.
'I guess I need the key to open each of these.' Vritra thought and took out Zengis from his inventory.
"Zengis, even if you are just a key, we will still be friends." He muttered before putting the stone on the pillar, but the barrier didn't open.
Vritra frowned. Picking up Zengis, he tried putting the key in every way possible, but the barrier remained as it was.
"What's going on? Was Zengis the key only for the outer door? What about these barriers wait, don't tell me!!" Vritra pulled Zengis's girl from his inventory.
Then he sat Pinky on the pillar and instantly the barrier buzzed and disappeared.
"So even my best friend's wife was set up by Divine?" Vritra sighed, wondering just how much planning Divine had put in from the beginning.
Finally, he glanced at the object revealed under the barrier, and it was a... toy house?
"What is this?" Vritra picked up the toy house, which seemed to be made of some blackish stones.
"This is your new house, do you like it?" Divine asked.
"... And how do I use it?" Vritra shifted to the dimensional book and then inserted some mana into it, but nothing happened.
"Just put a drop of your blood on it, and you will have a brand new house. Just know that Zihong has gone through a lot to obtain this house." Divine replied.
"..." Vritra drew a drop of blood from his finger and let it fall over the toy house, then he waited.
[You have obtained the House of Darkness.]
[Would you like it to transform to its original form?]
"Yes." Vritra nodded as the small house drifted away from him, and then it started growing.
Bigger and bigger...
Within moments, it had turned into a large building, more lavish than any palace he had seen before.
The walls seemed to be burning with dark flames, yet the house itself had a cozy feeling.
There were quite a lot of rooms, and Vritra could feel that he could change most things about it as he wished.
He kept the rooms limited. There was one big room where he would sleep with all his wives.
And each of them also had their separate rooms, the doors would lead them directly to the place they had set.
So now, his wives would be easily able to go back and forth between the kingdoms and their new house.
There were statues, paintings, countless stone guards, and whatnot. Such a luxurious house would be a very precious treasure in most places.
Each of the stone guards had power similar to or above that of a lord, and there were at least five thousand of these guards.
It was just impossible for Vritra to explore the house in such a short time, so he decided to check it out properly later with his wives.
First, he needed to see what other good stuff he had kept here.
'Divine did promise me about giving a house, so Drino's attack, that Nuclear Fist punch, and everything was all under his calculations?' Vritra wondered just how strong Divine had become.
He too was just a transmigrator in the beginning, but survived many games and transformed completely after the tragedy of losing both his sisters.
Leaving the big house in his dimensional book, Vritra returned to the locker room. There were still a few barriers he needed to check.
Picking up Pinky from the pillar, he placed her over the second pillar, and instantly the second barrier disappeared.
"What are these now?"
A big mountain of small spherical cores was revealed, but they weren't mana cores. Yet they seemed to be filled with some sort of strange energy.
"That is the currency used everywhere in the world. These are shards, and once the game starts, you will know just how valuable these shards are." Divine explained.
"Hmm, there are so many of them here. How much do you think it's worth?" Vritra looked over the mountain and could tell that there were roughly five hundred thousand shards.
"This is the lifetime savings of a demi god who had played five games, and before leaving he had taken the biggest loan from the World Bank." Divine answered.
"Does that mean he was at level 5? And what is it about the loan?" Vritra asked, throwing back the shard onto the mountain.
After a pause, Divine replied, "He took the biggest loan since if he becomes a god, the debt will be settled without paying back anything.
The time limit was quite long, so he was sure that he could find those things on the Zoratian planet and become one of the gods. Unfortunately, he failed."
Then he added, "So this is a lot of money, like really a lot."
"Nice, I am rich again!" Vritra exclaimed and safely teleported all the shards into his inventory. They might not be useful for now, but surely would be later on.
Then he moved towards the third barrier. Using Pinky as the key, the barrier disappeared, and only an emblem with strange patterns was present inside.
"What is this now? Is this some protection token or something?" Vritra questioned as he picked up the emblem. It was rather heavy for its size.
"Something like that, but it is more of a status symbol. Keep it safe, this emblem will be very helpful after the game starts." Divine spoke.
Vritra nodded. So this would give him more privilege and authority, a good thing indeed.
He threw it into his inventory but then shifted it to the divine realm so no one could sense its presence and locate him.
"This is turning out better than I expected." Vritra rubbed his hands together and moved towards the fourth barrier after picking up Pinky.
He unlocked the fourth barrier, and tiny pieces of cubes were revealed there. The quantity was in the hundreds of thousands, and they certainly weren't just glyphs.
"What about this?" Vritra tried using appraisal on them but didn't really get any information.
"These are even more precious than all that money. They could be said to be a part of the first Mythic Halo and could be used in the creation of all sorts of things." Divine answered.
"I see, they won't be of much use to me, but... I am sure they would be helpful for Tess." Vritra mumbled, then questioned, "It wouldn't be a problem to bring my wives out, right?"
"Yeah, they can't sense anything happening here, so you are fine." Came the reply.
Vritra scanned the divine realm and saw the group of women who were standing together with worry on their faces.
Yasmine was already awake and out of the bubble. It was very sturdy, but Tess was able to bring her out without breaking it.
Except for Yennefer, all his wives were perfectly fine.
Vritra directly teleported all of them into the locker room. The six women were surprised as they looked around in confusion.
"Master, where are we?" Maeve muttered, but then asked hurriedly, "Are you okay?"
"Honey..." vanessa tightly embraced Vritra then looked over him, sighing in relief upon finding no injuries in his body.
"Yeah, I am perfectly fine, and we are inside the locker room of the World Bank." Vritra started explaining everything to them.
"Hubby, I ended up creating trouble for you..." Yasmine hugged Vritra. She could only imagine how much he must have suffered against that demi god.
"Wifey, it's not your fault. Also, there is more you need to know..." Then he told Yasmine about her past life relation with the Divine.
"W What? He was my brother? Is that why those demons wanted to kill me so badly? And my parents had to sacrifice themselves?"
Yasmine had always felt that those attacks on the dragon kingdom and her parents' deaths were somehow related to her, but now she knew it was all because of her.

Vritra hugged her tighter, caressing her head gently as he spoke in a soothing tone, "Don't blame yourself. It's all because of that bastard Divine. You are a victim in this too, and from now on everything will be better."
After consoling Yasmine for a few minutes, the two separated. Vritra looked at Teresa and spoke, "Tess, take all these. I think they would be of use to you."
Teresa finally glanced over the mountain of tiny cubes and a surprised expression appeared over her face. It seemed she really recognized them.
"Is it really fine?" She really wanted to take those cubes but hesitated.
"Yeah, it's perfectly fine. They are yours. Create whatever you want." Vritra spoke.
Without wasting any time, Teresa put them all into her inventory, eager to try creating various things from them.
Then, using Pinky, Vritra unlocked the next barrier and found a big mountain of weapons and armor.
There were all sorts of equipment, most of them being at the lord rank.
Any of these weapons would be treated as rare treasures back on the Zoratian planet, but here was a heap of it all.
There were some even higher level ones, but for now Vritra just stored them in his inventory.
He planned to give a few to his wives and let Goop devour the rest.
Then he moved to the next barrier. After unlocking it, two objects appeared before Vritra.

They could be said to be a part of the first Mythic Halo and could be used in the creation of all sorts of things." Divine answered.
"I see, they won't be of much use to me, but...
I am sure they would be helpful for Tess." Vritra mumbled, then questioned, "It wouldn't be a problem to bring my wives out, right?"
"Yeah, they can't sense anything happening here, so you are fine." Came the reply.
Vritra scanned the divine realm and saw the group of women who were standing together with worry on their faces.
Yasmine was already awake and out of the bubble.
It was very sturdy, but Tess was able to bring her out without breaking it.
Except for Yennefer, all his wives were perfectly fine.
Vritra directly teleported all of them into the locker room.
The six women were surprised as they looked around in confusion.
"Master, where are we?" Maeve muttered, but then asked hurriedly, "Are you okay?"
"Honey..." vanessa tightly embraced Vritra then looked over him, sighing in relief upon finding no injuries in his body.
"Yeah, I am perfectly fine, and we are inside the locker room of the World Bank." Vritra started explaining everything to them.
"Hubby, I ended up creating trouble for you..." Yasmine hugged Vritra.
She could only imagine how much he must have suffered against that demi god.
"Wifey, it's not your fault.
Also, there is more you need to know..." Then he told Yasmine about her past life relation with the Divine.
"W What?
He was my brother?
Is that why those demons wanted to kill me so badly?
And my parents had to sacrifice themselves?"
Yasmine had always felt that those attacks on the dragon kingdom and her parents' deaths were somehow related to her, but now she knew it was all because of her.
Vritra hugged her tighter, caressing her head gently as he spoke in a soothing tone, "Don't blame yourself.
It's all because of that bastard Divine.
You are a victim in this too, and from now on everything will be better."
After consoling Yasmine for a few minutes, the two separated.
Vritra looked at Teresa and spoke, "Tess, take all these.
I think they would be of use to you."
Teresa finally glanced over the mountain of tiny cubes and a surprised expression appeared over her face.
It seemed she really recognized them.
"Is it really fine?" She really wanted to take those cubes but hesitated.
"Yeah, it's perfectly fine.
They are yours.
Create whatever you want." Vritra spoke.
Without wasting any time, Teresa put them all into her inventory, eager to try creating various things from them.
Then, using Pinky, Vritra unlocked the next barrier and found a big mountain of weapons and armor.
There were all sorts of equipment, most of them being at the lord rank.
Any of these weapons would be treated as rare treasures back on the Zoratian planet, but here was a heap of it all.
There were some even higher level ones, but for now Vritra just stored them in his inventory.
He planned to give a few to his wives and let Goop devour the rest.
Then he moved to the next barrier.
After unlocking it, two objects appeared before Vritra.

chapters.title: Chapter 571 Fishing?
paragraphs: Vritra removed the next barrier and two objects appeared before him. One was a glass bottle that was filled with some dark red fluid.
While the other object was a piece of horn.
Vritra picked up the two objects in his hands and had a feeling that he had seen something similar before.
Before he could ask this time, Divine spoke:

"These are the bloodline and physique of a god. Again, Zihong must have used all sorts of methods to obtain that. It is extremely precious but completely useless for you, as you are already a demi god."
'I guess my wives could use it, but whom would it suit the most? Diana?' Vritra glanced at the goddess.

"No, she already possesses that Tomb of the Gods. That alone is enough to bring her to the demi god level, so it would be wasted on her. Let Maeve consume it, it will greatly benefit her." Divine spoke, interrupting Vritra's thoughts.
Vritra's gaze then turned to the beautiful and seductive demoness, but before handing them to her, he asked, 'Swear that there is nothing wrong with these things and that it won't harm her.'

"You don't trust me, do you? Sigh. Yes, it is perfectly fine, I swear over my life." Divine said with a shake of his head, but he couldn't really expect Vritra to trust him blindly after all that had happened.
After pondering for a few moments, he turned to Maeve and spoke, "Foxie, take these, and after we return, use them to evolve."
"Thank you, Master~" The demoness hurried close to him and gave a gentle peck over his lips, then stored them away.
She wanted to get pampered by her master, but she had to wait until things had calmed down.
Vritra patted her head before turning to the other barrier. Zihong really had gathered a lot of stuff.
Teresa looked at the scene and remembered her first kiss. She wondered if all his wives really said thanks and sorry with kisses.
Then she regretted not doing it before. Vritra had given her those amazing creation cubes, but in her excitement, she forgot to say thanks.
Her mood turned a bit sour. She was already quite late, and with so many flaws, she was also so clueless.
She was also afraid that if Vritra could not fall for her, he would break the marriage and leave her.
So she decided to work harder and learn more from her elder sister, Yasmine.
Unaware of the thoughts of his wives, Vritra placed Pinky at the next pillar as the barrier disappeared.
Zihong had placed his most precious possessions in this bank. Each of them was the best of the best treasures.
The next object to appear was...
Somewhere far away in the universe, inside a big spacious room.
A chest kept hidden in a separate space suddenly started buzzing. Inside it was only the corpse of a shrivelled up lizard.
But suddenly, it seemed as if air had been pumped inside it as the small corpse started to bulge. Right before the explosion, it stopped.
Then the lizard crawled out of the chest and moved out of the hidden space, appearing in the large empty room.
It moved around, climbing onto the wall and bringing out various hidden things.
While continuing, the bug started cursing in a rather strange tone, "FUCK, FUCK, I am going to kill that puny bug. That weakling dared to destroy my body!!"
It was none other than Drino, or rather a part of his consciousness that he had hidden as a backup before.
This was really the last of him. If Vritra had somehow discovered this too, then he would have really died.
Thankfully, he was still just a newbie demi god.
'But then, why didn't the Divine try to stop me or warn him?' Drino wondered, but whatever the reason, he was just happy to be alive.
He swore to kill Vritra in a single strike in their next encounter. He wouldn't give that weak demi god a chance.
But now, his soul and body had been completely destroyed. Drino felt worse knowing that Vritra could somehow use them to strengthen himself.
He could still get his body and soul back, or rather create them anew, but that would take quite a lot of time and enormous resources.
Reaching the same level again, almost all his resources would be gone.
Still, there was hope, but he couldn't let his enemies know about this or they would attack him at his weakest.
And he had successfully failed the mission of the god. He would no longer be receiving any favours.
After arranging everything, the lizard entered a large metallic cylinder that was filled with some fluid.
It would take time, but he would get his chance to hunt Vritra down again, complete the mission, and regain his lost pride.
"Oh!" Vritra exclaimed as he picked up the next object, which was a round, heavy ball.
He could feel that it was filled with quite a large amount of energy, a lot more than the core of a demi god.
Again, Divine came to explain, "This is the planetary core, a core that the participants obtain after winning the trials, and it could help them reach the level of a demi god."
Vritra was again surprised, then he looked over his wives.
Diana already had the Tomb of the Gods. Maeve had just gotten that physique and bloodline. Vanessa had that cloth which could also increase her strength to that level.
Now Fiona, Teresa, Yasmine, and Yennefer remained, who still had no way of reaching the demi god level. He wondered who to give this core to...
'Wait, how many people can use it?' Vritra questioned. Surely not only a single person becomes a demi god from a team, right?
"Five," Divine replied, and it actually solved a big problem.
With this thing, none of his women would actually have any problems leveling up.
They just needed to absorb it, and they could reach the level of a demi god.
"Well, since it's stolen goods, you have to be careful. Don't let the gods notice their actual levels. And the process won't be as fast." Divine warned.
After all, only after the trial could they obtain a similar core.
And using that, they would then reach the demi god level.
Vritra turned and explained it to his wives. He took out the coffin that Yasmine had given him.
Taking a deep breath, he checked and found that this energy could actually be used to create a new body for Yennefer.
Finally, he had found a way!!
Happily, he put away the orb and the coffin. Soon, everyone in his family would be able to reach the demi god level.
But the process would be quite long. It might take them a few years, even with all these treasures.
Though Vritra could reduce the time somewhat, they needed to finish before the trial started.
"Husband, I can create rings that would perfectly hide our strength levels, even from the eyes of the gods." Teresa spoke, her voice as sweet as ever.
She might not have been confident before, but with those cubes, she could definitely pull this off.
"Alright, Tess. You can try it after we return." It seemed they would be spending some peaceful time after returning to the Zoratian planet.
Before the trial started, they were free to do as they wished after all.
And Vritra wanted nothing more than to just live peacefully with his wives while they continued to grow.
As long as no one came to break their peace, everything should be fine, especially since no one on that planet was strong enough.
Vritra then turned his gaze towards the final barrier. He picked up Pinky and then placed her over the next pillar, all the while wondering what could be hidden there.
Slowly, the barrier disappeared and the final object was revealed.
And it was a fishing rod?!!
"What the what? What is this now?" Vritra picked up the wooden fishing stick, which seemed as mundane as the word allowed.
"Well, this is my gift to you. Believe me, it was really hard to take this thing out. If the higher beings knew, they would rush over to take it." Divine said proudly.
Vritra frowned. He couldn't sense anything from it. He even tried injecting mana, but there was no response.
'Are you joking with me right now?' Vritra took a deep breath and waited for the explanation.
Divine might be a pig, bastard, asshole, but at least his skills and treasures were genuine.
"Ouch, so that's what you think of me. Sigh, and here I went through so much trouble just for you, since I thought you loved stealing." Divine spoke in disappointment.
'Huh?' Vritra's frown deepened. He didn't say or think anything, so how did Divine find out?
'Anyway, what do you mean by stealing? Tell me more about this!' Vritra was suddenly more interested as he looked over the ordinary fishing rod.
"Our time here is over. Keep it away for now. I will explain everything later. First, we need to escape. It shouldn't be too difficult... probably." Divine said, then went completely silent.
Vritra tried calling, but there was no response.
'Sigh, whatever. I got quite a lot of things from this place.' Vritra recalled everything he had obtained.
A wonderful house which possessed over five thousand guards, at least at the lord rank. Then a lot of money. An emblem which would make Vritra appear like a big shot in the future.
The creation cubes which would be of help to Tess. The bloodline and physique of a god which would be used by Maeve. Then the planetary core which would bring all his wives to the demi god level.
And finally, a strange fishing rod.
And now, it was time to leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 572 TAK
paragraphs: Vritra first sent all his wives back to the divine realm, along with the fishing rod. He decided to check it out later on.
He needed to properly go over all his loot later, but for now it was time to make their exit from the safest bank.
How difficult could it be?
As long as he stayed silent, everything should be fine.
KNOCK KNOCK
"Sir, are you not done yet? I am afraid that we are reaching our time limit." The gnome reminded from outside.
Vritra was ready to leave, but one last time he scanned the whole locker, just to make sure he wasn't leaving anything behind.
He had already stored Pinky and Zengis back.
Just then his gaze landed on a ball lying in the corner. There were no barriers around it, so Vritra hadn't noticed it before.
Walking up to it, he picked up the ball, which was just like a tennis ball. It was light and seemed bouncy.
"Is there anything special about this too?" Vritra asked, instinctively bouncing it off the floor before catching it.
TAK
One...
"Yeah, it is a bomb." Divine replied. Vritra paused, holding the ball carefully, then asked,
"How powerful is it?"
"Powerful enough to kill a bunch of lords and even greatly injure a demi god at the initial levels. It is rather powerful.
Maybe Zihong left it here to harm anyone who tries to steal his treasures." Divine answered.
"I see. Well, I guess it can come in handy sometime." He decided to just throw it in his inventory, but the ball wouldn't go inside.
Frowning, he tried throwing it into the dimensional book, but failed again, and then into the divine realm, but nothing worked.
"What's going on?" Vritra scratched his head as he bounced it against the floor again.
TAK
Two...
"Of course it can't be stored anywhere, even inside a barrier. That's why it was lying in a corner. Zihong had made a setup, but you possessed the key, so you didn't trigger the bomb." Divine spoke.
"Hmm, well I don't want to leave such a powerful bomb here. Let's take it along." Vritra mumbled. He could use it later if someone powerful attacked him, or just try it on the Golden Moon.
If one didn't know about it, they would just assume it was an ordinary ball, so he doubted the gnome or other guards would recognize it.
While holding the ball, he started walking towards the door, which started to open on its own.
"Ah, you are done. I was starting to worry that something happened to you inside and was about to charge in." The gnome muttered cheekily while trying to peek into the room.
But everything was covered by barriers, so he couldn't really see anything.
Vritra: "..."
TAK
Three...
The sound of the ball hitting the floor rang out lightly, and as usual, the gnome continued talking to himself.
He faintly glanced at the ball and then ignored it. Gesturing ahead, he spoke, "Sir Zihong, please follow. I will take you out. If you have instructions, then do tell me."
Vritra just started walking slowly, stopping before the corridors.
TAK
Four...
It had been so long since he had done that. It felt quite relaxing. Vritra let his mind wander while playing with the ball.
The gnome observed him and then made one of the platforms stop. They climbed on top of that, and it started moving.
TAK
Five...
"By the way, sir, did you deposit something in there? Sigh, I know you won't answer anyway. Now that the new round of trials is about to begin, a lot of people have been visiting this bank."
The chatterbox started speaking and just wouldn't stop.
TAK
Six...
'I wonder how much time has passed back on the Zoratian planet...' Vritra thought. After all, he had travelled very, very far away with Drino and had passed through all sorts of realms.
Thankfully, all his wives were with him, so he didn't need to worry at all.
TAK
Seven...

'Now I just need to wait for Yenni to come out of that pill piece. The soul potions are ready, and even the energy source is ready. I can directly help her strengthen her soul and create a new body.' Vritra thought, and this new body would be even stronger and better than the previous one, he decided.
TAK
Eight...
The ride over the platform was even longer than when they were going up. The traffic really seemed high in the bank.
"Demi God Zihong, when will you be participating in the sixth game?" the gnome asked, but again received no reply.
'I wonder how many games are there, and how does one become a god? What is even the maximum level for a demi god?' Vritra thought, but expected no answer from Divine.
TAK
Nine...
But Divine actually replied this time, though for some reason his voice sounded strained, as if he was holding back from laughing.
"There are a total of nine games, so nine levels in total. After that, in the tenth round, the winners would have to fight the gods themselves.
If they could win, then they would replace the god they defeated, and that god would go into eternal slumber inside the Tomb of Gods. After all, killing gods is nearly impossible." Divine explained.

'I see.' Vritra nodded, before asking, 'But I am already on level 1, so after winning the first game will my level be 2? But then after winning nine games, wouldn't my level be 10, though you said 9 is max?'
TAK
Ten...
"Well, you are different. After clearing the trial, you could only reach level 0 of demi god and become a proper demi god after winning the first game." Divine said.
Vritra nodded. He finally understood it, then he glanced at the ball and asked, 'But how do I activate this bomb? Do I need to insert my mana or blood to detonate it?'
He again threw the ball towards the ground, ignoring the gnome's chatter.
"No, pfft, not that. You just need to hit it hard or gently eleven times, and it will explode within moments."
Divine's words made Vritra freeze. How many times exactly had the ball hit the floor so far?
He counted and...
TAK
"FUCK!!" His eyes widened in shock as Vritra cursed Divine in his mind. That bastard knew it from the start.
On the other hand, the gnome was startled. After all, this demi god had been silent from the start, and now that he spoke, he cursed?
"S- Sir, is something the matter? Did my overbearing questions annoy you? I- I apologize to you sincerely. I will keep my mouth shut from now on-"
Vritra just ignored the gnome. The moment the ball hit the ground the eleventh time, it started to glow.
It was too late to even use the Null ability. To reverse time slightly would be ineffective against this bomb.
Vritra thought quickly, but there really wasn't anything he could do.
He couldn't even throw the bomb into his dimensional book, so he kicked the gnome away and jumped to the other side.
The ball buzzed for a few moments, and then a terrifying explosion shook the whole bank as destructive energy started to spread all over.
The platforms were instantly turned to dust, the scale of destruction quickly turning terrifying.
Thanks for reading...

Sigh, I know you won't answer anyway.
Now that the new round of trials is about to begin, a lot of people have been visiting this bank."
The chatterbox started speaking and just wouldn't stop.
TAK
Six...
'I wonder how much time has passed back on the Zoratian planet...' Vritra thought.
After all, he had travelled very, very far away with Drino and had passed through all sorts of realms.
Thankfully, all his wives were with him, so he didn't need to worry at all.
TAK
Seven...
'Now I just need to wait for Yenni to come out of that pill piece.
The soul potions are ready, and even the energy source is ready.
I can directly help her strengthen her soul and create a new body.' Vritra thought, and this new body would be even stronger and better than the previous one, he decided.
TAK
Eight...
The ride over the platform was even longer than when they were going up.
The traffic really seemed high in the bank.
"Demi God Zihong, when will you be participating in the sixth game?" the gnome asked, but again received no reply.
'I wonder how many games are there, and how does one become a god?
What is even the maximum level for a demi god?' Vritra thought, but expected no answer from Divine.
TAK
Nine...
But Divine actually replied this time, though for some reason his voice sounded strained, as if he was holding back from laughing.
"There are a total of nine games, so nine levels in total.
After that, in the tenth round, the winners would have to fight the gods themselves.
If they could win, then they would replace the god they defeated, and that god would go into eternal slumber inside the Tomb of Gods.
After all, killing gods is nearly impossible." Divine explained.
'I see.' Vritra nodded, before asking, 'But I am already on level 1, so after winning the first game will my level be 2?
But then after winning nine games, wouldn't my level be 10, though you said 9 is max?'
TAK
Ten...
"Well, you are different.
After clearing the trial, you could only reach level 0 of demi god and become a proper demi god after winning the first game." Divine said.
Vritra nodded.
He finally understood it, then he glanced at the ball and asked, 'But how do I activate this bomb?
Do I need to insert my mana or blood to detonate it?'
He again threw the ball towards the ground, ignoring the gnome's chatter.
"No, pfft, not that.
You just need to hit it hard or gently eleven times, and it will explode within moments."
Divine's words made Vritra freeze.
How many times exactly had the ball hit the floor so far?
He counted and...
TAK
"FUCK!!" His eyes widened in shock as Vritra cursed Divine in his mind.
That bastard knew it from the start.
On the other hand, the gnome was startled.
After all, this demi god had been silent from the start, and now that he spoke, he cursed?
"S- Sir, is something the matter?
Did my overbearing questions annoy you?
I- I apologize to you sincerely.
I will keep my mouth shut from now on-"
Vritra just ignored the gnome.
The moment the ball hit the ground the eleventh time, it started to glow.
It was too late to even use the Null ability.
To reverse time slightly would be ineffective against this bomb.
Vritra thought quickly, but there really wasn't anything he could do.
He couldn't even throw the bomb into his dimensional book, so he kicked the gnome away and jumped to the other side.
The ball buzzed for a few moments, and then a terrifying explosion shook the whole bank as destructive energy started to spread all over.
The platforms were instantly turned to dust, the scale of destruction quickly turning terrifying.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 573 Snow
paragraphs: All of a sudden, the world bank trembled, destruction flooding all over the place as most of the platforms got destroyed in an instant.
The lockers weren't harmed at all even by such a powerful explosion, hundreds of figures suddenly flashed there and started to control the violent energy.
Vritra just paused for a moment, then he turned and flew out, cursing out Divine.
'How do I even get out of here?' he cursed as he moved into the disappearing state.
"Do you see that black door which is rather small on your right?" Divine spoke.
"Yes, I will go there immediately." Vritra changed his direction hurriedly and flew towards the door.
He reached it in an instant and pulled the door a bit.
"That is the place you should avoid at all cost, the strongest guards reside there so don't even think of going there, you will die before you know it."
His words suddenly made Vritra halt as he shut the door back and moved away.
"You piece of shit, just tell me which direction I have to go!!" Vritra really wanted to smash his face into burning coal, Divine was still playing around.
"Sigh, move upwards, there you will see a red door, inside is a portal which will lead you back."
Divine said seriously this time and added: "Just remember to destroy the portal after using it so they can't use it to follow you, use your wraiths for that task."
Vritra calmed his mind, while the others were busy dealing with the destruction he flew upwards at full speed.
Before long, the red door appeared before his eyes, such a big commotion had alerted everyone.
Only the strongest guards remained hidden while all others started to gather.
This was just an accident so maybe even if Vritra was caught, they might just give him a light penalty and let him off after he pays some money?
This would be better than becoming the enemy of the world bank.
But then again, they would surely capture Vritra and launch an investigation to see if it really was just an accident.
And then things would get ugly, they would definitely find that he isn't the real Zihong.
So running away was his only choice now.
He kicked open the red door and saw a few guards wearing different armors.
However, just at that moment, Vritra had changed Goop's appearance to look like an armor and his own face was already altered.
His expression changed from panic to anger as he shouted:
"What the hell are you doing here?!! A big criminal has broken into the bank, go help in dealing with the bomb and then catch him. He was last seen near the entrance."
The best ability of a con man is his confidence, the tone was so authoritative that the other person instinctively starts to follow your orders.
And the same happened here, at first they looked at him strangely but then they hurriedly nodded and flew out.
Vritra scanned the area and flew inside, changing back to his real appearance. And indeed, there was a portal inside which was off right now.
He brought Yasmine out and asked her to operate the portal and bring them back to the Zoratian planet while he stood close to the door.
The dragoness quickly understood her task and got to work, but as she tried to operate it, she noticed a few problems.
"Hubby, this thing is broken and has no power." Yasmine spoke hurriedly, she couldn't fix it and couldn't use her mana to make it work.
Vritra's frown deepened, how could the portal in the world bank be broken? Was it a trap?
There was no time.
He brought Teresa out of the divine realm and asked: "Tess, can you fix this?"
Teresa glanced at the portal for a moment and nodded: "Yes husband, just give me a few moments."
Without wasting any time, she got to work, while Vritra questioned: 'Divine, stop playing around and get serious, what should I do about the energy source?'
It didn't take long before the guards had resolved the storm of destructive energy, and now they started to hunt the culprit.
The gnome who was with Vritra told everything to his superiors and soon, a search began.
"Alright alright, just use one of the shards you got from the locker room. That will be enough to run this portal."
Divine answered, it was almost as if he knew everything that was going to happen.
"Husband, I am finished." Just after a few seconds, Teresa spoke, she seemed happy to be of help to Vritra.
Her abilities were truly miraculous.
"Here, wifey, use this." Vritra threw one of the shards towards Yasmine, but just then he heard something from outside.
"Let's check the portal room, he might have gone there to escape." One of the guards shouted, his voice full of anger.
So many platforms and corridors were destroyed, now they would have to do extra work.
"But the portal is broken, and why would Demi God Zihong even attack this place? There must be some misunderstanding or some accident?" It was the gnome's voice.
But he didn't have much authority here.
"Check every corner of this place, whoever it was will have to undergo a proper investigation." Another guard, who seemed quite strong and bulky, ordered as the guards spread in all directions.
"Tess, make it so that it will stop working after we leave and becomes completely useless. And wifey, how long will it take?" Vritra watched as the guards started to spread in all directions.
Teresa nodded, doing this was even easier after all, breaking things is always way easier than creating them.
"I am almost done, just connecting to Zoratian planet, and... done, let's go hubby!!" Yasmine hurriedly spoke.
Vritra sent Yasmine to the divine realm and rushed towards the portal, then as soon as Teresa was done, he took her hand and flew into the portal.
Just as the two had disappeared, the portal buzzed and broke down, appearing as if it had not even been touched.
Then dozens of guards rushed there and found that there was no one and nothing had changed.
"He isn't here, keep searching and release a bounty for him."
The news of such a big event happening in the world bank for the first time ever spread far and wide quickly.
The gods and higher beings, all of them heard about it.
And Vritra's face, or rather his fake face, became famous. After all, he always used a fake appearance when he sensed danger.
The world bank was full of danger from the moment he arrived there, so just before the moment when he met the gnome, Vritra had changed himself just a little.
Despite all efforts, no one in the world bank could find any traces of Vritra or any information about him.
The portal situated in the Star Family suddenly lit up, then it buzzed and two figures flew out of it.
For some reason, there were no guards guarding the portal right now.
Vritra and Teresa flew out of the portal and finally relaxed upon seeing the familiar hall.
They were back.
"Why does it feel unusually cold?" Vritra looked around and saw that everything was actually covered by snow.
Both of them were baffled by the drastic changes they least expected to happen.

chapters.title: Chapter 574 Bad news
paragraphs: Teresa and Vritra stood in the underground hall of the Star family, and somehow the surroundings were rather chilly.
Snow had covered the floor even though this place was completely sealed off.
First, Vritra opened the gate of the divine realm as all his wives came out and were equally shocked.
"During the whole time I have stayed on this continent, I have never once seen such cold weather." Vanessa mumbled.
"Yes, this doesn't seem normal. What could have happened after we left?" Maeve, as the owner of the world information centre, possessed more information.
"Let's go out and check, I wonder how long we have been away for..." Vritra spoke, this level of cold was not a problem for them.
The group walked towards the exit, Vritra just passed through the door along with his wives because of the dimensional book.
After walking up, they finally saw the state of the continent.
A thick layer of snow covered everything, the air was literally freezing.
Snow was falling, Vritra gazed towards the sky in surprise, along with the snow something else seemed to be falling as well.
Stretching his hand, he caught something and looked closely.
"Spores?"
"Yeah, and these spores are everywhere." Yasmine too observed them, tiny spores filled the air, looking quite similar to snow.
"Why is there no one around though? This is one of the top families, how could this place feel so vacant?" Fiona spoke, everyone seemed to be locked up in their rooms.
"Let's first check how much time has passed since we left." Diana took out a communication glyph and contacted someone, then with a slightly surprised expression she spoke:
"It's almost been six months..."
Thankfully, the time gap wasn't as drastic as Vritra imagined, then how could this place have changed so far?
Beside him, Teresa wasn't wearing her veil right now, but her appearance was still hidden because of misty essence.
But all of Vritra's women except Yennefer, of course, had already seen her true appearance, and weren't surprised that she was said to be the most beautiful woman to exist.
COUGH COUGH
Just then, Maeve coughed, her eyes narrowing in confusion.
"Foxie, are you okay?" Vritra looked at her and noticed that the tiny spores might be harmful.
With a snap, he created barriers around all of them, keeping the spores away.
"Yeah, I suddenly felt a faint burning sensation in my throat." Maeve mumbled, but the spores weren't dangerous enough to kill anyone in a short time.
"Let's go to Charm City and see what has happened in the time we were away." Vanessa suggested, and so the group flew towards the City of Charms.
The whole continent was covered by a thick layer of snow, barely anyone could be seen outside right now.
Even the crops wouldn't grow in such weather and animals' survival would be difficult, it was like an apocalypse had descended.
People with higher levels were still fine, but normal people were having it the hardest.
While looking over the place, they soon arrived at the City of Charms and didn't see any guards standing outside.
It was just impossible to stay out in such weather for too long, even generals might get affected.
The defence formation and other things were still working perfectly fine, but they passed through easily.
Vanessa first arrived in the palace hall but found it completely empty, then decided to meet Layla in her house.
They quickly arrived outside her house.
KNOCK KNOCK
Vanessa knocked and waited, soon a voice sounded from inside: "Who is it?"
"It is me." Vanessa replied, her aura was hidden so Layla was unable to sense her.
"Oh Empress, you are back!!" In the next moment, the door was pulled open, as Layla appeared before them.
She was wearing several layers of winter clothes, but had an excited smile on her face.
"Ah, you all are here, please come inside." Layla stepped aside and gestured to the group.
Vritra nodded towards her, they knew each other from before.
Soon, Vritra and six of his women were seated inside with Layla, drinking warm water.
"Empress, where have you been all this time? W- We thought the Golden Moon had done something to you, it's almost been six months!"
Layla asked, handling the kingdom was quite difficult without her.
"I was trapped somewhere and was only able to come out now. Anyway, tell me, what has changed in these six months?" Vanessa asked, setting the glass down.
"There is a lot, I don't know where to start..." she mumbled and sighed, before beginning with her explanation:
"Well, the Grant and Trant families are gone, so now there are only three powerful families. Golden Moon has taken charge of the entire continent in the absence of the human empress, Diana Arclis.
The Twilight have been wreaking havoc, turning the bad condition into worse. As for this winter, no one really knows about it, it suddenly started to snow one day and hasn't stopped for months now."
After speaking everything in a single line, she paused and added: "I am sure you have noticed these spores too, these are harmful but we still don't know how they will affect everything.

But things have only gone worse in this time, there have been various attacks from the demon race recently, and another mysterious group has been attacking our kingdom, the Phoenix Kingdom, and the humans."
Diana, Fiona, and the others listened to everything silently, their expressions turning grim.
The situation was worse than they expected, and there were things that Layla wasn't even aware of since the connection to the outside world had been cut off for some time now.
Everyone was busy protecting themselves.
Diana tapped over the table with a frown on her face, then spoke: "I will first go and take charge of the kingdom back."

"Yeah, well, it is time we deal with the Golden Moon, they have enjoyed peace for quite long already. Now it's time for payback." Vritra added, they had attacked him for absolutely no reason, he had done no wrong.
Now that they had gotten so much power and control, it would be even more fun to break them.
"Okay, let's first deal with the Golden Moon, then we will solve one problem at a time." Vanessa said, as she thought nothing could ever be peaceful when Vritra was there.
'I wonder if it is because of the approaching trials or maybe someone is responsible for this change? The demons? Twilight?' Vritra pondered, but there were no answers.
Such cold weather and the spores certainly weren't normal.
But before heading to the Golden Moon, they decided to go and check on their respective kingdoms.
Vritra too wanted to check the Yate family and tell them he was alive.
"Oh right, let's check out our new house first, it can also open direct portals for us." Vritra said as he took out the toy house.
"But where are we going to put it?" Fiona asked.
"Let's make it float, Master, our majestic house will be flying above the continent!!" Maeve said, just imagining it made her feel great.
"Alright, let's check it out then." Vritra and all his women flew out, Layla stayed behind but was curious to see their new house.
The house itself had the ability to fly and it could keep floating without the need for any energy source.
Vritra let go of the house and flew back as it began to grow rapidly.

chapters.title: Chapter 575 Sacrificial Lamb
paragraphs: The house of darkness was just too damn big, with countless rooms and decorated with expensive jewels.
It was a ready to move in house, everything looked so perfect that there was no need to change anything.
For now, Vritra kept its size relatively small, but it still looked enormous and lavish, with black flames burning all over the walls.
And thousands of armoured knights guarding the house.
As they explored it, finding all sorts of defences and attack mechanisms, there really was a lot to see.
His wives were also going to level up here, and if he used Null then the time would be greatly shortened.
He gave the energy core to Yasmine for now, he would have to wait until Yennefer's soul was out of the pill.
Then they used the doors in their respective rooms to head to different kingdoms.
This time even Fiona had to go and check on the Phoenix Kingdom, while Yasmine decided to go along with Vritra and Teresa.
She barely cared for the dragons, and now even that was gone after the last incidents, they really betrayed her.
Before and now again.
She was sure even without her they could survive, and she just wanted to spend more time with her husband.

"Teresa, where have you been all this time? This is why I insisted for you to stay in your room, the outside world is far too dangerous for you." Sir Giant spoke, but he sounded rather meek.
He was still afraid of Vritra.
"Sister, we were all so worried, are you alright? Tell me if he is forcing you to stay away from us, we are your real family, please come with us." Shen spoke, while hiding behind his father.
Then he hit his wife's shoulder, gesturing her to act her part.
"My dear sister in law, sob, the days haven't been the same without you, only I know how I survived all this time. Sob, you have to come back to your family..."
Sakshi shed crocodile tears, but the tears froze even before they could fall off her cheeks, making her shiver and grimace.

Vritra rolled his eyes and questioned: "Are you just here for that or do you have any other motive? And if you try to emotionally blackmail my wife again, you three won't be leaving this place alive."
"Yes, don't you dare try to blackmail her!!" Gunter said, ready to join the fight.
Just then...
"PITIFULLL ONEEEEEEEEEEE!! I AM BACCCKKKKKK~"

sentences.text: Teresa worked on the several rings, with the creation cubes she could try all sorts of things and there were so many of them that she wouldn't run out of them any time soon.
Initially, she wanted to do it right there with Vritra around, she wanted him to see her working.
But for some reason, Yasmine wanted some alone time with him.
Teresa did ask the reason, and Yasmine just said they would be making a baby.
And just thinking about what her husband and sister might be doing, Teresa's head exploded and imaginary smoke came out of her head.
She knew very little of intimacy, at first she was a bit afraid, but after that kiss which felt incredibly good to the point she wanted more.
Teresa became curious about more, before leaving Yasmine teased her by saying:
"You can watch us if you want."
She could barely focus on her creation, as her mind kept drifting to thoughts of Vritra.
"Should I see it?
Just a peek?" she wondered and could no longer hold her curiosity back, so she took out a mirror and decided to take a peek.
"Ahhhh~ Hnnnn~ Hubby, fill me up~" suddenly Yasmine's loud voice rang out, which startled Teresa as she accidentally dropped the mirror.
And finally, she saw the intimate position her husband and sister were locked in, their naked forms pressed so tightly together.
Her face turned bright red, all thoughts disappearing from her mind.
On the other side, Yasmine smiled as she sensed the prying gaze.
While Vritra was shocked at first, wondering how anyone could peek through all those barriers, he then relaxed upon sensing that it was Teresa.
But then he was surprised that it was actually Teresa.
He was sure his wifey must be behind it, but Teresa should get mentally prepared for it, so he too acted as if he hadn't noticed anything.
For a few moments, Teresa stared at the mirror, then she picked it up and threw it back into her inventory.
Her cheeks were burning, and the sight was burned deep into her mind.
But along with embarrassment, it brought curiosity, she wondered if her sister was really feeling that good.
Shaking her head, she got to work, though her mind was still filled with strange thoughts.
Vritra and Yasmine went at it for a few more rounds, but they couldn't keep Teresa waiting for too long, so the two ended the session a bit early this time.
They took a bath together and dressed up in a new set of clothes.
Yasmine was quite satisfied, having her belly filled in so long.
Although the weather put most people in danger, everything being covered by a white layer made it look like a beautiful scenery.
Soon, Teresa returned, although she had finished some time ago.
"You are back, we were just waiting for you, how about you join us?" Yasmine spoke in a teasing tone, her lips curling up.
"Huh?
J- Join in what?" Teresa wore her veil this time, perfectly hiding her expressions, but she was clearly baffled.
"Of course, in having some food.
You must be hungry and tired after working, we were working on something too." Yasmine said with a chuckle, she was really enjoying teasing her innocent sister.
"Did you succeed?" Vritra shook his head, then stepping forward he took Teresa's hand and asked.
"Yeah, I have created these rings for us all." Teresa said and added: "I also created these bracelets for your friends, it will be helpful for them."
"Oh right, I almost forgot, I wonder what Shitless and that thief are doing now, it's been six months since we last met them." Vritra instantly took out a communication glyph and contacted them.
Before long, Onest replied, Vritra asked them to come meet them in the Yate realm.
"Alright boss, I will be there!" Onest replied, and the communication got cut off.
'Boss?
What was that?' Vritra's brows rose in surprise, just then he heard the sound of an alarm ringing.
"What's this now?"

"During emergency times in the top families, when they have sealed off their doors and refused to meet anyone, such alarms ring out when someone important has come and the monarch will have to make a choice whether to meet them or not." Teresa spoke, her voice as melodious as ever.
Vritra nodded and decided to go out and check, Shitless and Onest were coming anyway.
They decided to check out the rings later on and headed towards Gunter's room.
The monarch of the Yate family was already outside and discussing something with the guards.
"Oh Art, you should just stay in your room, it's too cold outside.
And why are you still wearing such thin clothes, I will ask the servants to bring you some warm clothes later on."
Gunter spoke as he saw the three walking towards him.
He asked no questions about Yasmine, Vritra could, after all, make his own decisions.
"It's alright, I do have warm clothes.
Anyway, who has come?" Vritra asked, he planned to go to the Golden Moon after this.
Gunter glanced at Teresa, then sighed and spoke: "It is some people from the Ford family, maybe they heard the news that Teresa is back."
Teresa held Vritra's hand tightly and firmly, there was no chance she would ever leave him.
"So what's the problem?
Let's see what they have to say." Vritra said and dismissed the guards, they decided to go towards the entrance of the realm.
"You go ahead, we will be there in a minute." Vritra said, as Gunter nodded and left first.
Then Vritra turned to his wives and took a warm coat out from his inventory, he had a lot of clothes stored away.
Although the winter wasn't affecting them, it was still better to wear them, just for the sake of it.
He put the long thick coats around Teresa first and then Yasmine, finally wearing one himself, the three headed towards the entrance.
Gunter was talking to three people currently, there was Sir Giant, Shen, and Sakshi.
As soon as they landed at the entrance, the three guests' gazes drifted to them.
"Teresa, where have you been all this time?
This is why I insisted for you to stay in your room, the outside world is far too dangerous for you." Sir Giant spoke, but he sounded rather meek.
He was still afraid of Vritra.
"Sister, we were all so worried, are you alright?
Tell me if he is forcing you to stay away from us, we are your real family, please come with us." Shen spoke, while hiding behind his father.
Then he hit his wife's shoulder, gesturing her to act her part.
"My dear sister in law, sob, the days haven't been the same without you, only I know how I survived all this time.
Sob, you have to come back to your family..."
Sakshi shed crocodile tears, but the tears froze even before they could fall off her cheeks, making her shiver and grimace.
Vritra rolled his eyes and questioned: "Are you just here for that or do you have any other motive?
And if you try to emotionally blackmail my wife again, you three won't be leaving this place alive."
"Yes, don't you dare try to blackmail her!!" Gunter said, ready to join the fight.
Just then...
"PITIFULLL ONEEEEEEEEEEE!!
I AM BACCCKKKKKK~"

chapters.title: Chapter 578 Oooooh!!
paragraphs: "PITIFULLL ONEEEEEEEEEEE!! I AM BACCCKKKKKK~" just then they all heard a loud distant scream.
All of them turned and saw a large bull running through the heavy snow, and two people were seated on top of it.
"Who are they-" Shen was just asking, but noticed that the bull was running too fast to stop in this snow.
And as Bullo got closer and tried to stop, the two passengers were thrown forward while the bull itself skidded forward.
Vritra made the mind of everyone muddy with misty essence and slowed down their thinking with Null as the three figures flew through the air.
'It seems Shitless has been practicing diligently in the last six months.' Vritra thought as he saw the monk's shining head.
And in the next moment...
BOOOM!!
Shitless' bald head struck right into Sakshi's face, as a loud crunching sound rang out and she was thrown dozens of meters away.
BANG
Sir Giant was hit by the bull, after his physique was stolen his body had weakened greatly, he too was thrown away.
Onest was already at the lord rank, he could have reacted in time but couldn't because of Vritra's interference.
And then...
CRACK
His head struck Shen's crotch directly as a strange sound rang out along with Shen's loud, painful, blood-curdling shout.
Ompphhh!!
Instantly he sprawled over the ground, his body spasming as he clutched his crotch and let out strange noises.
Shitless and Onest got to their feet and acted as if nothing had happened.
"Vritra, where have you disappeared off to?" Onest asked, brushing off his clothes.
"Just somewhere away from this planet, anyway how did your training go?" Vritra asked, looking at the two and noticing the changes.
Onest shivered when he remembered the location that map brought him to, and spoke: "Where did you get that map from? It helped but it was just too terrifying and painful, I have nightmares daily."
"Hehe. My head is harder than most metals now, it was painful at first but now it's fine." Shitless used a cloth to wipe the blood off his head.
"That's good, we will be going to the Golden Moon soon, this time we will be the ones to start the war." Vritra said, Gunter was busy helping Sir Giant and Shen up, so he didn't pay much attention.
"Alright, let's go, it is time that the world gets to know of me." Shitless agreed instantly and so did Onest.
"You damned baldy, ughhh m- my face, cough, my nose is b- broken, ahhh again..." Sakshi rose to her feet, her face a bloody mess.
"Oops. Sorry, didn't see you there. Anyway, get lost, we are having an important discussion."
Shitless said, if she was someone important Vritra would have stopped him earlier.
"Who are these unruly bastards?" Shen stood on his wobbly legs, the damage was too serious.
"Hahaha. Are they gone?" Onest just started laughing seeing Shen's expressions.
"Hey behave, my brother in law tends to lose his bearings easily pfft-" Vritra tried holding his laugh back.
Sir Giant and Shen were both really angry but with Vritra there, both of them were too afraid to speak anything.
"Shen, kill this bald bastard right now. Ughh look what he did to me, enough with this act, just drag her along, I don't think he can fight our entire family now!!"
Sakshi shouted angrily, while groaning in pain.
Vritra gestured for Shitless and Onest to stay silent and looked at Sir Giant: "Is there anything else you came here for? If not, you can leave."
Sir Giant was about to speak but then quieted down, he looked at Teresa with a pitiful look and spoke:
"Teresa, are you just going to let him humiliate your family like this? You don't care about us anymore? He is clearly wrong here, no?"
"My husband is always right and I have a new family now, so Grandpa you should leave and not bother us in the future." Teresa said firmly, as she held Vritra's hand.
She quite enjoyed his touches, a simple gesture of holding hands was enough to keep her happy.
"T- Teresa...?" Sir Giant stared in disbelief, was it really the same innocent girl? What has happened to her?
"You aren't leaving?" Vritra asked, his expression changing, making the father and son shiver.
"W- Wait, there is something else I wanted to tell you. The day after tomorrow, Tiny's grand wedding will be held in the Ford Realm, I came here to invite you all."
He took out an invitation card and passed it to Gunter.
Finally, he turned and flew away, Shen did the same but even his flight was unsteady.
Sakshi was left behind shouting, so Vritra asked Bullo to escort her out.
BANNGGGG!
In the next instant, Bullo roared and hit her with all its might, tossing her body several kilometres away.
"The wedding... it's been ages since I first heard about it, just what sort of wedding is it?" Vritra shook his head, how long has this wedding been stretched for?
At least now they had selected a groom, it seems.
Vritra turned to look at Teresa and asked: "Do you think the Golden Moon and all others will also be there?"
"Yes, with Grandpa's previous position, the entire Golden Moon and many other organizations will be there." Teresa answered.

"Oh that would be even more fun than just going there, the grand reveal in the grand wedding hehe." Yasmine chuckled, imagining everyone's expression once they get to know her husband's true identity.

"Alright then, change of plan. We will be meeting them the day after tomorrow." Vritra said, then turning to Shitless and Onest he added: "You two should just stay here for now, oh right, here are gifts for you two from Tess."
He took the bracelets from Teresa and passed them to Shitless and Onest, who wore the bracelets and were instantly surprised.
"Ohh I feel warm." Shitless said, and there were many other features in the bracelets, the two looked really happy with their gifts.
They thanked Teresa then left with Gunter, who would arrange rooms for them.
"Let's return to our house, since we got a free day. We can check out the reason behind this weather as well." Vritra said, and opened a portal directly into their nice and warm room.
"Haa this place really has the feeling of home." Yasmine fell back onto the bed, relaxing.
Vritra sent the message to all his wives and soon they were in the house.
"Foxie, there is still time so just go ahead with your evolution, I will alter the passage of time." Vritra said, since Maeve didn't want to miss out on the big fight.
"Okay Master, don't go without me." She said, then tip-toed close to him, after giving a soft kiss over his lips she went to another room to evolve peacefully.
After Maeve was in her room, Vritra covered it with several barriers and changed the passage of time.
"How about you all start absorbing the core, meanwhile I will go and check out the north." Vritra suggested.
Vanessa and Diana didn't need to absorb that core, while Maeve already has other treasure.
That left Yasmine, Teresa and Fiona, and all three were the type to demand more of his attention.
And there was no way Vritra could win against them, so the four of them headed out towards the North.

chapters.title: Chapter 579 Seed
paragraphs: Maeve began her evolution, while Vanessa and Diana also got to their training, their strength rapidly increasing.
While Fiona, Yasmine, and Teresa decided to absorb the core later on, for now they headed out of their house and towards the north.
The whole place was covered by snow and the air was filled with snow and spores, most people were locked in their houses.
"Husband, in such conditions, most people won't be able to survive, especially mundane people, so..." while flying, Teresa spoke.
"So you want to help them? How?" Vritra asked, he wouldn't mind that if it made her feel better.
"I would need the help of lots of lord ranks, I can handle the rest. But for food..."
Teresa fell silent, quite a lot of food must have gone to waste because of the sudden weather change and the spores.
It wouldn't be easy or plausible to keep feeding everyone, she could handle the heat and the spores but not that.

"That much is enough, I am sure they can take care of the rest themselves and we personally know all the empresses, so controlling them would be easy." Vritra said, the empresses are his wives so controlling everyone in the continent and around would be pretty easy.
Vritra suddenly paused, the three women did the same and looked at him in confusion.
"Hubby, what's wrong?" Yasmine asked.
"I sense there are people ahead, maybe they had gone there to check things up too."
Vritra said, and from what he sensed it was people from one of the organizations who had attacked him during the war.
"Which organization are they from?" Fiona asked, she was always ready for a battle.
"The Divine Kage, there are two of them and judging from their strength, they should be numbered around eighty?"
Vritra said, he should be right unless the level of strength had changed in the Divine Kage.
"Let's go check it."
They flew ahead, and the two men too were heading in the same direction.
It wasn't long before the two noticed the group, they paused and waited.
"Who are you?" their faces were covered by masks and their voices sounded as robotic as before.
"Well well, two new wraiths I am getting now." Vritra saw no point in wasting time or pretending in front of them.
He had already killed the dragon council and turned them all into wraiths, and he would do the same for these men.
The number of guards around his new house was increasing quite quickly.
"What?" With a snap, Vritra trapped the two in a barrier, then his appearance changed to the one before the war.
Horns appeared over his head and demonic presence spread around, startling the two warriors.
"V- Vritra Arclis?!! Reporting back to the headquarters!" one of them spoke, as they both tried to send information back but failed.
"Haha, are you scared yet?" Vritra stretched his arms and took off his coat, then handing it to Yasmine he asked them to move back.
Killing them was too easy but he wanted them to suffer.
"Communication failed, engaging in battle."
The atmosphere around the two suddenly changed, as they took out different weapons and flashed to either side of Vritra.
Their emotionless voices sounded again and the two attacked:
"Nullifying the threat!"
"How weak..." Vritra shook his head, he pointed his finger forward and tapped over the space in front of him.
Faint traces of greenish energy burst out, and cracks formed over the space, spreading quickly towards the two men.
And instantly their bodies were cut into thousands of pieces in a strange way, it was as if they had turned into glass figures and just broken apart.
They tried to heal but failed again, the green energy began to rapidly destroy them even though Vritra barely even used any strength.
After all, it was the core of a level 3 demi god, these Divine Kage were no match.
"Whoa!!" Teresa exclaimed in surprise, truly impressed by his strength.
Fiona and Yasmine just smiled, for them, Vritra was the best at anything and everything.
"Do you feel fear yet?" Vritra's chilling voice rang out, and the pieces of their bodies started to tremble.
Their robotic voices sounded again: "Failed to kill the threat, escaping."
Vritra just laughed, as he watched the two trying to run away, they were shivering in fear.
"Knight—" Vritra then paused, remembering that Knight was still undergoing the transformation, so he spoke again:
"Hellmancer, go and scare our new wraiths a bit and then bring them to me."
"Yes, master..." Hellmancer nodded, and flew towards their escaping body parts.
"Let's go."
Vritra said as they continued on their journey, previously Divine Kage, whose members are even stronger than all the lords, were too strong for Vritra.
But now they posed no threat at all.
As they flew further into the north, the cold began to increase, the snowfall was even heavier.
Everything was covered by snow.
Vritra even saw a small village of demons frozen up.
A few other small villages were also seen, beasts and all others in this region had frozen to their deaths.
Flowing warm air over his hand, Vritra paused as he finally arrived at what appeared to be the centre of all changes.
He sensed the biggest turbulence from there, buried deep in the snow, there was a white translucent stone.
"Hmm, stay back, let me check this." Vritra said as he landed, his feet instantly sinking into the snow.
He moved forward and with a release of some energy all the surrounding snow disappeared.
And finally, the white stone was more visible.
"So, this really is not a natural change. But it doesn't seem the demons or the Twilight were behind this."
Vritra thought and touched the cold surface and sensed something pulsating inside it.
Curious, he punched it.
BANG
But aside from slight faint lines, the stone was actually able to handle the punch.
Vritra used all his strength, even using some of his mana and a tiny bit of the green mana, and punched again.
BOOOOOOM!!
A sonic boom resounded all around, the snow all around was thrown away.
And the stone finally cracked, its pieces flying in all directions.
And what was revealed was a strange large black cocoon of some sort.
Its surface seemed to be made of rough skin, and it was thumping constantly as if alive.
"Is this a living creature?" Vritra frowned, he couldn't sense much from it.
He made a blade from Goop and tried slashing at it but even such a powerful blade couldn't do anything.
With the same amount of force, he punched again.
BOOOOOM!!
But aside from faint tremors, nothing happened to the mass of flesh.
"Divine?" Vritra could only get such answers from one person.
"This is a seed, it is planted in every planet that's about to go through trials. And yes, this is the reason for the sudden climate change." Divine answered.
"A seed? What will it do? Tell me more about it." Vritra asked.
"The seeds for all planets are different and controlled by the gods, it won't react if you win the trial but if you lose, it will be the thing that will destroy your planet.
Anyway, the seed's main functionality starts after the game begins." Divine explained.
