Reporting back to the headquarters!" one of them spoke, as they both tried to send information back but failed.
"Haha, are you scared yet?" Vritra stretched his arms and took off his coat, then handing it to Yasmine he asked them to move back.
Killing them was too easy but he wanted them to suffer.
"Communication failed, engaging in battle."
The atmosphere around the two suddenly changed, as they took out different weapons and flashed to either side of Vritra.
Their emotionless voices sounded again and the two attacked:
"Nullifying the threat!"
"How weak..." Vritra shook his head, he pointed his finger forward and tapped over the space in front of him.
Faint traces of greenish energy burst out, and cracks formed over the space, spreading quickly towards the two men.
And instantly their bodies were cut into thousands of pieces in a strange way, it was as if they had turned into glass figures and just broken apart.
They tried to heal but failed again, the green energy began to rapidly destroy them even though Vritra barely even used any strength.
After all, it was the core of a level 3 demi god, these Divine Kage were no match.
"Whoa!!" Teresa exclaimed in surprise, truly impressed by his strength.
Fiona and Yasmine just smiled, for them, Vritra was the best at anything and everything.
"Do you feel fear yet?" Vritra's chilling voice rang out, and the pieces of their bodies started to tremble.
Their robotic voices sounded again: "Failed to kill the threat, escaping."
Vritra just laughed, as he watched the two trying to run away, they were shivering in fear.
"Knight—" Vritra then paused, remembering that Knight was still undergoing the transformation, so he spoke again:
"Hellmancer, go and scare our new wraiths a bit and then bring them to me."
"Yes, master..." Hellmancer nodded, and flew towards their escaping body parts.
"Let's go."
Vritra said as they continued on their journey, previously Divine Kage, whose members are even stronger than all the lords, were too strong for Vritra.
But now they posed no threat at all.
As they flew further into the north, the cold began to increase, the snowfall was even heavier.
Everything was covered by snow.
Vritra even saw a small village of demons frozen up.
A few other small villages were also seen, beasts and all others in this region had frozen to their deaths.
Flowing warm air over his hand, Vritra paused as he finally arrived at what appeared to be the centre of all changes.
He sensed the biggest turbulence from there, buried deep in the snow, there was a white translucent stone.
"Hmm, stay back, let me check this." Vritra said as he landed, his feet instantly sinking into the snow.
He moved forward and with a release of some energy all the surrounding snow disappeared.
And finally, the white stone was more visible.
"So, this really is not a natural change.
But it doesn't seem the demons or the Twilight were behind this."
Vritra thought and touched the cold surface and sensed something pulsating inside it.
Curious, he punched it.
BANG
But aside from slight faint lines, the stone was actually able to handle the punch.
Vritra used all his strength, even using some of his mana and a tiny bit of the green mana, and punched again.
BOOOOOOM!!
A sonic boom resounded all around, the snow all around was thrown away.
And the stone finally cracked, its pieces flying in all directions.
And what was revealed was a strange large black cocoon of some sort.
Its surface seemed to be made of rough skin, and it was thumping constantly as if alive.
"Is this a living creature?" Vritra frowned, he couldn't sense much from it.
He made a blade from Goop and tried slashing at it but even such a powerful blade couldn't do anything.
With the same amount of force, he punched again.
BOOOOOM!!
But aside from faint tremors, nothing happened to the mass of flesh.
"Divine?" Vritra could only get such answers from one person.
"This is a seed, it is planted in every planet that's about to go through trials.
And yes, this is the reason for the sudden climate change." Divine answered.
"A seed?
What will it do?
Tell me more about it." Vritra asked.
"The seeds for all planets are different and controlled by the gods, it won't react if you win the trial but if you lose, it will be the thing that will destroy your planet.
Anyway, the seed's main functionality starts after the game begins." Divine explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 580 Trespasser!
paragraphs: Vritra listened carefully, so for now he could only let the seed be, there was nothing he could do about it.
"Will the cold weather persist till the start of the trials?" he asked.
"Yes, there could be many changes, it also hints towards the type of game you will play." Divine replied.
Vritra stared at the seed and decided to cover it up. With a wave of his hand, all the pieces of white stone flew back.
Then using Dust manipulation, he joined the stone back, almost making it as good as new.
It wasn't supposed to break, after all no one that powerful should be on this planet yet.
Even the supposed hero, Jack, has yet to reach the lord rank.
"Right, I need to find Jack before he kills anyone." Vritra had almost forgotten about him, or maybe it was fate's way of keeping the hero alive?
But the one with the highest connection, Maeve, has begun to evolve so she wouldn't be able to help right now.
For now, he decided to go back and inform his wives, so they could announce a search for Jack.
"Let's go, I will explain everything once we are back at our house."
And so, the group of four flew back, amidst the heavy storm and snowfall.
Vritra brushed off the snow from Yasmine's head and shoulders, then did the same for Fiona and Teresa.
Vanessa and Diana paused their training and came out after Vritra called them.
"Okay, so this thing is a seed, it will become the main source of destruction if we end up losing the trial. And when the game starts..."
Vritra explained everything to the five of his wives while displaying an image.
He wished for Yennefer to return as soon as possible, he was really starting to miss her.
And once she is out, he would take her and let her kill as many demon lords and demons as she wished.
"Honey, I will instantly start the search for Jack." Vanessa said.
"Dear, I haven't been able to take complete charge of the continent back yet, but now that everyone is aware of my return, all of the loyal subjects have returned."
Diana spoke, she really wanted to kill the Golden Moon members who were acting like big lords in her palace.
But the day after tomorrow would be the D-day for them all.
"It's alright, we will settle all new and old scores soon, just use whatever means you have to search for him. Also, inform the World Information Centre too, they are good at it." Vritra said.
"Darling, I will also put everyone in my kingdom to this task." Fiona said, she was just happy to be able to stay with him like back then.
"Wifey, you should start absorbing the core too, we all need to increase our strength as soon as possible. Tess, you too." Vritra looked at them and added.
"Hmm." They both hummed, it was a boring but important task.
All of them got to work. First Vanessa returned to the City of Charms and formed the search party.
After giving proper instructions, she returned and went back to her training.
With that nameless treasure, her strength was increasing quite quickly.
Diana did the same, after she put together a team for the search, she returned and started training.
With that Tomb of the Gods treasure, she was also growing very quickly.
Yasmine and Teresa started to train together, absorbing energy from the core.
While Teresa also needed to prepare for the cold weather so normal humans and other races could survive, as it seemed the temperature was only going to drop further in the future.
It had been way too long since Vritra spent any alone time with Fiona, so he decided to go out with her.
The two dressed up properly for the weather, although there was no need.
Just as Vritra flew out of his house, Hellmancer arrived there with two dead bodies which were cut into tiny pieces.
It seemed Hellmancer had tortured the two men from Divine Kage quite well.
"Good job, now stand guard here." Vritra said as he quickly turned the dead men into soul wraiths and added them to his large army.
There were thousands of guards, even the weakest was a beginner lord while most went far above that level.
"Fiona, let's first go to the Phoenix Kingdom." Vritra said, as he pulled the cap over her head and touched her warm cheeks.
"Okay, darling." The redhead replied with a big smile, this was all she wanted, and she was so happy to have this time.
The two held each other's hands, fingers interlocking intimately as they flew away.
Despite the weather turning bad, it was another type of experience.
The two looked at the beautiful scenery below, the blanket of snow covering everything.
The sun was completely hidden from sight, and the weather would only get worse.
Fiona and Vritra took their time enjoying the sights as they finally arrived at the Phoenix Kingdom.
Surprisingly, a couple of guards were standing outside, guarding the gate.
Fiona landed before them, as the snow all around them melted instantly.
The guards were startled, but upon seeing her they bowed hastily and spoke: "G- Greetings, Empress, we were waiting for your return!!"
Fiona didn't even glance at them and continued to walk alongside Vritra, a smile on her lips as she talked about random things.
After they had walked away, the guards finally straightened up and wondered if it really was their Empress.
The Empress who is always angry and in the mood to slaughter, she was talking so gently with someone?
They hadn't seen her expression properly or they would have been even more shocked.
"Heh, these people really fear Fiona, she used to be so sweet to everyone." Vritra shook his head, at least she was opening up to him more.
After arriving outside an empty hall, Fiona turned to Vritra and said: "Darling, give me a moment, let me call them all here."
Then taking a glyph out of a storage glyph, she injected some mana as the alarms started ringing.
Within a minute, dozens of men and women rushed towards the hall, knowing that their Empress was back.
"Go ahead, take care of the business here, I will wait outside for you." Vritra said, and before she could reply he started to walk towards a nearby building.
Fiona hummed and decided to finish this meeting as soon as possible.
Vritra paused outside a shop that was selling some sort of candies, they smelled quite good so he decided to purchase some.
He still possessed quite a lot of gold, so the high prices were no problem for him.
"Haven't seen you here before, who are you?" Just as Vritra took the candies, a group of three men walked towards him.
Maybe because of high tolerance, and their nature being fire, the phoenixes weren't as affected by the cold.
Vritra glanced back and could tell they were just here to extort some money, the weather still made everything really expensive.
"Don't mind me, just... go away." The three were so pitifully weak that killing them would just dirty the ground.
"Oh, guards!! There is a trespasser, we have caught a thief, hurry up!!" They suddenly started shouting, the three men looked shrewdly at Vritra.
With the natural disaster befalling, the rate of crime has also increased.

chapters.title: Chapter 581 A Beautiful Scenery
paragraphs: "Here, we have caught a thief, he is trespassing into our kingdom. He might be a demon or a spy!" one of the three men shouted, gloating at finally catching a rich victim.
He paid the high price of the candies without a second thought, so just how much money and treasure must he be holding?
And they could clearly tell he was not someone from the phoenix race, so what better chance than this to extort him?
Instantly, as if waiting for their chance, four guards rushed towards him from some corner.
And just by a single glance, Vritra could tell that only one of them was a real guard, the other three were just pretending.
"Arrest him! I suspect him of heinous crimes," another from the group of three spoke.
"How dare you be so arrogant in our kingdom, you are asking to be killed. Hurry up and hand over everything you have stolen, or would you prefer freezing in prison in this cold?" the guard said.
Vritra turned to look at the shopkeeper and asked, "And what do you have to say about this?"
"I...?" the shopkeeper was confused for a moment. He was the one who gave the signal, but that was all he needed to do.
"Y- Yes, I saw you stealing. Just cooperate with the guards and return the money you stole," the shopkeeper said.
"Sigh, fine. How much did I steal? I will return it," Vritra said, releasing a long sigh.
"H- He stole a hundred, no, a thousand gold coins!!" the group of three said.
"Is that so? Then take out all one thousand coins right now," the fake guard spoke.
"Okay, okay, it is just a thousand. I have a lot more," Vritra said, and with a wave of his hand, a small mountain of gold coins appeared.
There were at least a hundred thousand gold coins, baffling all of them.
'F- Fuck, I should have asked for more.' They gulped, but in the next moment, the gold coins disappeared, and now they felt that stealing a thousand coins was far too little.
"A- All of that must be stolen! Guards, take it all away and throw him out!!" the three shouted.
"Is that so? You can throw him out? You think you deserve to be here more than him?" a female voice sounded from somewhere.
"Of course, get the hell out of here if you don't want to be thrown in pris-" one of the fake guards spoke arrogantly as he turned towards the source of the voice.
And finally, all eight of the men froze as they saw the terrifying empress standing before them.
'W- Wasn't she gone? When did she return?' Their bodies instantly started to shiver. If they knew she was back, they would never have dared to do this.
"Haa Fiona, can you lend me a few gold coins? I have to return the stolen goods," Vritra said with his arms crossed, clearly in for a good show.
"!!!" The eyes of all eight widened. He actually dared to call the empress by her name directly?
Even if they were going to be punished, he was going to be burned to death. They felt a bit satisfied.
"Darling, don't worry, let me pay for you," Fiona said with a smile.
The heads of all of them began to spin.
Darling? DARLING?!! Wasn't this a random human who had come here to buy things?
Their bodies felt like melting, they just wanted to disappear as the end felt near.
Then Fiona turned to them and asked, "Do you think you deserve to be in this kingdom more than the emperor himself?"
She gestured to one of the ministers and asked, "What should be the punishment for disrespecting my husband, the emperor?"
"T- They should be tortured to death!!" the minister replied in a hurry. Somehow, she seemed even more terrifying now.
And who exactly was this person who could handle such a madwoman, more than half of whose thoughts were filled with slaughter and death?
"Good. Make an example out of them. Also, how are they able to commit crimes openly?" Fiona asked sternly, and Vritra looked at her, finding her even more adorable.
"S- Sorry, Empress, I wasn't careful enough," the minister said, surviving only because he didn't make useless excuses.
Then he gestured for all eight of them to be dragged away, the shopkeeper, the group of three, and the four fake guards.
"W- Wait, we are sorry, please forgive us. We were wrong..."
The eight continued to scream as they were dragged away, but Vritra didn't really care.
It had been a long time since others' deaths stopped affecting him, of course except for his family.
After giving a few more instructions, Fiona took Vritra's hand and asked, "Darling, shall we go?"
"Yeah," Vritra nodded as the two flew away towards the south, where the temperature was still a bit better.
Soon, the two sat at the top of a mountain, with Fiona sitting sideways on his lap and her head resting on his chest.
They stared towards the sky where the faint figure of the sun peeked through the light snowfall.
The sight was truly beautiful, and just enjoying each other's presence felt wonderful.
Both of them were inside Vritra's jacket, his arms wrapped around her slim waist.
"Darling..." Fiona spoke softly, feeling relaxed and happy.
"Hmm," Vritra hummed, looking down at her beautiful face, her juicy red lips tempting him.
"I have thought of a lot more plays. Let's try them all," she said, smiling innocently.
Vritra chuckled. All her ideas were rather bizarre. Caressing her thigh, he asked, "My little devil, where do all these ideas come from? And here I used to think you were too innocent."
Fiona had always been curious about such things and enjoyed them even more.
"I just want to do more and more with you," Fiona said. She leaned up and gently pressed her soft, moist lips against his.
Vritra lightly bit her lower lip, pulling it slightly before letting go as her lips bounced back softly.
"Mmm~" Fiona stared at his face and then looked towards the sky. Sitting peacefully with her husband in such a beautiful place, what could be better than that?
But then she remembered something.
"Wait, Teresa got such a nice wedding, but what about us? You don't love me as much as her?" Fiona asked, pouting.

Vritra couldn't help but pinch her cheek, then spoke, "Yeah, sorry, it's my fault. Things just happened. But once Yenni is back, let's hold the grandest wedding where I marry all my gorgeous wives. Is that okay?"
If she wanted a separate wedding, Vritra would do it that way.
If things weren't so hectic all the time, he should have had a wedding with all of them by now.
They were already deeply connected, so he never cared much for ceremonies, but now it seemed there really was a need for it.
"I am fine with that. Thank you, darling," Fiona said, giving him another kiss on the lips.
They talked and enjoyed the scenery for a bit longer before finally moving to another place.
Fiona seemed eager to try some strange idea of hers, which again made Vritra question whether they should even do it or how he would look himself in the eye afterward.
But as the saying goes, happy wife, happy life, so poor Vritra had no choice but to indulge in her erotic acts.
Thanks for reading...

Because of the bracelet they received from Teresa, the two were completely unaffected by the cold and spores.
"So where are we going?" Monk Shitless brushed off the snow gathering over his bald head and asked.
Bullo was asleep inside the house right now.
Vritra nodded and explained his plan, after a moment he asked:
"Can you create something like that?"
Shitless and Onest had disgusted looks on their faces but they nodded, both couldn't help but smile upon thinking of their plan.
"Yup, we will get to it immediately." They both nodded and hurriedly got to work.
They were going to create a special solution, and the ingredients, although not needed to be followed strictly, would be hard to find in the current weather.
Vritra waited patiently, after a moment he remembered something and picked a few candies from his pocket and threw one into his mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 589 It's Gone
paragraphs: Vritra threw one candy into his mouth. These were the ones he got back in the Phoenix Kingdom, right before those people tried to rob him.
It tasted quite good actually. Vritra waited a little longer, aware the thing he had asked them to create wouldn't be made easily.
His gaze drifted towards the sky. Raising a hand, he caught one of the spores and stared at it.
But even with his senses, he couldn't find anything, so he threw it away and continued waiting.
"Hubby," suddenly Yasmine's voice sounded in his mind. For a moment, Vritra felt she had arrived, but then he remembered about their connection.
'How's training going?' he asked, rubbing his hands and blowing warm air at them. Thankfully, this much cold couldn't affect him.
"It is a really miraculous core, my strength is increasing quickly. But this is so boring, where are you going?" she asked. Previously she wasn't sharing his senses, so she hadn't heard the plan.
'Well, it's a little surprise for...' Vritra explained his plan, and the dragoness burst out laughing. She really wished she could be with him right now.
But sharing senses like this was also fine.
The two chatted, and Vritra no longer felt bored standing alone in the open.
After a while, Onest and Shitless returned with big smiles on their faces.
Vritra looked and asked, "Is it ready?"
"Well, it was hard to find that type of things, but it turned out better than you asked. Take a look at this." Shitless excitedly gestured towards Onest.
Who in turn took out a big bottle, at least three litres in size. It was filled with many types of things.
But the moment it was pulled out in the open, the whole surrounding was filled with a very, very disgusting stench. It was worse than dozens of corpses rotting away.
Vritra instantly pulled the handkerchief from his inventory and pressed it against his nose. Instantly, the bad smell stopped coming.
Instead, his nose was filled with Teresa's sweet fragrance. It almost worked like an air filter for him, keeping the stench away.
The noses of Shitless and Onest were wrinkling too as they covered their faces with other pieces of cloth, patting their chests as if some acid was burning inside.
"How is it?" Onest asked. His hands were covered by several gloves. He didn't even want one drop of that to touch his skin.
Only the two of them knew what the ingredients of that fluid were. It was so disgusting that he didn't even want to talk about it.
"Hmm..." Vritra nodded. With one hand holding the handkerchief, he pulled out a small bottle which he had also gotten from Teresa.
Then he made it float and poured the contents into the bottle.
Instantly, as if some reaction had taken place, it started to boil over as bubbles flew out of it and burst into the air, instantly melting the surrounding snow.
"It's perfect now, good job." Vritra said, his lips curling up under the handkerchief. Then he added:
"Let's go."
"Muahahaha, this is so great. I was craving something like this." Shitless laughed like a mad scientist, overjoyed.
Onest put away the bottle and laughed too. He agreed, this was going to be fun.
The three started walking while talking about it, their feet sinking into the deep snow.
Vritra then threw two candies at them, which they caught and threw into their mouths.
"Mmm, it's good. Thanks, pitiful one." Shitless said, and Onest thanked him too.
"Pitiful one? Didn't my bad luck disappear?" Vritra asked with his eyebrows raised.
The monk stared at his head and mumbled, "You always have bad luck, and I can't think of a better name."
The three were just walking, but suddenly Shitless fell to his knees. He clutched his throat and screamed in despair:
"NOOOOOOOOOOOOO!"
Vritra and Onest were both startled as they turned abruptly, wondering what happened to the monk out of nowhere.
Was it because of that fluid or the candy?
Onest almost spat out the candy instinctively, but he knew Vritra wouldn't harm them, so he paused.
"What's wrong? Are you allergic to it?" Vritra asked hurriedly, as he took out a couple of potions, ready to pour them into his mouth.
"I- It's gone, SOB," Shitless looked up with tear-filled eyes and muttered.
"What's gone? What happened exactly?" Vritra couldn't understand.
"T- The candy, I swallowed it accidentally. SOB, it's gone now, it was so tasty, SOB." Shitless shared his grievances.
Vritra rolled his eyes while Onest hit the back of the monk's head. He showed such a dramatic reaction just for a candy.
"Here, you can have another." Vritra gave him one, shaking his head.
"R- Really? Thank you, SOB, you are the best, pitiful o- one." he spoke.
The two held back their urge to smack his head and turned towards the exit.
Without wasting any time, the three flew away. Of course, Shitless still couldn't fly, so Vritra used dust manipulation to bring him along.
Around evening,
Far away from the Quartz continent, it was the base of the Golden Moon.
The head of this organization, Oracle, called upon another meeting.
Recently, the snow and spores had made people's lives difficult, and he had discovered that the spores might affect everyone more than he expected.
So he wanted to deal with these disasters, and if it was impossible then they at least needed to protect the top ones.
Very few people could do anything in such a situation, and the Stealer of Fate was one such individual.
Earlier they had tried to recruit her, but at some point she just disappeared, and Oracle with his ability knew that the Yate family wasn't lying.
So he had to stop his pestering, but now he found out that she had returned.
And there was a high chance she would be in the marriage of the Fords, so he planned to go there personally along with other Golden Moon members.
Knowing about her kindness, he was sure just a few sentences were enough to make her heart melt, so making her work partially for them would be easy.
And then they would just find ways to keep making her work for the Golden Moon. Such a talented person couldn't be left to other organizations.
After everything was planned, he ended the meeting and returned to his home. After a few more miscellaneous tasks, he decided to rest.
Even at their level, resting greatly relieved their mental tension.
Oracle was rather pleased with the current development. Before the war, his personal strength wasn't as high.
And he still had to listen to other members of the Golden Moon, especially Sir Giant, but now everything had changed.
He obtained a new body even better than before, and his strength had increased greatly over the past few years.
In reality, he had benefitted the most from that war, though that demon, Vritra, did give him trauma, often appearing in his nightmares.
But things were getting better now.
He had even taken control of the Quartz continent without any fight. Thankfully, the empress had just disappeared.
He lay on his bed, staring out of the window where wind blew hard and lightning thundered.

chapters.title: Chapter 590 Drink It!!
paragraphs: [A/N: Don't read while eating.]
Outside the window, lightning thundered, flashing briefly amidst the heavy storm and snow.
The weather seemed to be worsening.

'I am sure Teresa will have some solution to this, and even if she can't then we will just have to evacuate a selected few.' Oracle thought, after all, in his eyes the lives of those ordinary people weren't as important as top figures.
After a while, he closed his eyes, all alone on his bed.
Oracle never trusted anyone enough to slip into his bed, and kept women away.
Tomorrow would be even better, he could finally obtain a powerful tool.
While thinking of several things, he soon drifted off to sleep.
Several hours passed in the blink of an eye, despite the bad weather outside, he slept quite peacefully.
THUNDERRRR
Suddenly, lightning thundered outside and three shadows could be seen imprinted on the wall.
The three figures had their faces covered with clothes, and even their hands were covered by gloves.
Oracle didn't wake up, as he couldn't sense their presence. Otherwise, he would be terrified to see the three figures standing around his bed like ghosts.
The scene was truly bone chilling.
One of them sat on the bed beside Oracle's pillow, then patted Oracle's cheek, muttering in a soft voice: "Wakey wakey, daddy is here."
Oracle grimaced, his nose wrinkling, then his eyelids fluttered and slowly opened.
"Aww, are you up?" the same person sitting on the bed said, caressing Oracle's head.
Oracle was dazed for a moment, but then startled, he stared at the dark figure and then sensed the other two.
Somehow, he couldn't look at their faces, even his senses failed to obtain any information.
He froze and stared at the person caressing his head, and only a bald head was visible. The three ghost-like beings had their faces covered.
"Who-"
But all of a sudden, the hand caressing his head tightened and clutched his hair forcefully, yanking his head backwards.
As he returned to his senses, Oracle was filled with rage. He was about to get up, but the other two moved at this time.
Vritra on the right held one of his arms with one hand and placed his palm over Oracle's chest, while Onest held his other hand.
"Bahahaha, open your mouth, we have brought some choco for you, say aah~" Shitless laughed like a maniac and inserted his fingers into Oracle's mouth.
Then with a loud laugh, he pulled his jaw open, almost ripping it apart.
"Take this, bastard, I created it personally so you better not waste a drop, hahahaha." Onest laughed just as loudly.
In the next instant, he pulled out the bottle and turned it upside down, but the contents didn't spill out yet because of Vritra.
BANG
With all his might, Onest thrust the round entrance of the bottle into Oracle's mouth just as the monk pulled his hand away.
The mighty leader of the Golden Moon wriggled and twisted on the bed like a fish out of water. He struggled with all his might but couldn't break free.
Even his mana was in turmoil, unable to be used. He really was completely powerless at this moment.
"POUR IT!! Let it all out!! Drown this motherfucker!!" Vritra said, barely holding himself back from killing this pig.
The three laughed like devils. Onest wasted no time and raised his right hand, then struck the back of the large bottle with all his strength.
BANG
The bottle thrust even deeper into his mouth, slightly tearing the corners of his lips, the tip pressing directly against his throat.
"Ooooogh oobbbb iiieeeee"
Oracle kept trying to shout, glaring at them, unable to understand what was happening all of a sudden.
But then, the contents of the bottle finally flooded into his mouth, and Oracle's eyes rolled back as he tried to stop whatever it was from going down his throat.
But Shitless suddenly punched his belly, making him lose control for a moment.
"MUAHAHAHA, gulp it down. I personally added my precious piss into it, oh and also..." As Shitless spoke, the contents of the special drink continued flowing.
Oracle's eyes almost popped out and extreme disgust filled him, but he had no control as the fluid started to flood down his throat.

It even filled his mouth, and the taste made him, at the lord rank, almost faint. There were solid things in the fluid too, and hearing the talk, Oracle vomited the contents back only to have it pushed back down.
"You piece of shit, did you like that?" Onest shouted, squeezing the bottle and pushing more fluid into his body.
Oracle screamed and twisted, the drink also burning up his body from inside. It was way too disgusting.
Vritra, Onest, and Shitless made Oracle drink every last drop of it, and once he had drunk it all, only then did they pull the bottle away.
Oracle had no strength. He coughed and kept trembling, the room was full of stench. Thankfully, they had covered their faces.
"Kekekeke, liked that? You lucky bastard, getting to drink that. You have been cleansed internally, now wait patiently to go to hell." Shitless shouted.
The three looked at the broken state of Oracle in satisfaction. Vritra looked at them and said: "Let's go, that's all for now."
Oracle stared at the ceiling and the three shadows in a daze. It had all happened too suddenly, he couldn't understand anything.
Then the three figures started to leave, but suddenly the bald figure turned and jumped up.
Monk Shitless had been practicing for quite some time now. Aside from his head, he had strengthened his fists and knees as well, and some other parts.
CRACK
He jumped up and then smashed one of his knees into Oracle's crotch, as the leader of the Golden Moon coughed and then everything went dark.
Some time passed and Oracle woke up with a start. He looked around but found no one.
"W- What was that? Another nightmare?" He was drenched in sweat and saw outside that it was already morning.
He sighed in relief that it was just a nightmare, but suddenly he coughed and spat out a tiny piece of something.
"H- Huh? Did I end up eating something strange?" He threw it away, believing that all was just a dream.
Then he got up to get ready for the wedding.
Some time ago, after leaving Oracle's house, the three flew away and couldn't help but laugh.
That was so satisfying. Shitless was the happiest, he really enjoyed such stuff.
Then Vritra opened a portal and sent the two back first, and he paused in the middle of nowhere.
The snow and spores fell over him but couldn't get close to his body.
He pondered and tried to sense Knight's presence, but it seemed the powerful knight would need more time.
Then he pulled out the fishing rod from his inventory. This was present in Zihong's inventory, but he didn't have the time to test it yet.
"Divine?" Vritra called out, but again got no response, making him feel irritated.
He never replied when Vritra asked anything, and only spoke when it benefited him somehow.
Giving up on contacting that useless guy, Vritra tried using the fishing rod. It shouldn't be something simple.
But no matter what he tried, nothing special happened.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 591 The Great Change
paragraphs: It was a grand day in the Ford realm, the entire realm was decorated especially well.
At least ten or even twenty times better than at Teresa's wedding, previously they were rushed but this time they spent money like anything.
Not to mention, the Ford realm has grown recently, they even swallowed two of the strongest families.
Although Teresa's absence would be troublesome, they still had quite a few treasures she had left behind, so they were still doing great.
Despite the current weather, dozens upon dozens of people were constantly entering the realm, all of them awed by the decorations.
Already thousands of people had gathered, fully aware that this wedding was going to be anything but ordinary.
Many especially came knowing how interesting the previous marriage of the Ford family was.
And even more people came because of Teresa, aware that she would definitely be here.
All the members of the Ford family were busy, Sir Giant planned to make the last attempt to try to get Teresa back.
He now felt that even letting Vritra meet her might have been a mistake, but he was also torn, since she seemed happy with him so he didn't want to separate the two.
He just hoped the two would start living there.
The Golden Moon also arrived there, the six seats and a lot of other members were present.
Somehow the feared leader, Oracle, seemed to have a cough and for some reason he was walking a bit strangely.
But still he acted as if no one around was higher than him.
Almost all other organizations were there, even many dark organizations, some hidden and a few even openly, who maintained a false good image.
All the people were gathered in a large open area, but a layer of invisible barrier stopped the snow and spores above, making it look even more beautiful.
But the main characters of today's event were yet to arrive, not the bride and groom but some others.
Back in the House of Darkness, Vritra dressed up in a black outfit which looked quite good on him.
He was going to meet his in-laws so obviously he needed to look good.
Right now he stood in front of Maeve's room, wondering if her evolution would finish in time.
They were about to head out but the demoness was still inside, despite the difference in time, this process was taking quite a lot of time.
After a moment, he decided to contact her mentally.
After a few tries, he was able to telepathically talk to her.
'Foxie, will you be out anytime soon? It is already time, we will be heading to the marriage soon.' Vritra spoke, and soon a disappointed voice sounded in his mind.
"Master, it seems this will take some more time, I... can't go with you." Maeve spoke, she really wanted to go and kill many with her own hands.
'Oh, it's alright, just focus on your evolution, that is more important.' he said, after all Oracle and the others held no importance in their lives.
And after today they would cease to exist.
"Hm, master, beat them extra for me, and record it all, I will see it later." Maeve said.
'Alright, we will be back soon.' Vritra talked with her a bit more and finally walked to the other room.
Then he saw his other wives, all of them were dressed up in winter clothes, which perfectly hid their curves but they all still looked exceptionally beautiful.
His gaze moved from Fiona, Diana, Vanessa, Teresa and finally landed on Yasmine.
"You all look wonderful, makes me want to just cancel the other plan." He spoke with a smile, as the five women stood up and walked towards him.
"That won't do, we have to butcher a few pigs, can't let them enjoy life any longer." Yasmine said, straightening Vritra's clothes gently and caressing his chest.
"Should I...?" Teresa looked at Vritra, holding the veil in her hand.
"It's alright, you don't have to wear that. I will use illusion to stop anyone from seeing you, or Diana can also do that." Vritra said, his gaze turning to the goddess.
Diana too had obtained a halo; though it was a lot weaker than a mythic halo, by now it had grown quite a bit too.
She could easily handle such a simple thing.
"Yeah, I can, leave that to me dear." Diana spoke.
"Honey, let's go." Vanessa smiled, she too was going to slaughter the ones who hurt her son.
Although no one from the Yate family was going, Gunter had arranged a couple of vehicles for them, one was for Vritra and the women with him.
And the other carried gifts, Onest and Shitless.
And so, together they headed towards the venue.
The mood in the car was actually quite good, except for Yennefer still trapped, nothing else was wrong, everything seemed to be going perfectly.
After finding Jack, one more problem would be solved as well.
But from all the news, he had just disappeared and wasn't seen again.
Vritra couldn't find him at all, and could only wait.
Maybe having that werewolf guy around wouldn't have been bad, but he was already dead so there was no point thinking.
The two vehicles quickly flew through the heavy snowfall, but were protected by barriers, not getting affected at all.
Before long, they heard the music even a couple of kilometres away, and could see the bright lights which illuminated the entrance of the Ford realm.
'They have really gone all out.' Vritra thought and looked to the side at Teresa, who showed no emotion on her face.
It seemed matters related to the Ford family no longer affected her, Vritra was glad about that but for her sake, he decided not to kill them.
As the vehicles flew towards the entrance, they lowered towards the ground and the snow under them cleared a bit.
Just then, a dragonfly dying amidst the snowfall tiredly moved down towards the ground.
Then it landed over the snow, seeming quite close to its death; quite a lot of insects and animals had died in such weather.
But just then, a parasitic plant closed its mouth around the insect, it too was barely alive.
The dragonfly struggled to escape but had no strength and soon became still, getting even closer to death.
In the silence, tiny spores continued to fall, covering all of the ground.
Just then an invisible wave swept through the whole planet rapidly, it was invisible and couldn't be sensed, even Vritra didn't feel anything as the invisible wave passed through.
The tiny spores began to evolve in strange forms.
Several spores were already over and inside the plant.
Suddenly, the parasitic plant buzzed and then its mouth was forced open as hundreds of mutated small dragonflies suddenly rushed out.
After moving into the sky, all the dragonflies were pulled back into one large insect before shooting into the distance.
The parasitic plant on the ground also buzzed and twisted, its size increasing and vines spreading around, it suddenly was filled with intense life force.
Instantly the place was filled with ear-piercing screeches and screams of countless creatures.
A great change started to occur all over the planet, which was going to affect all living creatures.
Thanks for reading

chapters.title: Chapter 592 The Gathering of Old Friends
paragraphs: As the cars stopped in front of the Fords' door, several servants quickly approached to welcome them.
And upon seeing it was Vritra and several others, they informed the members of the family.
Before long, Shen and Sir Giant both arrived at the door.
"Art, welcome." He said with a smile, seemingly in a good mood.
After everyone got off the cars, he looked around and asked: "Didn't your parents come with you or anyone else from the Yate realm?"
"No, they had some other business to tend to." Vritra replied emotionlessly as he gestured for the servants to take the gifts inside.
Beside him were Fiona, Diana, Vanessa, Teresa, and Yasmine, the sight instantly attracting the attention of a lot of people.
"Oh, it's alright, please come inside." Shen spoke, still wary of Vritra, maintaining some distance.
As they made their way inside, Vritra and the others noticed many important figures. Of course, Fiona and Diana were the ones pointing them out.
While bringing them inside, Sir Giant had to step away to meet some other people.
"Here, we have arranged some seats for you. If you need anything, just order them." Shen spoke hurriedly.
Vritra nodded as he sat down along with his wives. Shitless and Onest were also there, sitting not too far away from him.
The two seemed to be quarrelling about something.
Vritra didn't pay attention to their bickering and instantly focused his gaze on several men in the distance.
Just as he had expected, Oracle had come, and many other Golden Moon members were there as well.
Big Guy was there too, who had barely survived in that war.
A few demons could also be sensed. Of course, in such a big event, they would enter.
Whether with some hidden motive or just for some opportunity.
Vritra continued to look around, and soon he was a bit surprised as he found someone he hadn't expected to see.
It was none other than Kryn, the leader of Grieves, who had somehow managed to survive the war.
Except for Sloth the demon, most of the participants were actually gathered here.
Of course, the members of Twilight were also there, but Vritra was a bit disappointed to not see Red at the wedding.
The leader of the group Bone Blood Cult, which was already destroyed and merged with Twilight.
'Han isn't here either, he has disappeared after that war.' Vritra thought. Han was the protector of the human emperor and secretly in love with Yennefer.
He decided to deal with them separately. For now, he would just take care of the Golden Moon and Kryn.
Several waiters brought various sorts of dishes and drinks for them.
"Honey, when do we start?" Yasmine asked, killing intent flashing in her eyes. She was barely holding herself back from attacking Oracle.
"Not yet, let them proceed with the wedding." Vritra said as his gaze landed on Oracle, who was talking with Sir Giant.
After a moment, he decided to go and talk.
"Wait here, and if someone tries anything, you all are free to kill them. It won't disturb my plan." Vritra said as he got up and gestured towards Shitless and Onest.
The three headed towards a small group which also consisted of a few other Golden Moon members.
"Hello, you must be the leader of Golden Moon, Oracle? I have heard a lot about you." Vritra suddenly interrupted their conversation as all eyes turned towards him.
"Hmm, and you are?" Oracle looked at Vritra and instantly recognized him as Teresa's husband, but pretended not to know.
He was a bit surprised to see him talk so confidently and not appear afraid before him.
'Haa, the Yate family is weak. Is he just so confident over the Fords and Teresa?' Oracle wondered. He knew Vritra had some strength, but he didn't think much of it.
"This is Art Yate, my grandson-in-law." Sir Giant introduced hurriedly. Now that his physique was stolen by Vritra, his strength had decreased significantly.
He was also afraid that Vritra might pick a fight with the Golden Moon.
"W- Why don't you chat with..." Sir Giant said but was interrupted.
"I didn't expect you to come to such a small function when the whole planet is in such crisis, Golden Moon, heh." Vritra chuckled, and Shitless chimed in.
"They are here enjoying while people are hoping that the Golden Moon is going to save them. I thought they were better, but it seems they are just scum, pieces of shit, shit-eating—"
The monk didn't stop and continued to throw insults, only pausing when Sir Giant interrupted.
"What are you saying, haha, he just jokes around a lot." Then in a low voice he asked: "Who the hell are you? How did you get in?"
But Oracle didn't get angry. He looked at Vritra and spoke: "About that, we are going to need Teresa's help to solve this crisis. I hope you don't have a problem with that, not that it would matter."
Before Vritra could speak, however, Shitless laughed and pointed towards Oracle.
"Did you forget to wear your diaper? Why are you leaking? Hahaha."
All eyes instantly turned towards Oracle, and they were shocked to actually see the wet line, and then smelled something foul.
"!!!" Oracle was even more shocked. For some reason, since morning his lower body had been acting strangely.
But now even he couldn't remain calm. He glared at Shitless and turned, walking away hastily.
"Eww, what is that foul smell, don't tell me you shat too. The leader of Golden Moon peed, everyone, he peed!!" Shitless shouted, pointing towards him.
Oracle really felt like smashing that bald man's head, but he hurriedly left, disappearing from everyone's sight.
If he didn't have other motives, then he would have just left the place after such humiliation.
"Stop!" one of the Seats of Golden Moon shouted, seeming as if he was about to attack.
"Oh, what are you going to do otherwise? Pee in your pants?" Shitless laughed. With Vritra there, he didn't have to fear anything.
"You—" just before a fight was about to break out, Sir Giant interrupted them.
But Vritra's attention was pulled towards something else.
In the distance, he saw several guards surrounding a young man.
Someone Vritra recognized instantly.
'Jack!!' he exclaimed, finding this guy in the place he expected least.
Rich was standing there too with an angry look. He seemed to be questioning Jack.
Vritra instantly walked towards the group and asked: "What's the matter, Rich?"
"Oh, Art... um, uncle, uh... we found this guy in our inventory. He was stealing stuff, and upon questioning he said he had entered a hidden inheritance." Rich explained.
"Oh, are you Jack?" Vritra's lips curled into a smile. Could the situation become any better?
"You know me?" Jack was surprised, then he felt that it was to be expected.
With his huge growth and status as a hero, people were bound to recognize him.
"Yes, of course, I know you very well." Vritra said, then looked at Rich and spoke: "He is innocent, just take away all his treasures and leave him be."
"... Alright." Rich nodded and asked the guards to search Jack.
Of course, the wannabe hero struggled, looking enraged.
"Don't you dare touch me, or the entire Ford family will disappear!!" he threatened.

chapters.title: Chapter 593 Stolen Kiss
paragraphs: Jack, after entering the continent, wanted to meet up with Diana and hoped he could find Fiona too.
Now that Vritra was dead, she must finally be out of his hypnosis. She would truly understand his feelings and see his overwhelming strength.
But unfortunately for him, just as he had reached the palace, he heard the news that the empress had disappeared.
Jack continued his search but couldn't find the goddess or Fiona, he could only wait in the capital.
Then the cold disaster struck and he had to go out to get food, and one day he was suddenly thrown into a rift.
When he opened his eyes, he found himself in an underground inheritance with a lot of treasures.
Of course, he had gone through such experiences many times so he wasted no time and started looting.
Later, he was caught by several guards for stealing, and found out it was the treasury of the Ford family.
The zombie girl and Raino were with him too.
Currently, the guards forcefully took away all his glyphs and then Onest used his ability to steal everything from his inventory.
Even his personal stuff was stolen away.
"Stop you bastards, those are just my clothes!!" Jack shouted as not even his clothes were spared.
"Did you find everything inside?" Vritra looked at Rich and questioned.
"Yeah, there is more than he had stolen inside, should I return—" Rich was speaking but was interrupted.
"It's fine, just keep that all, think of it as his compensation."
Then the guards and Rich left, leaving Vritra, Onest, Shitless along with three others.
"What are you doing? M- My stuff!!" Jack stared dazedly as he got looted in broad daylight and then he glared at Vritra.
He was a bit surprised internally to see someone so handsome.
"Who the hell are you? How do you know me—" Jack was just speaking but he suddenly paused as his gaze drifted towards a table not far away.
And there, seated, was none other than his longtime crush, Fiona.
"F- Fiona? Is that really her?" he stared at her in bewilderment, she certainly seemed more grown up and mature.
Not to mention far more beautiful than he remembered, he was completely frozen.
But upon seeing the gorgeous goddess beside Fiona, he became sure that he had finally found the two.
He quickly looked at the other women and didn't recognize Yasmine or Vanessa, while Teresa's face was covered.
Vanessa did seem a bit familiar but she too seemed to have changed so much that he could no longer recognize her.
But none of it mattered, he hurriedly ran towards that table.
Vritra was a bit surprised at first but upon seeing where Jack was headed, his lips curled up.
How could he not torture someone who was begging for it so badly?
Jack paused in front of Fiona and with a massive smile he spoke: "Fiona, I finally found you!!"
Fiona, who was just chatting with others, was startled and her icy gaze landed on a man whose face seemed familiar.
She thought for a few moments, but couldn't really remember, but then seeing those tattoos which were roughly covered up, she remembered.
"Jack?"
"I knew it, you remember me haha I missed you so much, how are you? You missed me too right? I never got to say it before, but I love you so much, what about you?"
In one breath, he said several things, his expression joyful.
He even spread his arms as if he was going to hug her.
Vritra shook his head, this guy was begging to be killed by eyeing his wife.
His body disappeared and he appeared on a seat between Fiona and Diana, there was a black sword in his hand that he extended towards Jack.
"Huh?"
Suddenly feeling something press against his throat, Jack paused mid-motion, his arms still stretched.
His gaze shifted to Vritra.
"It's you again, what do you want now? Get lost, don't interrupt our reunion." Jack shouted angrily, trying to push the sword away but he couldn't even make it budge.
"Oh, do you know her?" Vritra asked, ready to crush his heart again.
"Of course, I love her... and I am sure she reciprocates my feelings. Goddess, you remember me too, right? I am the hero, are you happy to meet me?" his gaze shifted between Fiona and Diana quickly.
Both women looked extremely beautiful, Fiona was his first love but he also liked Diana a bit.
Still, this time he swore he would get Fiona.
But right then, Onest came and pinched his ear, dragging him away.
Vritra watched Jack get pulled away, the show was just beginning.
"What the fuck are you doing ouch ouch who the fuck are you?!!" Jack shouted angrily, his ear was almost torn off.
"Ah sorry sorry, I got the wrong person." Onest chuckled and let go of his ear, then walked away.
Jack was super mad, almost attacked Onest but right now Fiona was more important.
His gaze shifted back towards the table but there was no one now.
"Huh? Where did they go? Was it a dream?" Jack was confused, he even asked Raino about it and confirmed that Fiona was really there.
"Look, Fiona is there." Raino suddenly pointed in a direction, he was shocked at how beautiful Fiona had gotten, and she looked mature too.
She should still be in her early twenties just like them but she was already so graceful.
Jack turned happily, ready to run off but his body froze as he saw the scene before him.
Fiona was right now on the dancing stage where many couples were dancing.
And she was actually dancing with that hateful guy from earlier, Jack instantly felt as if someone was twisting his heart, seeing the two so close.
"No, that bastard I am going to kill him!!" Jack was extremely angry, his face turned red.
On the other side, Vritra held Fiona's hand while his other hand rested on her waist as the two danced slowly to the rhythm.
Their bodies were tightly pressed together, their faces very close.
"Hehe darling, you are so naughty, you sure like making others jealous and stomping on their hearts."
Fiona said softly, she knew what Vritra had planned so she stuck even closer, pressing her body against his.
"His bad for desiring my wife, this is but the start." Vritra said with a smile, then he lowered his head, their faces getting dangerously close.
Seeing this from the distance, Jack almost fainted, he let out a heart-wrenching scream.
How could he just watch some random guy kiss the woman of his dreams, the one he loved for so long?
Watching their faces getting closer was like getting stabbed right in his heart, Jack rushed forward hastily to stop them.
He couldn't understand why Fiona, the woman of his dreams, would do this with a random person at that.
"Right, he must have hypnotized her or something, I have to save her!!" Jack screamed as he rushed forward, he couldn't let his future woman be touched by others.
But suddenly, something smashed into his head and made him fall.
Jack had no time to waste, he tried to get up as his gaze moved towards the dancing stage.
But it was already too late, under his gaze their lips met, as they started kissing softly.
While their lips gently moved, pressing together, Vritra glanced towards Jack.
Fiona just closed her eyes, she didn't really care for Jack, just enjoying kissing her darling.

Later, he was caught by several guards for stealing, and found out it was the treasury of the Ford family.
The zombie girl and Raino were with him too.
Currently, the guards forcefully took away all his glyphs and then Onest used his ability to steal everything from his inventory.
Even his personal stuff was stolen away.
"Stop you bastards, those are just my clothes!!" Jack shouted as not even his clothes were spared.
"Did you find everything inside?" Vritra looked at Rich and questioned.
"Yeah, there is more than he had stolen inside, should I return—" Rich was speaking but was interrupted.
"It's fine, just keep that all, think of it as his compensation."
Then the guards and Rich left, leaving Vritra, Onest, Shitless along with three others.
"What are you doing?
M- My stuff!!" Jack stared dazedly as he got looted in broad daylight and then he glared at Vritra.
He was a bit surprised internally to see someone so handsome.
"Who the hell are you?
How do you know me—" Jack was just speaking but he suddenly paused as his gaze drifted towards a table not far away.
And there, seated, was none other than his longtime crush, Fiona.
"F- Fiona?
Is that really her?" he stared at her in bewilderment, she certainly seemed more grown up and mature.
Not to mention far more beautiful than he remembered, he was completely frozen.
But upon seeing the gorgeous goddess beside Fiona, he became sure that he had finally found the two.
He quickly looked at the other women and didn't recognize Yasmine or Vanessa, while Teresa's face was covered.
Vanessa did seem a bit familiar but she too seemed to have changed so much that he could no longer recognize her.
But none of it mattered, he hurriedly ran towards that table.
Vritra was a bit surprised at first but upon seeing where Jack was headed, his lips curled up.
How could he not torture someone who was begging for it so badly?
Jack paused in front of Fiona and with a massive smile he spoke: "Fiona, I finally found you!!"
Fiona, who was just chatting with others, was startled and her icy gaze landed on a man whose face seemed familiar.
She thought for a few moments, but couldn't really remember, but then seeing those tattoos which were roughly covered up, she remembered.
"Jack?"
"I knew it, you remember me haha I missed you so much, how are you?
You missed me too right?
I never got to say it before, but I love you so much, what about you?"
In one breath, he said several things, his expression joyful.
He even spread his arms as if he was going to hug her.
Vritra shook his head, this guy was begging to be killed by eyeing his wife.
His body disappeared and he appeared on a seat between Fiona and Diana, there was a black sword in his hand that he extended towards Jack.
"Huh?"
Suddenly feeling something press against his throat, Jack paused mid-motion, his arms still stretched.
His gaze shifted to Vritra.
"It's you again, what do you want now?
Get lost, don't interrupt our reunion." Jack shouted angrily, trying to push the sword away but he couldn't even make it budge.
"Oh, do you know her?" Vritra asked, ready to crush his heart again.
"Of course, I love her... and I am sure she reciprocates my feelings.
Goddess, you remember me too, right?
I am the hero, are you happy to meet me?" his gaze shifted between Fiona and Diana quickly.
Both women looked extremely beautiful, Fiona was his first love but he also liked Diana a bit.
Still, this time he swore he would get Fiona.
But right then, Onest came and pinched his ear, dragging him away.
Vritra watched Jack get pulled away, the show was just beginning.
"What the fuck are you doing ouch ouch who the fuck are you?!!" Jack shouted angrily, his ear was almost torn off.
"Ah sorry sorry, I got the wrong person." Onest chuckled and let go of his ear, then walked away.
Jack was super mad, almost attacked Onest but right now Fiona was more important.
His gaze shifted back towards the table but there was no one now.
"Huh?
Where did they go?
Was it a dream?" Jack was confused, he even asked Raino about it and confirmed that Fiona was really there.
"Look, Fiona is there." Raino suddenly pointed in a direction, he was shocked at how beautiful Fiona had gotten, and she looked mature too.
She should still be in her early twenties just like them but she was already so graceful.
Jack turned happily, ready to run off but his body froze as he saw the scene before him.
Fiona was right now on the dancing stage where many couples were dancing.
And she was actually dancing with that hateful guy from earlier, Jack instantly felt as if someone was twisting his heart, seeing the two so close.
"No, that bastard I am going to kill him!!" Jack was extremely angry, his face turned red.
On the other side, Vritra held Fiona's hand while his other hand rested on her waist as the two danced slowly to the rhythm.
Their bodies were tightly pressed together, their faces very close.
"Hehe darling, you are so naughty, you sure like making others jealous and stomping on their hearts."
Fiona said softly, she knew what Vritra had planned so she stuck even closer, pressing her body against his.
"His bad for desiring my wife, this is but the start." Vritra said with a smile, then he lowered his head, their faces getting dangerously close.
Seeing this from the distance, Jack almost fainted, he let out a heart-wrenching scream.
How could he just watch some random guy kiss the woman of his dreams, the one he loved for so long?
Watching their faces getting closer was like getting stabbed right in his heart, Jack rushed forward hastily to stop them.
He couldn't understand why Fiona, the woman of his dreams, would do this with a random person at that.
"Right, he must have hypnotized her or something, I have to save her!!" Jack screamed as he rushed forward, he couldn't let his future woman be touched by others.
But suddenly, something smashed into his head and made him fall.
Jack had no time to waste, he tried to get up as his gaze moved towards the dancing stage.
But it was already too late, under his gaze their lips met, as they started kissing softly.
While their lips gently moved, pressing together, Vritra glanced towards Jack.
Fiona just closed her eyes, she didn't really care for Jack, just enjoying kissing her darling.

chapters.title: Chapter 594 Apology
paragraphs: "Noooooooooo!!" Fallen to his knees, Jack let out a scream, his heart once again broken.
He could only watch as his long-time crush kissed some unknown guy passionately. He could feel the love between them.
'Fionaaa, what has he done to you? I- It must be some trick, I can still save her...' Jack barely stood on his feet, killing intent surging in his heart.
He really wanted to kill Vritra at this moment.
Back on the dance floor, Vritra's lips moved along Fiona's, their tongues grazing against one another.
He gazed at Jack from the corner of his eyes and laughed internally.
Their lips separated, Vritra then kissed her cheek and then his lips pressed against her creamy smooth neck.
Fiona let out a faint moan, as Vritra pulled back, she looked into his eyes.
A beautiful smile on her face, then she leaned forward and pressed her lips against his, softly kissing him.
Jack received yet another blow. Fiona was even taking the initiative to kiss this guy.
They danced for a few more seconds, then Fiona softly changed position with Diana, as she moved to stand beside Yasmine and the others.
'W- What is he...' Jack stared in bafflement as the goddess's body pressed against Vritra.
He couldn't believe the sight before him. No way the goddess would also be tricked or hypnotized by him, right?
But in the next moment, their lips met in a short but steamy kiss, as the gorgeous Diana reciprocated.
After that, Diana changed position with Vanessa and moved out of the dancing floor.
"Honey, you sure know how to break him and make him jealous." Vanessa spoke softly, their noses touching, their bodies pressed tightly.
"He is asking for it." Vritra shook his head, then he kissed his mother, taking her soft red lips into his mouth.
Vanessa released a soft muffled moan, as she tasted her son, their lips rubbing and their tongues dancing along.
Jack stared in complete bafflement, stood frozen and couldn't believe anything.
Right after Vanessa, it was Yasmine's turn. She giggled, knowing her hubby's plan, and took the initiative to kiss him.
Each of the women that had kissed Vritra was super gorgeous, so beautiful that no one back on Earth could even come close.
Yet all of them were in a relationship with him?
Then taking Yasmine's hand, he walked away, as all his wives followed.
He didn't kiss Teresa there since her face was covered by a veil, although it was just an illusion.
Jack once again fell to his knees. He knew something was definitely wrong but couldn't pinpoint it.
Jumping to his feet, he hurriedly ran towards the group. His heart felt as if it was about to burst, intense jealousy filled him.
"Fiona, goddess, what has he done to you all? Why are you with him?" Getting close, Jack shouted.
But just then an announcement rang out.
"We will now be calling the groom on the stage." It was Shen, as always making the announcement, standing beside a priest.
The same one who was present in Teresa's marriage. He was sweating heavily and wanted to just get over with this marriage.
Soon, a young good-looking boy started walking towards the stage along with his friends.
Vritra had never seen him before, so he didn't pay much attention.
He looked around and his senses locked onto his enemies. Oracle was back again, though in a different outfit this time.

"This is Jean Trant, the most outstanding young man in the entire world. He has defeated everyone in every competition, and I can say that no one else is better for my daughter than him." Shen spoke, looking extremely proud.
Vritra raised an eyebrow. This young guy was at the general rank and seemed good at fighting.
'Well whatever, it is about time we start the real show.' He thought.
The young man in question appeared extremely proud. He looked around as if the entire world was beneath him.
His family had already been absorbed by the Fords, so he would be becoming a live-in son-in-law.
His gaze landed on Vritra. Although he had married one generation higher into the family, since their ages weren't too far apart, Jean couldn't help but feel competitive.
Raising his nose high, he pointed a finger at Vritra and then gestured for him to get close.
'Sigh, some people just couldn't live in peace. He hasn't even become a Ford and already wants to fight me.' Vritra thought and just ignored him.
"Why? WHY? Fiona, answer me, why this guy? I know you love me, he hypnotized you, right? Don't you recognize me, I am Jack! H- How can you just kiss..." Jack couldn't care less about the marriage.
"Huh? Have you finally gone crazy? Of course I love him, and there has just been one person in my life, my husband." Fiona said with a frown, hugging Vritra's arm.
"Wha-? How is that just one person? Weren't you with Vritra before and now him? How could you do this to me?" he spoke, as tears started to fall down his cheeks.
"Whatever, don't disturb us. You look ugly and you stink. Go somewhere else. Any girl would rather remain single than be with you." Fiona said, then ignored him.
Jack clutched his chest, his heart gravely wounded, but he couldn't accept the rejection.
On the other side, Jean frowned seeing Vritra just ignore him.
He leaned towards one of his friends and asked: "Isn't that Teresa's husband? Who are those women around him? What relation does he have with them?"
"Yes, he is Art Yate, and those women are Vanessa Arclis, Yasmine, Fiona Arclis, Diana Arclis and of course Teresa." Came the answer.
"Hah, so shameless. He is here and still mingling with other women, acting so proud. Let's show him his place." Jean spoke, he just felt jealous.
The reason obviously being the difference between Teresa and Tiny.
As Jean had climbed onto the stage, Shen's voice rang out again: "Now, let's call the most beautiful girl in the world, my daughter, Tiny Ford!!"
Many people let out loud cheers as the sky filled with beautiful firecrackers.
Everyone looked around but couldn't find the bride.
Vritra leaned towards Teresa and asked: "Where is this niece of yours? Is she not coming?"
Her presence was important for his plan, otherwise how could he mentally torture Sir Giant.
"Oh uhm, she is coming." Teresa pointed towards the sky, and soon everyone saw a woman whose height didn't even reach three feet.
Wearing a long bride dress, she looked quite strange.
'Tiny for a reason, huh.' Vritra was actually surprised. He didn't think the name was literally her description.
Jean looked at his future wife, who wasn't even half of him, and then back towards Teresa, the most beautiful woman to exist.
Two hearts in the venue were bubbling over with rage and jealousy, and their single enemy was Vritra.
"Pfft." Vritra chuckled a bit, then he pointed towards Jean and Tiny and gave a thumbs up.
Saying it was a match made in heaven.
"You!! Father, he insulted me. Call him here now to apologize or I won't go forward with this marriage." Suddenly, Jean looked at Shen and demanded.
He was sure that with the Ford's power, even Art could do nothing.

chapters.title: Chapter 595 The Devil's Return
paragraphs: "W- What?" Shen was startled. Upon seeing who Jean was talking about, he shivered.
"Cough What misunderstanding is there? Anyway, let's not waste time and continue with the marriage." Shen said, hurrying the priest.
"He insulted me, you have to punish him for me or what would others think." Jean said angrily.
"Oh, and how did he insult you?" Shen rubbed his temples, as his daughter arrived.
"H- He said..." Jean was at a loss for words. How could he say what Vritra had said?
Vritra had complimented the two's bond, and it got him angry.
"Anyway, do something." He said after a moment.
"..." Shen only now thought that along with all other requirements, they should have properly administered the behaviour of the candidates.
Tiny jumped onto the small wooden tile, giving a big smile and said: "Priest, hurry up and get it over with, I can't keep my boyfriends waiting."
The bride had one bad habit, she loved having male slaves around her at all times.
Hearing this, the expressions of the three men on the stage changed.
"Shh, didn't I tell you not to say that?" Shen muttered.
"Let's go and meet her now." Oracle spoke, as he walked towards Teresa.
"Hello Teresa, I am Oracle. I am sure you must have heard about me, right? Anyway, today I have come to meet you for an important task." He said seriously.
Teresa turned to look at him, staying silent. She still held Vritra's arm.
"As you might have seen, our planet is in great danger right now and I think only you can help us solve this problem.
So, just to save all those pitiful people, would you like to join the Golden Moon? I can instantly make you one of the seats." He added.
"No, I don't want to." Teresa said firmly, and turned away.
"H- Huh? Don't you want to help everyone? Are you just going to watch them die?" Oracle was truly shocked. He was sure she would instantly agree when he mentioned the people.
"And why does my wife need to join your shady group to do that? She can save everyone on her own, and you still stink, stay away from us."
Vritra spoke as he pulled Teresa behind him and stepped forward.
Teresa smiled, feeling his protectiveness. The Fords had always protected her too, but this was a completely different feeling. She hugged his arm even tighter.
"I am not talking to you, and you don't decide for her. If I have said she will join, then she will." Oracle said arrogantly, ready for battle.
"Is that so? But wouldn't it be a waste to join Golden Moon when it isn't going to survive more than a day?" Vritra sighed pitifully.
"Oh, is that a threat? You think the Fords could protect you? It seems I will have to deal with you first to make her join." Oracle said.
But Sir Giant, seeing the situation, hurriedly came to stop the fight, and Oracle stopped for now.
"Your grandson-in-law, he isn't going to live long with that arrogance." Oracle spoke, brimming with rage.
"But I agree with him, Teresa is not going to join the Golden Moon. Don't pull her into all this power play and danger." Sir Giant said sternly.
"Let's talk after the marriage and you- huh? Where did he go?" Oracle looked towards Vritra only to find he was no longer there.
"Haha, did I scare away your family's son-in-law? He sure knows how to run." Oracle laughed and shook his head, then turned towards the stage.
"Sigh..." Sir Giant just sighed.
On the stage, Shen and Jean were surprised too upon not finding Vritra.
The marriage was about to begin but suddenly the sky was filled with even louder firecrackers, the sky completely illuminated.
Everyone was surprised. Shouldn't such a show start after the marriage is complete?
"What's going on? Go check it out." Shen frowned, ordering one of the servants.
Suddenly, everything seemed to be going bad at the wedding, but just then a very loud announcement rang out.
"An important guest has arrived, from a faraway place, back after a long time. None other than..." there was a pause as everyone began to discuss.
None could think who could be getting such a grand welcome. Not a single person had been welcomed in such a manner before.
Suddenly the large hall was enveloped by darkness, all gazes turned towards the entrance.
And finally the last words of the announcement sounded:
"Vritra Arclis has arrived at the marriage!!"
There was pin-drop silence in the entire hall. Many had already forgotten that name.
But those who remembered felt their hearts tremble just at the mention.
After all, it was none other than the demon who had destroyed an entire continent previously and single-handedly killed over a million people and so many lords.
"W- What kind of joke is this? Who is playing around? Go arrest them!!" Oracle shouted. He almost peed again after hearing this name.
But then he shook his head. There was no way that guy could be back from the dead, not after receiving the god's punishment.
Suddenly, he started to feel a strong itch in his throat and belly, as if something inside him was churning.
"What is going on? Vritra Arclis? Who is trying to ruin this marriage?!!" Sir Giant shouted angrily.
Within a few seconds, everyone had remembered who exactly Vritra Arclis was.
"N- No way that demon is alive, right? Right? GULP, won't he just kill everyone?" someone in the crowd muttered.
"H- Hey, I heard Vritra wasn't actually at fault and had even saved many people before. Didn't you hear, even the empress said that." Someone voiced their thoughts.
"No way, didn't he destroy the continent and kill the entire army? How do you explain that?"
All sorts of discussions broke out as the tension rose.
Sir Giant had himself seen Vritra's corpse, so he too didn't believe he could actually be back.
It seemed someone was playing a sick joke or ruining the marriage.
But just then a silhouette appeared near the entrance amidst the darkness, the breath of all the people collectively stopped.
STEP
STEP
The sound of his steps reverberated. People moved away as he entered, everyone just stared nervously.
After walking halfway into the hall, he stopped. Suddenly lights fell on him, illuminating his figure.
And the face that no one could forget appeared before everyone once again.
Vritra Arclis was standing before them all.
There were two horns on his head, and a bloody aura surrounded his body. The floor cracked under his feet.
Above, Onest and Shitless were handling the lights for the dramatic entry.
Oracle's body shivered, his face turned white as he stumbled and fell on his butt, muttering something.
"T- This isn't possible, he isn't alive. This is a fake, a clone, n- no, who is doing this? Yes, this must be a nightmare." Oracle was traumatized as he shivered.
In the crowd, Kryn, who had been hidden all along, also felt goosebumps, fear creeping into his heart.
Sir Giant too stood frozen on the stage. This person was definitely Vritra Arclis.
The same face, and even the presence. There was no doubt, he had actually risen from the dead.
"Hello everyone, mind if I crash into this wedding?" There was a faint smile on his face.
But his appearance alone had sent everyone into a dreadful state.
