"Vritra Arclis has arrived at the marriage!!"
There was pin-drop silence in the entire hall.
Many had already forgotten that name.
But those who remembered felt their hearts tremble just at the mention.
After all, it was none other than the demon who had destroyed an entire continent previously and single-handedly killed over a million people and so many lords.
"W- What kind of joke is this?
Who is playing around?
Go arrest them!!" Oracle shouted.
He almost peed again after hearing this name.
But then he shook his head.
There was no way that guy could be back from the dead, not after receiving the god's punishment.
Suddenly, he started to feel a strong itch in his throat and belly, as if something inside him was churning.
"What is going on?
Vritra Arclis?
Who is trying to ruin this marriage?!!" Sir Giant shouted angrily.
Within a few seconds, everyone had remembered who exactly Vritra Arclis was.
"N- No way that demon is alive, right?
Right?
GULP, won't he just kill everyone?" someone in the crowd muttered.
"H- Hey, I heard Vritra wasn't actually at fault and had even saved many people before.
Didn't you hear, even the empress said that." Someone voiced their thoughts.
"No way, didn't he destroy the continent and kill the entire army?
How do you explain that?"
All sorts of discussions broke out as the tension rose.
Sir Giant had himself seen Vritra's corpse, so he too didn't believe he could actually be back.
It seemed someone was playing a sick joke or ruining the marriage.
But just then a silhouette appeared near the entrance amidst the darkness, the breath of all the people collectively stopped.
STEP
STEP
The sound of his steps reverberated.
People moved away as he entered, everyone just stared nervously.
After walking halfway into the hall, he stopped.
Suddenly lights fell on him, illuminating his figure.
And the face that no one could forget appeared before everyone once again.
Vritra Arclis was standing before them all.
There were two horns on his head, and a bloody aura surrounded his body.
The floor cracked under his feet.
Above, Onest and Shitless were handling the lights for the dramatic entry.
Oracle's body shivered, his face turned white as he stumbled and fell on his butt, muttering something.
"T- This isn't possible, he isn't alive.
This is a fake, a clone, n- no, who is doing this?
Yes, this must be a nightmare." Oracle was traumatized as he shivered.
In the crowd, Kryn, who had been hidden all along, also felt goosebumps, fear creeping into his heart.
Sir Giant too stood frozen on the stage.
This person was definitely Vritra Arclis.
The same face, and even the presence.
There was no doubt, he had actually risen from the dead.
"Hello everyone, mind if I crash into this wedding?" There was a faint smile on his face.
But his appearance alone had sent everyone into a dreadful state.

chapters.title: Chapter 596 A Disgusting Monster
paragraphs: Slowly the darkness receded from within the hall as everyone stood frozen, all their gazes fixed onto just a single figure.
No one could believe what they were seeing, how could someone who had died over three years ago be back.
'No no, this has to be a joke, a nightmare!! Don't tell me I am still asleep after that sick dream last night?'
Oracle wanted to slap himself but because of fear, it was hard to move even a muscle.
"..." Vritra's gaze swept over the entire hall, seeing the shock in everyone's eyes.
From Sir Giant, Oracle, Kryn and even the members of Twilight.
The murmurs of the guests had instantly turned silent, but the music continued to ring out in the background, making the whole scene more horrific.
"It is good to meet you all, hope you have not forgotten me." Vritra finally spoke, the faint smile on his handsome face made others dread.
"But before that..." he looked around as if searching for someone.
Someone who hadn't made her appearance since he arrived at this wedding, and soon he found her sitting in a corner.
None other than the bitch Sakshi, Tiny's mother, and a woman with the gutter of a mouth.
Rich had made sure that she didn't spoil the wedding so she was sent away early on.
Suddenly a tiny ball of dust formed in front of him and before Sakshi even knew what was going on, it smashed into her face.
BANG
Her nose instantly twisted, and she was thrown backwards, wondering why she was the first to be hit.
"Anyway," Vritra turned around as if nothing had happened, and looked straight at Sir Giant.
"Shall we settle some debts?" as Vritra spoke, Sir Giant shivered. His entire family was here, and he was way weaker than he was in the war several years ago.
Remembering the horror of that demon, he knew if it was really Vritra, then everyone here would be buried with him.
"V- V- Vritra?!!" Jack stared in bafflement as deep fear rose in his heart.
"No this isn't real, Vritra is dead. Who are you, why are you trying to imitate him?" Oracle finally cleared his mind, and finally relaxed.
"Is that so?" Vritra suddenly shifted his gaze and then his body disappeared, appearing right in front of Oracle.
"Is it really that hard to believe?" while speaking he patted Oracle's shoulder lightly, but a faint wisp of energy entered his body.
Sir Giant stared at him, even though so many years had passed, he could never forget a moment of that war.
And sensing the energy, it was definitely Vritra.
"H- How are you back? Didn't you die all that time ago?" Sir Giant couldn't help but ask, despite the fear in his heart.
Knowing that they stood no chance against this monstrous entity, he knew the chances of survival were nil.
But he just wanted to safely move his family.
Looking at Rich, Tiny, Shen and finally at Teresa, he had to move all of them away at any cost.
'Where did Art go? I have to protect him too.' He thought, despite the conflict between them, Art was still his grandson-in-law.
How could he allow him to die in this place.
"Well I will have to thank my good friend, Oracle, for that. Although he put on quite a show for you all, but from the beginning he was on my side."
Vritra spoke, as all the gazes moved onto the baffled Oracle.
None in the crowd dared to speak or move, they weren't even sure if they could survive this.
Fully aware of how much damage the continent had suffered all that time ago, they were already filled with despair.
The priest on the stage cursed his luck, he should not have come here at any cost.
At first he had refused to come but because of the high rewards, he had come in the end.
It was his greed which brought him to his death, he regretted not forgetting about worldly pleasures as a priest.
"What lies are you s- spouting, when did I help you?" Oracle instantly shouted, trying to find a way to escape from there.
"Haha, quite the actor aren't you? Well there is no longer a need to pretend, why don't you show everyone your true form?" Vritra said as he flashed away and stood with his arms folded.
'What does this mean?' Sir Giant and all others looked doubtfully at Oracle, still too shocked at the sudden arrival of a dead person.
"Stop! Don't you-" but just as he was speaking, Oracle suddenly felt something twisting in his body.
He vomited several mouthfuls of black blood instantly and extreme pain shot through his body as every bone in his body began to break, his flesh splitting.
Under everyone's terrifying gaze, Oracle's body started to mutate, turning into a demonic figure as dark energy seeped out of his body.
A loud ear-piercing scream rang out, making the people cover their ears as they moved back in fear.
"H- How can this be? Oracle was a demon all along?!!"
All the people received the second shock of the day, how could their protector itself be an enemy?
Then what fate awaited them all if that very protector was a demon?
Even the people from Golden Moon, the other five seats and others looked terrified, quickly moving away from the terrifying monster.
After rising to a height of over ten feet, Oracle's transformation finally ended.
His reddish muscles were bursting as blood veins were constantly exploding, he was pushed into this form forcefully.
Of course it was because of the thing he made Oracle drink earlier.
"Good, there is no longer a need to be afraid. Show your might, Demon Oracle." Vritra chuckled as he saw Oracle scream constantly in pain.
He felt an intense hunger, it made him feel as if he was dying and countless insects were eating him from inside.
Oracle's body was bursting with power at this moment as he juiced every bit of his power and potential.
After the transformation ended, he would lose it all.
His gaze moved around, and quickly landed on a man.
Stomping the ground, he jumped and before the other person could react, he grabbed and bit down hard.
Amidst the screams, the sound of flesh being torn and bones cracking rang out, this man was none other than Kryn.
Of course he had just taken over a human body, as soon as his shell was broken, he was about to come out.
But Vritra not only wanted to torture him physically but mentally also.
Trample over his reputation and turn him into a cannibal monster.
No one noticed as darkness flashed and Hellmancer quickly dragged Kryn away, the poor guy had no chance.
But instead of killing him instantly, Hellmancer sent him through inhumane torture.
After all he was also one of the participants in the war all those years ago.
After a long torture he would simply be devoured.
On the other side everyone stared in bafflement as Oracle turned into a human-eating monster, everyone fleeing away.
While the one suffering the most was obviously Oracle, not only was he enduring the extreme physical pain.
But even the disgust and mental trauma, watching as everyone who respected and feared him looked at him with disgust.

chapters.title: Chapter 597 Cannibal
paragraphs: The foul taste of human flesh filled Oracle's mouth as intestines and internal organs hung from his mouth.
It was a terrifying scene, but despite the trauma and dread, Oracle could no longer control his body.
While devouring one human, he instantly jumped towards one of the other seats, picking him up amidst the resistance.
Many of the people began to launch attacks upon noticing that escaping from this hall was impossible for some reason.

Oracle screamed even more as the attacks hit him, his defences had reduced to the lowest, it was as if the layer of skin had been removed and everyone was directly hitting against his flesh and nerves.
He roared and crushed the head of another person, eating the flesh and brain matter.
Oracle felt extreme disgust, he wanted to tear apart his own mouth, he was performing cannibalism right.
Sir Giant, dreaded, reacted quickly and along with other Ford members he quickly began to launch attacks.
Vritra stood there with a smile, watching the whole scene play out.
If he had killed them himself it would be no fun, but he enjoyed their dread, the despair and the confusion.
Turning Oracle into this man-eating monster was truly a fantastic idea.
Of course, he was not going to let that monster just devour everyone, he was only feeding the ones he wanted to kill.
Suddenly, while munching over two men, the monster jumped in front of Jack.
"W- Wha-?" the young hero staggered back and instantly peed, his strength was way too weak. He wanted to run but couldn't move.
Just then the space energy began to ripple beside him as if he was about to be pulled into it.
'Oh, his fate is trying to save him, it is really quite handy.' Vritra thought, after all, until Jack had killed a demon lord, the planet itself was protecting him.
But how could Vritra just allow him to escape, without wasting a moment, he threw Jack into the dimensional book.
The large monster just punched the ground, hitting nothing.
Seeing its prey missing, Oracle roared madly while internally trying to stop himself, his mind was a mess.
It was worse than any nightmare, he couldn't control himself but could feel everything clearly.
"Oracle, you bastard, stop right now!!" Sir Giant shouted but no matter how many attacks landed on his body, after getting damaged he just healed rapidly.
Sir Giant looked around fearfully, he then shouted at Shen: "Take Rich, Tiny and Teresa, escape. I will try to hold them back if possible, also have you seen Art?"
"No, I didn't but h- how could I just-" Shen couldn't leave his grandfather behind, he was really in a dilemma.
"This is an order, take them and leave or our entire family will be killed. Hurry!!" Sir Giant angrily shouted, each moment was bringing them closer to death.
ROOOAAARRRRRRRRRRR
Suddenly, Oracle jumped towards Sir Giant and punched hard.
BOOOM
Instantly, the old man's body was blasted away, smashing into the ground.
Shen gritted his teeth, but after a moment he turned and moved towards Tiny.
He glanced around but also couldn't find Rich around, while his wife lay in one of the corners, lying like a lump.
Protecting others took priority so he just left her be for now, moving hurriedly towards the stage.
Tiny and Jean were frozen stiff on the stage beside the priest.
"H- Hurry up, p- protect me. You bastard slave, what are you s- spacing out for?!!" Tiny shouted as she jumped and slapped Jean's face.
Jean was brought back to his senses as anger flooded him. Yes, despite everyone thinking so highly of him, he was nothing more than Tiny's slave.
A husband who would follow her around like a dog, along with many of her other slaves.
But now that death was so close he couldn't take it anymore, he kicked the Tiny girl away, shouting: "You damn slut, die along with your whore mother, fuck!"
He moved back instantly as he saw the large flesh monster jumping up towards the stage.
"Uwaaaaaah" the priest screamed and ran away.
Sir Giant and Shen were filled with fear as they watched the giant monster rushing towards Tiny.
They both screamed and rushed forward, Shen got close first but the monster just slapped him away.
Sir Giant, charging every bit of his strength, desperately rushed forward, even burning his life force.
He charged the strongest punch he could launch and aimed towards the flesh monster.
But just as he was about to get close to Tiny, something wrapped around his feet and pulled back forcefully, as his face smashed into the floor.
He tried to break free but the sticky black substance clung to his feet, making it impossible for him to move.
He hurriedly looked back and saw Vritra's wide smile and instantly a scene played back in his mind.
Previously, when Vritra was rushing forward to save who he thought was his mother, it was at the end Sir Giant who stopped him.
He too felt his desperation and struggle but only now understood how it felt to be on the other end.
Regret and pain flooded his heart, he turned towards Tiny, and could only scream, watching in despair and helplessness as the monster raised his feet.
"Nooooooooo stop stop Oracle, Vritra I am begging you stop-" he screamed as tears streamed down his face.
"S- Save me SOB helpppp fatherrrr great grandpa, save me I don't want to die aaaaaahh-" Tiny screamed in despair as the ugly monster came dangerously close to her.
BOOOOOM!!
But in the next moment a loud sound rang out and instantly pieces of flesh and bones flew around and Tiny's pleading for help suddenly came to a halt.
Both Shen and Sir Giant felt as if someone had ripped their hearts out as their bodies went limp, their red eyes staring blankly.
As Oracle raised his feet, the minced meat and organs stuck and stretched. Without caring, he rushed towards the members of the Golden Moon, eating them up.
"Kill me just kill me, I c- couldn't protect her, my little buttercup SOB aaaaaah" Sir Giant screamed in despair, before fainting from the extreme mental distress.
In the distance, Shen was experiencing something similar, his face breaking into tears as he fell with no strength.
But then pushed himself up, he still needed to save his son and sister.
"Good good, old man, wake up, did you like it?" Vritra laughed, enjoying the sight.
Of course, because of Teresa, he had decided not to kill them so Tiny was still alive.
Vritra flashed before Sir Giant and threw some boiling water over his body, which was at an extreme temperature.
Immediately bringing him back to consciousness.
"Uwaaaah" Sir Giant screamed, his eyes bloodshot, it seemed he wanted to die.
"G- Great Grandpa, h- help meeeeee" suddenly, Tiny's voice sounded again.
Sir Giant, startled, quickly looked towards the stage and she was actually still standing there in her wedding dress.
"H- How can this be? T- Tiny...?" Sir Giant couldn't understand anything, but while laughing Vritra cleared his doubts.
"Oh that previously was just an illusion, go hurry and save her. She is really about to die." While speaking he removed the restrictions of the goop.
And Sir Giant was finally able to move. He was overjoyed and filled with dread at the same time.
But this time he was going to save her for sure.
'Haha this sure is fun, let's see how long he can handle this.' Vritra was enjoying the whole thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 598 Clean up
paragraphs: Sir Giant rushed to save Tiny once again from the raging monster, desperation filling his eyes.
But just as he reached close, once again, goop bound to his feet and pulled him back, stopping him at just the last moment.
"Aaaaah S- Save me uwaaaa-"
BOOOM!
Again, the same scene played out as she turned into minced meat under the monster's feet, dying a gruesome death.
Yet again, Sir Giant felt like dying as he screamed in despair, and Vritra just watched the scene in satisfaction.
But it was far from over, as Tiny once again pleaded for her father and great grandfather to save her.
Sir Giant couldn't understand what was happening nor did he have the time, but he just wanted to save her.
Again and again, Tiny kept dying, sometimes getting devoured, sometimes just getting stomped.
Vritra tortured the old man mentally, after just a few experiences he looked even older.
"SOB What are you d- doing? Please I b- beg you, don't hurt her. J- Just kill me..." Sir Giant pleaded as he once again saw Tiny die.
"Haha yes, so far all of them have been mere illusions, but from now on be careful.
I will no longer stop you so save her if you can, oh also, any of the illusions just might be reality." He spoke and turned his gaze away.
And then, Sir Giant rushed forward, barely protecting Tiny only to find the cycle repeat.
His heart was full of dread because of Vritra's words, after all any of this could be real.
Vritra left Sir Giant to keep trying, this much payback was enough, and just like he had planned, he didn't kill them.
Looking at the Golden Moon, most of whose seats were already dead, Vritra pondered.
And soon his gaze landed on Big Guy, who was shivering in the hall, praying that Vritra wouldn't find him.
"Hey big guy, how you doing?" Vritra instantly flashed away, appearing before the frightened seat.
"V- Vritra? How are you still alive?" he couldn't help but ask, there was no point in fighting so he didn't even try.
"Does that really matter?" he asked, but then Fiona appeared.
"Darling, let me take care of this one." She was furious at all these people for hurting Vritra and almost killing him.
For separating them for so long, if she had enough strength before, she would have burned down the entire Golden Moon before.
"Hmm alright, just don't make it take long." He said stepping back, as Fiona's body got covered by blood-red flames.
"Of course, just let me handle this." She spoke, and soon began to torture the big guy who begged and couldn't even commit suicide.
Vritra looked around, there were still a few people who weren't here yet, like Red and that demon glutton.
He planned to kill them later, for now he decided to clean up the human trash, the present members of the Twilight.
With a snap of his finger, all members of Twilight started to float. It was actually quite easy to find them, they all had the same exact stench.
"Ahhhhh S- Spare us, we did n- nothing wrong"
"L- Lord Vritra, we are on the same side!! We aren't with these people aaaaah"
All those people screamed in terror, completely losing any control of their bodies, and were pulled away from the crowd.
Vritra rolled his eyes, just because he is a demon, does that put him at the same level as these scum?
"Oh, you think we are equal or I am like you people?" he instantly pulled the person forward, his terrifying gaze piercing directly into his soul.
"A- Aahhhh I didn't mean- uwaaaaaaah" in the next instant his body was thrown away, as the big monster jumped and caught him like a dog.
Then he tore his limbs, slowly munching on him as the man continued to scream.
Vritra felt no pity for such waste, they had tortured and killed so many people.
The lives of others were nothing in their eyes, following illusory goals, they harmed everyone.
Calling another person forward, Vritra looked into his eyes and asked:
"How many people have you killed before?"
"Uh... I- I don't know SOB please I am innocent sir, spare me... I have a daughter and a wife, SOB I am begging you-"
Vritra shook his head and threw him away.
"Wrong answer."
Instantly the monster caught him and began feasting, internally Oracle was disgusted and broken, he just wanted everything to end.
But the one who would suffer the most among all these people was certainly him, his torture hadn't even properly begun.
Vritra threw many other people towards Oracle, as the others saw their fate, they started to break.
"Who among you has killed the most?" Vritra asked as he pulled another floating figure forward.
"I- I please, SOB it was him, he killed the most SOB please let me go, I really-"
Vritra nodded, and gave him a quick death then looked at the person who was the leader of this team.
After a moment, he pulled all ten or so remaining members of the Twilight, these people would be useful later on.
He threw them to the side, making it impossible for them to even speak.
He looked around and found that aside from Oracle, everyone had received their punishment.
"I guess, it is time to start." Vritra mumbled as his gaze landed on the monster who was still munching on flesh.
Oracle was already done killing the members of Twilight he had thrown.
With a snap of Vritra's finger, the monster's body exploded as all muscles and veins blasted apart.
Terrifying roars filled the hall as Oracle cried and screamed in pain, filling all the people in the hall with fear.
Those painful screams were like music to his ears, he smiled while watching as the giant figure slowly started to shrink.
Oracle returned to his human form but looked extremely weak, his skin was shrivelled up and there was barely any mana in his body.
His mana core was also broken, all his strength was already gone.
"Oracle, how do you feel?" Vritra smiled, watching the ugly figure.
But the poor thing couldn't even speak, so the kind Vritra took out a bottle of powerful healing potion and dropped it over Oracle's head.
And within a minute, his body visibly healed, he looked at Vritra with hate, fear, despair and many more emotions, but was helpless.
Of course the biggest feeling of all was regret, he regretted meeting this monster and going against him.
Feeling that even death would be a mercy.
"Now that's a look I like, alright since you behaved well as my pet, I will give you a reward and send you off with a unique experience."
Vritra said with a kind smile on his face which terrified Oracle even more.
He wanted to plead and beg for death, but couldn't speak in front of this terrifying devil.
Compared to a few years back, his presence was extremely terrifying.
He couldn't even fathom how strong Vritra had gotten in such a small time, and how he did it.
Not caring about his thoughts, Vritra looked towards the survivors from the Twilight.
And Oracle had a really bad feeling in his heart, he prayed again and again that the Divine Kage would come here and save him.
This demon could still be killed by the god's punishment right?

But just as he reached close, once again, goop bound to his feet and pulled him back, stopping him at just the last moment.
"Aaaaah S- Save me uwaaaa-"
BOOOM!
Again, the same scene played out as she turned into minced meat under the monster's feet, dying a gruesome death.

chapters.title: Chapter 599 Love Room
paragraphs: Oracle gazed towards the entrance, with their capability, the Divine Kage must already be aware of Vritra's return.
If only they could come, then there was still a chance of survival.
"Boys, come here." Vritra gestured, and the bodies of ten Twilight members floated towards him.
Using his natural hypnosis which was extremely powerful now, he commanded: "We need to send this good pet away happily and filled, can't let him die empty-handed and empty-stomached."
"W- What?" the leader of the group was equally terrified as their bodies slowly landed on their feet.
"Since this is a wedding, there should be some romance in the air." Vritra's smile widened, frightening the eleven men.
On the ground, Oracle kept wriggling and pleading. He knew he was in the wrong, he had made a big mistake, he wanted to apologize but it was already too late.
Not keeping them in suspense, Vritra spoke: "Alright, go take him inside and fuck him to death."
As soon as he spoke, the faces of all eleven of them turned white, especially Oracle.
Just thinking of something like that, how humiliating would it be? He tried to die but had no energy, he couldn't even move.
The Twilight members also wanted to beg but their bodies moved automatically, and they moved towards the pitiful Oracle.
All ten of them had big strong bodies and unlike Oracle they still had their full strength.
Everyone in the hall was terrified as they watched the ten men drag the leader of Golden Moon into a room.
Then even more screams sounded from inside, sounds of clothes getting torn, objects falling and then loud slapping.
The faces of all the people in the hall were full of disgust and terror, they imagined the scene of ten burly men forcing Oracle and couldn't help but vomit.
Now the place was filled with Oracle's muffled screams, several thumping sounds, and Sir Giant's shouts.
Vritra stood there, feeling that revenge really was enjoyable.
Just then he glanced towards the sky and saw several figures rushing inside.
Of course it was the people from the Divine Kage, they were finally here.
He sensed their strength and shook his head in disappointment as not one was under number fifty.
As soon as the twenty or so men had landed they were pressed into the ground, their flesh ripping and bones breaking.
They kept muttering different things in robotic voices, but were completely helpless and started to feel fear.
"Divine Kage, you people sure are very arrogant. Anyway, why don't you all join in the lovemaking of the special bride, go ahead inside and enjoy with the rest. Go and fuck each other to death."
In the next moment, their bodies moved on their own and they too entered the room.
Soon even more noises started to come out.
Before long, Sir Giant just fainted and could no longer endure the constant torture. So Vritra ended it, this much was fine, now he decided to let this family be, of course except that woman.
Looking to the corner he saw that she had already awakened and had sat up.
Shaking his head, he made her float as she screamed in an annoying voice, then Vritra just threw her far away.
She flailed her arms and legs, screaming in terror, but disappeared into the distance soon.
"Haa now all that's left is to let them fight among themselves, these people are quite fierce and hungry." Vritra chuckled as he heard the wild noises coming from inside.
He too was disgusted and kept his senses away from it, not wanting to see even a glance inside.
"DIEEEEEE!! YOU ALL DIE!!" Just then a scream rang out, startling all the people who were starting to relax.
Even Vritra looked over in surprise, and soon saw someone familiar.
"None of you deserve to live, I am going to obliterate everyone who killed her." The man shouted.
It was none other than Han Gratt, the person who secretly loved Yennefer, he had disappeared after the war too.
'Oh, how come he is here?' Vritra thought, and didn't react immediately, watching the madman.
Han's eyes were bloodshot and his hair was messy, it seemed he had really lost his mind.
"I am going to blast you all to pieces." He shouted and laughed madly.
For a long time he had searched for Yennefer everywhere but no matter what, he could never find her.
And in the end only one outcome remained, he understood that she might be dead, he might have lost her forever.
Only because of her he followed that emperor, even if he couldn't be with her, Han still wanted to support Yennefer in whatever way he could.
But now she was gone, he wanted everyone who had participated in the war to die.
He had been looking for a way to deal with them all, of course his strength was not enough, so he decided to use this chance.
Now that all these people were here, he wanted to blast them to pieces with the treasures he prepared.
"Hello there, long time no see, Han." Vritra floated up, his demonic figure exuding a deadly aura.
"H- Huh? Vritra, is that you? How are you, weren't you dead? Wha- Huh?" Han was truly shocked, staring wide-eyed.
But then he shook his head and asked urgently: "Yennefer, where is she?!!"
"...She is alive and with me, just leave and start a new life." Vritra said, he didn't hold any grudge against this guy.
Instead, in the war Han had fought from their side because of Yennefer.
"She is alive?!! Really? Where is she? I want to see her once." Han immediately asked, he was overjoyed and could live peacefully with just that information.
"Sigh, because of current circumstances, she can't meet you. Anyway, do you wanna join?" Vritra smiled, and pointed towards the room in the distance.
Even if Yennefer was already back, he wouldn't like Han getting anywhere near her.
Even if they had known each other before, now that she was his and with Vritra's possessive nature, how could he let Han near her?
Han was a bit surprised as he focused on the strange mix of noises coming from that room.
Frowning he focused as his senses scanned inside and instantly his face turned pale and he vomited.
There was an orgy going on inside with so many men and the scene was very revolting and foul.
"N- No, but is Yennefer really back?" Han couldn't understand anything but was only concerned about this.
"Yes, she is alive. With me here, you don't have to worry or even think about her. Now leave." Vritra said, his eyes narrowing.
Han lingered around a bit longer as if he had a lot of questions, but in the end he just nodded and turned around.
"By the way, here, I planned to use this to blow up this realm." Before leaving, Han threw a glyph towards Vritra and then left.
Vritra floated for a couple of minutes, then he returned to the ground.
He didn't want to disturb the people in the room and allowed all the guests to leave first, they would spread the news of Oracle and make him even more famous.
Vritra was just walking towards his wives when he suddenly felt a faint sensation and in the next moment the tiny piece of pill in his inventory broke.

chapters.title: Chapter 600 Bad Revenge
paragraphs: Vritra had just taken a couple of steps when he suddenly noticed a slight change inside his dimensional book.
Quickly, he scanned and was surprised to see the tiny pill breaking apart.
Instantly joy and excitement filled his heart, looking up at his wives, he didn't explain anything and just said:
"Handle everything here, I will be back soon."
Vanessa and the others stared at him in surprise and before they could even ask, Vritra disappeared.
"What happened?" Diana looked at the others in confusion, and soon they all looked at Yasmine, who could easily see what Vritra was seeing or talk to him internally.
After a moment her eyes widened in surprise as she mumbled: "Yennefer is back!!"
Inside the dimensional book, Vritra quickly got close to the pill that was starting to crack up.
It only took a few moments and finally it disintegrated, leaving behind a weak wisp of energy.
"It's her soul!" Vritra exclaimed, surprised at how weak and close to death she actually was.
With so little strength and energy, she couldn't even regain consciousness and very soon would really die.
Vritra's heart thumped wildly as he pulled out thousands of bottles of soul potions.
Then changing their form from liquid to pure energy he moved it towards the soul, letting it strengthen and heal her.
Using Nihil Anima, Vritra surrounded her soul, making the mythic halo nourish her soul and protect it.
Without wasting a moment, he continued to pour more and more energy, frantically pouring it all into her soul.
And slowly, the soul's strength began to increase as her consciousness started to return.
Dozens of minutes passed and Vritra didn't stop until the strength of her soul had reached the general rank.
Finally she was safe, wiping the sweat from his forehead he took several long breaths, his heart beating rapidly.
"Haa it almost feels like I have become a doctor and just performed the most difficult and critical surgery."
But with his physique, he calmed down within moments. Then he looked up at the soul, the silhouette was translucent but clearly, it was her!
That gorgeous and graceful empress, her eyes were still closed while her aura got stronger and stronger.
Vritra waited, still feeling a little nervous; right now this was his biggest worry, if she could return, his family would finally be complete... for now.
A few silent moments passed, the beautiful figure continued to float, even now she had that oppressive aura.
Out of all his wives, she was the one who showed little emotion, but also loved dominating him in bed.
A few tense moments later, her eyes fluttered and slowly, Yennefer opened her eyes.
As her blue eyes opened, she appeared dazed and confused, Vritra just waited.
As clarity returned to her eyes, she looked around with questions rising in her eyes.
And finally her gaze fixed on Vritra, she was surprised and without a word she flew close to him.
"Husband!!" Yennefer tried to hug him but her body just passed through Vritra's, leaving her baffled.
And only now did she notice her condition, after looking down, her adorable face looked confused.
Her mature and voluptuous figure trembled.
"W- What's happening? Husband?" she looked up at Vritra, who had turned to face her.
"Yenni, welcome back..." Vritra smiled, he almost felt like crying seeing her again, but no tears were coming, thankfully.
Otherwise, crybaby would be activated for no reason.
"Huh? I was... a dream? Didn't I die?" Yennefer looked up at Vritra, still wondering if it was the afterlife.
After she saved Vritra, her body was destroyed and even her soul didn't survive as darkness consumed her vision.
But suddenly, she was in a very long and beautiful dream.
A dream in which only she and Vritra were present, they lived alone together on a mountain.
Like loving husband and wife, just like they lived in that divine realm. She had spent exactly a year in that dream.
Despite everything, she was just happy to be with the one person she loved the most.
After losing him once, she never wanted to be separated.
"Yenni, this is real. I am real and so are you." Vritra stepped forward, raising his hand to touch her cheek but she was just a soul after all.
"I didn't die?" after confusion drifted away, a beautiful smile appeared on her face.
Her heart was full of warmth and happiness as she gazed at her husband. She had lost hope and thought that they would be separated forever.
But she was just happy that he was safe.
"Yes, you didn't. There are a lot of things you need to know, but first let's go out." Vritra had a big smile on his face, he was just so happy.
The empress of his heart, Yennefer, still stirred the same feelings in his heart, only more intensely.
"..." Yennefer nodded quickly, she so badly wanted to hug Vritra but was restricted.
Using her soul power, she used it like telekinesis, as she held Vritra's hand.
She was yet to properly meet his, no their family, and wanted to talk a lot with Vritra.
The two left the dimensional book and reappeared in the marriage hall, just as they appeared, Yennefer was shocked to see her surroundings.
Especially the strange noises coming from that one particular room.
"Ignore that." Vritra quickly pulled her towards his other women.
By now, most of the people were gone, the few members of the Ford family were still around.
Though they were busy with their own problems and weren't paying any attention to others.
"Yenni is back!" Vritra said as all of his women looked at her slightly blurry form, it was her soul after all.
"..." Yennefer too had a big smile as she gazed back at them.
She had met Fiona, Vanessa and Diana before, and also recognized Yasmine immediately, but her gaze paused on Teresa.
Her smile disappeared as she looked at Vritra and asked: "Husband, who is she?"
"Oh uh..." Vritra scratched his cheek, he remembered only now how possessive she was.
At the start she didn't even like the fact that he had other women in his life, although she came to terms with it.
But of course, because of that she became quite clingy and demanded more of his time and love.
So it was evident, she wouldn't be happy to know he just went ahead and married another woman.
Even giving her a ceremony.
Vanessa couldn't help but chuckle, wondering how her son was going to deal with it.
Yasmine smiled playfully, she wanted to tease but decided not to make it difficult for her husband.
Maeve wasn't here or she would have certainly helped her master slash husband. Yennefer noticed the demoness's absence too, but that wasn't important now.
Diana just smiled faintly, it seemed a good drama was about to begin.
While Fiona as the dutiful wife took it upon her to bring her husband out of this predicament.
She gave Vritra a reassuring smile, and spoke: "Let me explain to you. She is Teresa Ford, Sir Giant's granddaughter."
After a slight pause, she continued: "And darling married her through a very grand ceremony some time ago, she is his seventh wife."
"..." Vritra looked at Fiona with surprise and a look of betrayal, it seemed she was still angry at not getting a proper ceremony.
And she chose this moment for her revenge.
'I was wrong, revenge isn't fun at all...'

sentences.text: Vritra had just taken a couple of steps when he suddenly noticed a slight change inside his dimensional book.
Quickly, he scanned and was surprised to see the tiny pill breaking apart.
Instantly joy and excitement filled his heart, looking up at his wives, he didn't explain anything and just said:
"Handle everything here, I will be back soon."
Vanessa and the others stared at him in surprise and before they could even ask, Vritra disappeared.
"What happened?" Diana looked at the others in confusion, and soon they all looked at Yasmine, who could easily see what Vritra was seeing or talk to him internally.
After a moment her eyes widened in surprise as she mumbled: "Yennefer is back!!"
Inside the dimensional book, Vritra quickly got close to the pill that was starting to crack up.
It only took a few moments and finally it disintegrated, leaving behind a weak wisp of energy.
"It's her soul!" Vritra exclaimed, surprised at how weak and close to death she actually was.
With so little strength and energy, she couldn't even regain consciousness and very soon would really die.
Vritra's heart thumped wildly as he pulled out thousands of bottles of soul potions.
Then changing their form from liquid to pure energy he moved it towards the soul, letting it strengthen and heal her.
Using Nihil Anima, Vritra surrounded her soul, making the mythic halo nourish her soul and protect it.
Without wasting a moment, he continued to pour more and more energy, frantically pouring it all into her soul.
And slowly, the soul's strength began to increase as her consciousness started to return.
Dozens of minutes passed and Vritra didn't stop until the strength of her soul had reached the general rank.
Finally she was safe, wiping the sweat from his forehead he took several long breaths, his heart beating rapidly.
"Haa it almost feels like I have become a doctor and just performed the most difficult and critical surgery."
But with his physique, he calmed down within moments.
Then he looked up at the soul, the silhouette was translucent but clearly, it was her!
That gorgeous and graceful empress, her eyes were still closed while her aura got stronger and stronger.
Vritra waited, still feeling a little nervous; right now this was his biggest worry, if she could return, his family would finally be complete... for now.
A few silent moments passed, the beautiful figure continued to float, even now she had that oppressive aura.
Out of all his wives, she was the one who showed little emotion, but also loved dominating him in bed.
A few tense moments later, her eyes fluttered and slowly, Yennefer opened her eyes.
As her blue eyes opened, she appeared dazed and confused, Vritra just waited.
As clarity returned to her eyes, she looked around with questions rising in her eyes.
And finally her gaze fixed on Vritra, she was surprised and without a word she flew close to him.
"Husband!!" Yennefer tried to hug him but her body just passed through Vritra's, leaving her baffled.
And only now did she notice her condition, after looking down, her adorable face looked confused.
Her mature and voluptuous figure trembled.
"W- What's happening?
Husband?" she looked up at Vritra, who had turned to face her.
"Yenni, welcome back..." Vritra smiled, he almost felt like crying seeing her again, but no tears were coming, thankfully.
Otherwise, crybaby would be activated for no reason.
"Huh?
I was... a dream?
Didn't I die?" Yennefer looked up at Vritra, still wondering if it was the afterlife.
After she saved Vritra, her body was destroyed and even her soul didn't survive as darkness consumed her vision.
But suddenly, she was in a very long and beautiful dream.
A dream in which only she and Vritra were present, they lived alone together on a mountain.
Like loving husband and wife, just like they lived in that divine realm.
She had spent exactly a year in that dream.
Despite everything, she was just happy to be with the one person she loved the most.
After losing him once, she never wanted to be separated.
"Yenni, this is real.
I am real and so are you." Vritra stepped forward, raising his hand to touch her cheek but she was just a soul after all.
"I didn't die?" after confusion drifted away, a beautiful smile appeared on her face.
Her heart was full of warmth and happiness as she gazed at her husband.
She had lost hope and thought that they would be separated forever.
But she was just happy that he was safe.
"Yes, you didn't.
There are a lot of things you need to know, but first let's go out." Vritra had a big smile on his face, he was just so happy.
The empress of his heart, Yennefer, still stirred the same feelings in his heart, only more intensely.
"..." Yennefer nodded quickly, she so badly wanted to hug Vritra but was restricted.
Using her soul power, she used it like telekinesis, as she held Vritra's hand.
She was yet to properly meet his, no their family, and wanted to talk a lot with Vritra.
The two left the dimensional book and reappeared in the marriage hall, just as they appeared, Yennefer was shocked to see her surroundings.
Especially the strange noises coming from that one particular room.
"Ignore that." Vritra quickly pulled her towards his other women.
By now, most of the people were gone, the few members of the Ford family were still around.
Though they were busy with their own problems and weren't paying any attention to others.
"Yenni is back!" Vritra said as all of his women looked at her slightly blurry form, it was her soul after all.
"..." Yennefer too had a big smile as she gazed back at them.
She had met Fiona, Vanessa and Diana before, and also recognized Yasmine immediately, but her gaze paused on Teresa.
Her smile disappeared as she looked at Vritra and asked: "Husband, who is she?"
"Oh uh..." Vritra scratched his cheek, he remembered only now how possessive she was.
At the start she didn't even like the fact that he had other women in his life, although she came to terms with it.
But of course, because of that she became quite clingy and demanded more of his time and love.
